jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer (Cloud Native) – Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.

Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en RTL met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNNI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.

Om onze groeiambities binnen onze smart devices practice te realiseren zoeken we een Senior Software Engineer (Cloud Native). Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwerpen van zwaarbelaste backend-omgevingen, het bewaken van technische standaarden en het meedenken over digitale oplossingen die écht verschil maken binnen mobiele applicaties voor miljoenen gebruikers.

Jouw rol

Als Senior Software Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor de cloud-architectuur en de backend-trajecten van onze smart device applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat backends standaard zijn geoptimaliseerd voor mobiele apps.

Je bent analytisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en je krijgt er energie van om complexe business-requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en denkt proactief mee over databeveiliging, cloud-kosten en schaalbaarheid. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie.

Wat je zal gaan doen:

  • Ontwerpen en programmeren van complexe cloud-native architecturen en API's (AWS Serverless, microservices) met een focus op clean code.

  • Vertalen van complexe klantvragen naar stabiele cloud-infrastructuren en dit helder uitleggen aan zowel developers als aan de klant.

  • Proactief bewaken en optimaliseren van applicatie-uptime, API-performance, databeveiliging en cloud-kosten (FinOps).

  • Reviewen van code, bewaken van de technische standaard en het coachen van andere developers binnen het team.

  • Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team.

Requirements

Wie ben jij?

We zoeken een ervaren engineer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau en meerdere jaren ervaring in het succesvol bouwen van grootschalige, complexe cloud-native applicaties. Je hebt al meters gemaakt met AWS en weet hoe je een stabiele infrastructuur ontwerpt voor mobiele toepassingen (zoals iOS en Android). Modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen.

Je bent een echte spin in de code die geniet van architectonische puzzels en kalm blijft tijdens kritieke live-gang momenten. Je streeft onvoorwaardelijk naar technisch vakmanschap en deelt jouw kennis graag om het hele team naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Je begrijpt dat het in deze rol draait om de perfecte brug te slaan tussen de wensen van de klant en de ultieme technische oplossing. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

  • Maatschappelijke Impact: De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, RTL Boulevard en het KNMI binnen een uitstekend beoordeeld top-tier maatwerk softwarebedrijf (Emerce100 koploper).

  • Salaris: Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6000,- passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten.

  • Werkplek & Sfeer: Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen.

  • Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken: Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen.

  • Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies.

  • De 'Gadget Kit': Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek.

  • Events & Fun: Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.

Solliciteren

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.

Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen software ontwikkeling) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen.

  • Excellent verbal communication skills with the ability to present information in an empathetic, clear, way. Must be adaptable, flexible, and readily able to adjust to changing situations.

jobs.title: VP, Global Practices - Professional Services
jobs.excerpt: SummaryThe VP, Global Practices leads the technical and methodological backbone of Guidewire Professional Services.
jobs.description:
Summary

The VP, Global Practices leads the technical and methodological backbone of Guidewire Professional Services. This leader owns the global capability, technical standards, and innovation agenda across five practices — InsuranceSuite & INOW, Data, Digital, Tech & Integration, and Business Consulting — and is accountable for ensuring Guidewire-led implementations and SI partner-led programs are delivered to the highest technical bar in the industry.

This role is a true VP on all three Guidewire PS VP framework dimensions: global in scope (every practice, every region, every product), strategy-setting in authority (defines the multi-year capability roadmap and the technical bar for Guidewire implementations worldwide), and externally facing (the senior technical voice of PS with customers, SI partners, analysts, and industry forums).

Job Description

What you’ll do

Strategic Accountabilities

Technical Methodology and Standards

  • Own deployment of global technical methodology — architecture standards, integration patterns, product-specific implementation methods, design patterns, and code standards — for every Guidewire product implemented through PS.

  • Maintain practice IP (toolkits, accelerators, reference architectures) in partnership with Services Product and Portfolio team, and ensure it is versioned, governed, and accessible to regions, GDC, and SI partners globally.

  • Set the engineering rigor expected of every implementation, every region, and every partner; establish the quality bar and the enforcement mechanisms that hold to it.

  • Partner with Delivery Assurance & Global PMO on integration into the end-to-end PS delivery standard, and with Global Delivery on operationalizing technical methodology into GDC and productized services.

Innovation and Practice Evolution

  • Set the multi-year vision for how each of the five practices evolves to support new products (Pricing & Rating, Underwriting, Industry Intelligence), new delivery models, and AI-accelerated implementation.

  • Lead the integration of AI methods and tools into technical practice methodology — AI-accelerated prototyping, document ingestion, intelligent automation, code-gen, and agentic workflows — in partnership with the PS AI CoE.

  • Partner with Product, Platform, and AI engineering to ensure practice capability stays ahead of product roadmap commitments — and that Guidewire-led implementations are a proof point for new product capability.

  • Champion the productization of repeatable services solutions (e.g., BOLT, US Admitted Lines) and own the technical quality of those offerings in partnership with Global Delivery and Product & Portfolio.

Talent and Capability Bench

  • Build and maintain a world-class bench of architects, technical experts, and methodologists across all five practices.

  • Define the technical career path and leveling expectations for practice talent — from senior consultant to principal architect — in partnership with People Solutions on the broader PS career framework.

  • Drive workforce planning across practices in coordination with Global Operations and Global Delivery — anticipating skill needs 12–24 months ahead of demand.

  • Drive high levels of utilization and overall productivity across practices, managing the impacts of AI on the various tasks and roles in the organization.

  • Develop succession depth for each Senior Director practice lead and identify high-potential talent for cross-practice rotation.

Sales and Strategic Deal Support

  • Serve as the senior technical voice on strategic deals — partner with GTM and regions on deal shaping, technical pre-sales, and complex proposal development.

  • Provide escalation support for at-risk programs, bringing the right practice expertise to recover delivery and protect customer outcomes.

  • Own the technical credibility of Professional Services with major customers, partners, and Guidewire executive leadership.

Partner Technical Enablement

  • Partner with Delivery Assurance & Global PMO (which owns partner program quality standards) to set the technical bar that SI partners must meet to deliver Guidewire programs successfully, and align technical certification with overall partner accreditation.

  • Build the practice tools, training, and reference assets that enable SI partners to scale quality delivery without Guidewire bottlenecks.

  • Influence the partner ecosystem strategy — which partners to invest in, where capability gaps exist, and how to close them.

Practice Areas Under Leadership

Five Senior Director-led practices, each with its own strategic mandate:

  • InsuranceSuite & INOW — global product methodology, architecture standards, and integration patterns for Guidewire's flagship core product suite.

  • Data — data architecture, platform integration, ETL, analytics enablement, and Industry Intelligence implementation methodology.

  • Digital — Jutro, digital experience layer, customer and agent portals, and modern front-end engineering practices.

  • Tech & Integration — integration architecture, API design, cloud platform engineering, DevOps, and the cross-cutting technical foundation that all practices depend on.

  • Business Consulting — insurance domain expertise, business process design, change management, and value realization advisory.

External Representation

Represents Guidewire externally as the senior technical voice of Professional Services — at customer executive briefings, customer advisory councils, SI partner technical summits, analyst engagements, and industry forums. The role is the public face of “how Guidewire implements”, with credibility to engage architects and engineers as a peer, not just a manager.

Decision Rights

  • Owns: Global technical methodology, reference architectures, architecture and integration standards, practice IP (toolkits, accelerators, design patterns, code standards), engineering quality bar for implementations, technical certification standard for SI partners, technical career path and leveling for practice talent, practice headcount plan.

  • Influences: Regional delivery execution (regions own customer P&L), program management and assurance methodology (owned by Delivery Assurance & Global PMO), engineering and delivery-execution methodology for GDC and productized services (owned by Global Delivery), product roadmap (owned by Product & Engineering), AI tooling roadmap (owned by AI CoE), partner commercial strategy (owned by GTM and Alliances).

What Success Looks Like in the First 12-18 Months

  • Each practice has a refreshed, multi-year capability roadmap aligned to Guidewire's product strategy and AI direction.

  • Measurable improvement in implementation quality and consistency — fewer escalations, more predictable technical outcomes, fewer rework cycles.

  • AI-accelerated methods are integrated into core technical practices and produce demonstrable productivity gains as well as measurable returns – in speed, accuracy, and cost-efficiency to both Customers and Guidewire.

  • The SI partner ecosystem is operating to a clearer, more rigorous technical bar with defined accreditation.

  • Senior Director practice leads are operating with greater autonomy and have credible succession plans in place.

  • Regions and customers experience Global Practices as a force multiplier — not a bottleneck.

What you’ll bring

Required experience

  • 15+ years in technology services, software implementation, or enterprise consulting, with significant time in a practice or capability leadership role.

  • Proven track record leading a global, multi-practice or multi-discipline technical organization at scale.

  • Deep experience implementing complex enterprise software — ideally in insurance, financial services, or a comparable regulated industry.

  • Demonstrated experience driving technical methodology and engineering rigor in cloud-based delivery models.

  • Experience integrating AI and automation into delivery practices — agentic tooling, code-gen, document ingestion, intelligent automation.

  • Experience operating in or alongside a major SI partner ecosystem.

Required capabilities

  • Strategy-setting leadership: defines a multi-year technical vision for a global function — anticipates market and technology shifts and translates them into clear capability priorities.

  • Stakeholder influence: builds alignment across executives, regions, partners, and customers — solves for the enterprise rather than for a single function.

  • Technical credibility with senior architects and engineers — engages as a peer, not just a manager.

  • Talent architecture: builds future-ready leaders and capability; leads transformations in skills, methodology, and ways of working.

  • Executive presence: communicates with clarity, confidence, and credibility across cultures and audiences; able to represent Guidewire externally at the highest levels.

Preferred

  • P&C insurance domain depth, or comparable depth in another core-systems-driven regulated industry.

  • Prior CTO, Chief Architect, or VP of Engineering experience in a services or product company.

  • Track record building or scaling a global practice function from earlier-stage to enterprise scale.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $232,000 - $377,000. Your base pay will depend on your experience, skills, education, training, and location among other factors. All full-time positions or part-time roles working 30 hours or more a week at Guidewire are eligible for benefits that support their health and well-being including health, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, and a company sponsored retirement plan. In addition, some roles may be eligible for the annual company bonus plan, commissions, and/or long term incentive awards which are contingent on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, company and employee performance.

Disability Accommodations and Guidewire’s Appeals Process. Guidewire provides accommodations to the hiring process to create a fair opportunity for candidates with disabilities to contend for open positions. Accommodation requests should be directed to . If things do not go as hoped, we invite you to use our appeals process. Guidewire promises to independently review any denied accommodation and any decision not to offer you the position. The appeals process is the same in either case. Within five business days of receiving a notice of denial of an accommodation, or receiving a notice of your non-selection for a vacancy, e-mail to make an appeal. Guidewire will assign a new decision-maker to review the request and/or hiring decision, who will then notify you in writing of a decision within 10 business days.

About Guidewire

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC.

Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

Remote | Based in Germany | Full-Time | Competitive Salary

Build the German market. Win new business. Own the opportunity.

You’ll work with senior decision-makers across nursing schools, vocational training providers, recognition examination preparation organisations and education institutions, building relationships and creating new commercial opportunities.

Requirements

We’re looking for a commercially driven salesperson who enjoys opening doors, building relationships and taking ownership of opportunities within the education and training sector.

Essential

  • Currently living in Germany / DACH region.
  • Comfortable working remotely while travelling occasionally for customer meetings and events when required.

This is an opportunity to support a business at an exciting stage of its growth and play a genuine role in building the German market.

The role is remote-first, giving you the flexibility to work from home while still having opportunities to get out into the market. From time to time, you’ll attend industry events, customer meetings and networking opportunities across Germany, giving you the chance to build your network, meet customers face-to-face and represent an innovative proposition.

You’ll have the opportunity to own conversations, develop opportunities, close business and grow customer relationships, giving you broader exposure than a traditional Inside Sales position.

If you’re a German-speaking B2B sales professional with experience in the education or training sector who loves winning new business, closing opportunities and building long-term customer relationships, this could be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

jobs.excerpt: As Group IT Manager, reporting to the Head of IT and working closely with the Head of UK and Global IT Cybersecurity Consultant, you will oversee the global governance, delivery, and optimisation of the organisation’s IT platforms and services.
jobs.description:
As Group IT Manager, reporting to the Head of IT and working closely with the Head of UK and Global IT Cybersecurity Consultant, you will oversee the global governance, delivery, and optimisation of the organisation’s IT platforms and services.
Working within a cloud-first, Azure-led environment, you will lead the design, standardisation, and continuous improvement of technologies including Azure, Azure Virtual Desktop, Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID, endpoint management, and cloud infrastructure.
You will ensure a seamless and secure digital workplace experience across all locations, with responsibility for platform governance, IT operations, identity and access management, endpoint governance, and service delivery within a globally standardised Azure environment.
The role also focuses on maintaining a globally aligned IT operating model, providing strategic direction and ensuring effective execution through regional IT teams, while ensuring platforms remain scalable, secure, resilient, and compliant with business and regulatory requirements.

We welcome applications from candidates who prefer to work fully office-based, in a hybrid arrangement, or fully remote from a Langham Hall country location. Successful hire would be required to work within the European time zone. Applications welcome from candidates whose working locations are based in United Kingdon, Ireland, New York, Guernsey, Jersey and Luxembourg only.

Key Responsibilities


Global Platform Ownership & Operations
  • Own and govern the global Azure environment, ensuring performance, scalability, security, resilience, and cost optimisation.
  • Lead Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) globally, including architecture, operational standards, scaling, performance, and user experience.
  • Define and enforce standards across Microsoft 365, Azure services, and core cloud platforms.
  • Act as escalation point for critical platform issues, ensuring stability and availability.
  • Drive automation, standardisation, monitoring, and continuous service improvement.

Digital Workplace & Office Technology
  • Own IT services across all global offices, ensuring a consistent digital workplace experience.
  • Define standards for collaboration tools, Microsoft Teams, conferencing systems, and meeting room technologies.
  • Ensure alignment between global standards and regional execution.
  • Improve IT service quality, responsiveness, and end-user experience globally.
Endpoint & Device Management
  • Own global endpoint management via Microsoft Intune and Autopilot.
  • Define device lifecycle standards including provisioning, configuration, patching, compliance, asset management, and retirement.
  • Ensure all endpoints meet security, compliance, and Conditional Access requirements.
  • Maintain global visibility and governance of all devices.
Identity & Access Management
  • Own Entra ID operations including identity lifecycle, access control, governance, and access reviews. Enforce Zero Trust principles, MFA, Conditional Access, least privilege, and role-based access.
  • Improve privileged access management and identity security structures.
  • Ensure compliance with audit, regulatory, and client requirements.

Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Own global joiner, mover, and leaver processes.
  • Ensure secure provisioning and deprovisioning across Entra ID, Intune, AVD, Microsoft 365, and business systems.
  • Maintain audit-ready compliance and a consistent employee experience.


Security, Risk & Incident Response
  • Own and govern security controls across all core IT platforms.
  • Ensure alignment with cybersecurity frameworks, ISO 27001, ISAE 3402, DORA, and client assurance requirements.
  • Lead or support major security incidents across platforms and regions.
  • Support audits, risk assessments, control testing, and remediation tracking.
  • Drive a strong global security culture.

Resilience, Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity

  • Own global disaster recovery and resilience strategy for cloud and IT services.
  • Ensure redundancy, failover, backup validation, and cross-region continuity. Lead DR testing, validation, and remediation activities.
  • Align IT resilience with business continuity requirements.
Network & Connectivity
  • Define global connectivity standards for Azure, Microsoft 365, AVD, and SaaS platforms.
  • Oversee secure network design including VPN, WiFi, wired networks, and cloud connectivity.
  • Manage global network providers and ensure service performance and reliability.
  • Resolve connectivity issues impacting core platforms.
Governance, Compliance & Vendor Management
  • Own IT governance frameworks, policies, and standards globally.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO 27001, ISAE 3402, and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead audit, risk, and compliance reporting activities.
  • Manage strategic vendor relationships, ensuring performance, cost optimisation, and service quality.

Global Leadership & Operating Model
  • Lead a federated global IT operating model across central and regional teams.
  • Provide technical direction and governance to regional IT teams across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Ensure consistent service delivery, tooling, and standards globally.
  • Lead global IT initiatives from strategy through to operational adoption.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Strategy & Continuous Improvement
  • Translate business requirements into global IT strategy and roadmap.
  • Drive standardisation, automation, optimisation, and simplification of IT services.
  • Ensure technology decisions align with security, compliance, and business objectives.
  • Balance strategic leadership with operational execution.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Strong experience in Microsoft Azure environments (governance, security, networking, cost management, resilience).
  • Enterprise experience with Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) including scaling, performance, and user experience optimisation.
  • Deep knowledge of Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, and modern endpoint management.
  • Strong expertise in Entra ID, identity governance, Conditional Access, MFA, Zero Trust, and least privilege models.
  • Experience managing Microsoft 365 at enterprise scale.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, VPN, WiFi, secure access, and hybrid connectivity.
  • Experience with cloud disaster recovery, resilience, and business continuity frameworks.
  • Experience operating across multi-region or global IT environments.
  • Experience in regulated environments with audit, risk, compliance, and client assurance requirements.
  • Familiarity with ISO 27001, ISAE 3402, DORA, and cybersecurity control frameworks.
  • Minimum 10 years’ IT experience, including operational and leadership responsibilities.

Preferred Attributes

  • Proven experience leading distributed or global IT teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management with senior leadership engagement.
  • Strategic thinker with ability to balance governance and execution.
  • Strong focus on global consistency and user experience.
  • Highly structured approach to governance, control, and service quality.
  • Proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong attention to detail, documentation, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborative leadership style with ability to influence across regions and vendors.

jobs.excerpt: About DoitWe are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more.
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for Android software engineers to build the native Android experience for Doit's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is based in Taiwan. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Taiwan office at least 3 days per week.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

  • Commitment to customers; service-minded
  • Makes logical timely decisions based on analysis and experience

jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for mobile developers to build BJAK's AI Neobank App across Android and iOS.

This role is for strong mobile builders who can ship clean, reliable and intuitive mobile experiences, whether their main strength is Android, iOS or both.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship mobile features for Android and/or iOS.

  • Create simple mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product, design and backend teams to turn complex journeys into usable mobile products.

  • Integrate APIs and handle edge cases, loading states, errors and production issues.

  • Improve app performance, reliability, crash rate and user experience.

  • Support fast product launches, experiments and iterations across mobile journeys.

  • Help set high standards for mobile product quality across the app.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of mobile development experience in Android, iOS or both.

  • Strong experience with Kotlin and/or Swift.

  • Experience shipping production apps used by real users.

  • Strong product sense and attention to mobile UX.

  • Able to work with APIs, analytics, crash logs and production feedback.

  • Fast, practical and comfortable owning work with limited handholding.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks like a product builder, not just a mobile coder.

  • Cares about smooth flows, small details and real user behaviour.

  • Can work across ambiguity and ship without waiting for perfect specs.

  • Takes production quality personally.

  • Honest about what they built directly versus what the wider team delivered.

This Role Is Not For

  • Developers who only want to build isolated screens.

  • People who do not care about UX, performance or reliability.

  • Candidates who cannot explain their own contribution clearly.

  • People who need heavy guidance for every task.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a high-growth environment.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Sweden. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Sweden.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
Intellect is APAC's leading mental health and wellbeing platform, serving around 4 million members across more than 100 countries through digital self-care tools, telehealth consultations, crisis helplines and physical clinics. Our mission is to make mental health support radically more accessible, preventative, relatable and stigma-free across Asia. We sell primarily to enterprise buyers — CHROs, total rewards and benefits leaders — while the end user is the employee, which means one brand with two expressions.

The Role

We're in the middle of a brand revamp — a four-phase programme to rebuild the brand key, validate it with both buyers and members, and activate it across product, web and content. Our recent design audit was blunt about where we stand: recognisable core logo, strong content, but text-heavy layouts, no unified design system across sub-brands, and creative that leans on vibrant illustration in a way that undercuts our clinical B2B positioning. You'll be the designer who closes that gap — turning credible clinical substance into work that reads as enterprise-grade and still stops the scroll.

What You'll Do

  • Campaign and social creative. Design assets across the monthly brand campaign calendar — LinkedIn single images, carousels, personal-profile posts and launch moments — with stronger visual hooks and less text density.
  • Sales and marketing collateral. Rebuild case studies, white papers and research reports with clear typographic hierarchy, generous white space, modern infographics and data visualisation so ROI metrics are skimmable.
  • Design system and sub-brands. Help build and maintain a unified system covering typography, colour, iconography, illustration and the asset bank — and bring fragmented sub-brands (Intellect Clinic, Atlas) into one coherent architecture.
  • Events and offline collateral. Design booth backdrops, roadshow banners, print and merchandise to real production specs — panel sizes, zone hierarchy, bleed and legibility at distance.
  • Motion and video. Produce and maintain video templates for YouTube and social, plus screen-recording and product-demo assets through in-house or external agencies.
  • Web. Partner with the web developer on landing pages and the site revamp, with attention to navigation hierarchy and conversion pathways for executive decision-makers.
  • Brief and quality control. Work from written design briefs, run your own reviews against brand guidelines, and help direct freelance and backup designers as volume spikes.

Requirements

Must Have

  • 3–5 years in brand, marketing or agency design, with a portfolio showing both digital and print work
  • Strong typographic and layout craft — the ability to make dense, evidence-heavy content readable.
  • Fluency in Figma; comfort with Adobe CC (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign or equivalent)
  • Experience designing to and maintaining a brand system, not just producing one-off assets
  • Data visualisation and infographic skill
  • Ability to work from a brief, take direction, and turn around at campaign pace across multiple markets

Nice To Have

  • B2B, SaaS, healthcare or regulated-industry experience
  • Motion design (After Effects) and video editing
  • Web design experience (Webflow, HubSpot CMS, Wordpress, Figma, Elementor)
  • Illustration capability that can flex toward a more restrained, clinical register
  • Experience across APAC markets and multi-language layouts

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

  • Global company – work in a diverse environment with people from nearly 20 countries
  • Generous leave policy – time off to rest and recharge
  • Christmas week off – company-wide break during Christmas, separate from annual leave
  • Birthday leave – enjoy a day off on your birthday
  • Quarterly mental health days – one day off every quarter to focus on your wellbeing
  • Flexible work arrangements – work in a way that suits your lifestyle and goals
  • Work-life balance – a culture that values personal time and long-term wellness
  • Medical coverage – comprehensive insurance for peace of mind
  • Performance bonus – high performance is recognised and rewarded
  • Development budget - annual allowance to support your professional development
  • Mental health support – premium coaching access to our mental health app and resources & dedicated budget for clinical and psychiatric care
  • Socialsand communities – regular non-work events/activities to connect and have fun together

Psychiatric Mental Health NP is a member of a treatment team, which may consist of staff with a variety of mental health, education, or medical backgrounds. The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner plans and delivers clinical services that include:

  • Document patients' medical and psychological histories, physical assessment results, diagnoses, treatment plans, prescriptions, or outcomes.
  • Evaluate patients' behavior to formulate diagnoses or assess treatments.
  • Analyze patient data to determine patient needs or treatment goals.
  • Write prescriptions for psychotropic medications as allowed by state regulations and collaborative practice agreements with experience and understanding of chemical dependency treatment.
  • Monitor patients' medication usage and results.
  • Monitor patient progress or responses to treatment.

The NP must practice in accordance with the rules adopted by the Ohio Board of Nursing, the Revised Code, and SBHI policies and procedures.

The Advanced Practitioner will document patient histories, perform physical examinations, order diagnostic tests, and perform existing patient assessments as needed. The Advance Practitioner will also implement treatment plans in coordination with the supervising physician and inform patients about the medical components of their treatment. The goal of this position is to be a key component of the integrated care team that provides high quality comprehensive care to each of our patients.

Responsibilities

    • Mentor and conduct professional development activities (e.g., in-service, training) in medical subjects relevant to the patient’s treatment
    • Participate in all trainings as required by federal, state, local and accrediting agencies
    • Develop and present training content for education on various medical topics relevant to substance use disorders and general good health practices when requested
    • Perform medical services within the scope of his/her education, training and expertise:
      • Obtain and prepare patient histories and perform physical examinations
      • Assess patient’s appropriateness for dosing, dose level adjustments, phase level adjustments, and changes to the patient’s treatment plan
      • Order or perform diagnostic procedures as delegated by the supervising physician
      • Assist in the development and implementation of a treatment plan in accordance with written clinical practice guidelines
      • Monitor the effectiveness of therapeutic interventions
      • Offer counseling and education to meet patient needs, especially in the medical areas of patient’s treatment
      • Coordinate care with ancillary healthcare providers and make referrals when appropriate
      • Review all laboratory results, as well as all medical documentation from other care providers
    • Ensure implementation of medical quality health standards for both patients and employees
    • Provide medical input into overall program philosophy, treatment services, and patient care when requested
    • Provide a response to emergency care providers when they require consultation for one of the program’s patients
    • Collaborate whenever necessary with other physicians, clinics or hospitals participating in the treatment of program patients
    • Attend weekly treatment team meetings, as well as outside seminars and training when approved by the Senior Medical Director
    • Hold a basic understanding of drug/alcohol abuse and addiction
      • Keep updated on current drug abuse and treatment information, especially current trends in Substance Use Disorders including Opioid Maintenance Treatment
    • Develop professional, helpful, and effective relationships with patients, team members, and constituents; re-engage patients as necessary
    • Ensure treatment center meets all accreditation standards related to Medical, Health, and Safety issues
    • Comply with all accrediting, federal, state, and local regulatory agency requirements
    • Assist in activities that are otherwise identified by members of the Senior Management team

Qualifications

    • Required Education/Degree:

      • Master’s degree

      Required Certification/License:

      • Ohio Certified Nurse Practitioner (KY preferred)
      • Psychiatric (Required)
      • D.E.A. licensure as required by BrightView

      Required Work Experience:

      1 to 3 years preferred, ideally with experience and understanding of substance use disorder treatment.

      Note, this position is fully remote, and working hours may be set by the provider that works for both the provider and patient

jobs.description:
Senior Partner Acquisition Manager (m/f/d) - Partner Acquisition Germany

Berlin or Frankfurt (Germany)

We're looking for a Senior Partner Acquisition Manager (m/f/d)

You'll own iwoca's most strategic partnerships in Germany, from the first conversation with a bank, payment provider or business software platform to a live integration that funds small businesses. Your mission is to bring fast, flexible finance to the places where SMEs already run their business.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4.5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Partner Acquisition Germany team builds the partner channel through which iwoca reaches small businesses in Germany: comparison platforms and brokers, banks, payment providers, business software providers and financial advisors who offer iwoca's finance to their customers at the moment it is needed. The team works with three partnership models, from a co-branded referral link and a partner portal to a full API integration, and measures its success by partners that are live and funding customers.

The team is small and works closely together: the Head of Partner Acquisition Germany, a Strategy & Data Manager who owns market analysis, business cases and the CRM, and the partner managers who own the relationships. The team prioritises partners by strategic fit, works through warm introductions and existing networks wherever possible, and stays close to every new partner until the first customers are funded. It works hand in hand with Relationship Management and the product and engineering teams in London / Berlin / Frankfurt that build the integrations.

The role

This is a senior role with full ownership of the partners you pursue. Three things matter more than anything else: You will qualify before you sell, because the best partnerships begin with a genuine customer need. You know how to activate networks and create warm introductions rather than relying solely on cold outreach. And you consider a deal complete only when the partnership is live, working well and funding its first customers. You'll travel across Germany one to two days a week for face-to-face partner meetings, industry events and trade fairs.

Ownership and impact

  • Own a portfolio of the highest-value partnership prospects in Germany, from first conversation to signed contract and live integration.

  • Lead negotiations with founders, managing directors and heads of product or partnerships at banks, payment providers, business software platforms and financial intermediaries.

  • Design the cooperation model and commercial terms for each partner so that the partnership works for both sides over years, not quarters.

  • Bring every partner to go-live with a committed internal promoter and a first concrete use case, so that your work turns into funded customers and long-term value.

Autonomy, backed by a dedicated strategy and data function

  • Spend your time on relationships and deals, with a Strategy & Data Manager who builds target models, business cases and CRM automation alongside you for your prospects and partners.

  • Own your pipeline end to end and keep it transparent, so that forecasts and decisions rest on input and numbers everyone trusts.

  • Decide together with the Head of Partner Acquisition which segments and partners you pursue and where you say no.

Influence on product and strategy

  • Feed what you learn from partners directly into our partnership models, the integration roadmap and the go-to-market plan for Germany.

  • Shape the activation playbook for new partners and the handover to Key Account Management together with the Head of Business Development.

  • Represent iwoca at the industry events, trade fairs and partner roundtables that matter for SME finance in Germany.

The requirements

Essential:

  • At least five years of experience in B2B partnerships, business development or key account management in fintech, banking, payments or business software. You can show a proven track record of closing complex deals with six to twelve month sales cycles at C-Level, founder, board or head-of-department level.

  • A working understanding of how a financing product is integrated into a partner's platform: APIs, embedded finance and how a partner's customer data can be used in the application journey. You won't build integrations yourself (our engineering teams do that), but you need to lead that conversation credibly.

  • Native-level German and professional English.

  • Demonstrates curiosity to use and learn more about AI tools. You’ll already be comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to help solve problems, increase productivity and improve quality of work, showing good judgement about when to use them and the ability to explain the reasoning behind that use.

Bonus:

  • An existing network among German banks, payment providers, brokers or business software platforms.

  • Experience with lending, working capital or other financial products for small businesses.

  • Experience managing a partner pipeline in HubSpot and using data to prioritise targets.

Don’t take this list as prescriptive: it’s just to give you a sense of who might do well at the job. We’d still love to hear from you if you don’t hit every point on the list, or if you have other experience.

The salary

We expect to pay from €70,000 - €85,000 base salary plus a performance-related bonus for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • A smart, motivated and international team (we represent over 35 different nationalities) with a ridiculous growth-mindset.

  • 26 days of vacation a year plus a free day for your birthday.

  • One-month fully paid sabbatical after 4 years.

  • Mental health support with direct access to certified psychologists via our partner OpenUp.

  • iwoca takes over a ski chalet in winter so that you and your team can ski or snowboard (and work) for a week. During summer we are drawn to the sun. We’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

  • Access to the gym membership program, €25 for either Fit711 or Urban Sports Club.

  • €30 contribution towards the Deutschlandticket.

  • Company Pension with Canada Life.

  • Great office locations. In Frankfurt in the middle of the city, our Berlin office is located in Prenzlauer Berg.

  • A paid volunteer day that gives you the opportunity to invest time to support a charity of your choice.

  • Corporate Benefits discounts.

  • ’iwocans’ also benefit from fully stocked fridges in our offices with whatever is needed to strengthen them. There are snacks (both healthy and less healthy) for the whole day.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone, including a book budget.

  • Learning German budget.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • See iwoca benefits & policies iwocade/iwoca-benefits-policies-de for detail and some additional benefits.

  • See iwoca interview welcome pack iwocade/iwoca-interview-welcome-pack-de.

Compensation Range: €70K - €85K

Zelfstandig betekent niet alleen

Je krijgt ruimte om zelfstandig te behandelen, maar staat er inhoudelijk niet alleen voor. Je werkt samen met onder anderen psychologen, ervaringsdeskundigen, verpleegkundigen en psychiaters.

Je stemt af met de regiebehandelaar over behandelplannen en bespreekt casuïstiek met collega’s wanneer dat inhoudelijk nodig is. Ook neem je deel aan multidisciplinaire overleggen.

Zo combineer je zelfstandig werken met de kennis van verschillende disciplines.

Zo ziet werken bij GGz Online eruit

GGz Online is de digitale poli van GGz Centraal en biedt specialistische geestelijke gezondheidszorg volledig online. Niet alleen het contact met cliënten is digitaal; de manier van werken is daarop ingericht.

Binnen de behandeling werken we met evidence-based interventies en verschillende digitale behandeltechnieken. Als masterpsycholoog krijg je daarmee de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen én ervaring op te bouwen met volledig digitaal behandelen.

Requirements

Past deze manier van werken bij jou?

Volledig digitaal behandelen moet bij je passen. Je hebt niet voortdurend collega's fysiek om je heen en organiseert je werk voor een belangrijk deel zelf. Dat vraagt dat je verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor je eigen werk en gericht afstemming zoekt wanneer dat nodig is.

Je past bij deze manier van werken als je:

  • zelfstandig kunt werken en professionele verantwoordelijkheid neemt;

  • digitaal vaardig bent;

  • via beeldbellen een professionele behandelrelatie kunt opbouwen;

  • zorgvuldig en gestructureerd kunt werken;

  • nieuwsgierig bent naar de mogelijkheden van digitale behandeltechnieken;

  • collega's actief opzoekt voor afstemming en inhoudelijke verdieping.

Dit heb je nodig

Voor deze functie heb je:

  • een afgeronde universitaire masteropleiding psychologie;

  • een LOGO-verklaring of de mogelijkheid deze op korte termijn aan te vragen;

  • ervaring binnen de specialistische ggz;

  • een afgeronde basiscursus CGT.

Ervaring met EMDR, imaginaire exposure en/of ACT is een pré.

Daarnaast ben je bij voorkeur twee avonden per week beschikbaar om tot 19.30 uur te behandelen.

Wat je van ons krijgt

Werk dat er toe doet en waar je van betekenis bent, dat is alvast onze eerste belofte. Omdat we een grote organisatie zijn met veel verschillende mogelijkheden kunnen we inspelen op ontwikkelwensen en voorkeuren qua functie-inhoud, type behandelprogramma en woon-werkafstand. We zien wie je bent en wat je kan. Als -masterpsycholoog bij GGz Centraal kun je in ieder geval rekenen op:

  • een bruto maandsalaris volgens CAO GGZ, FWG 60 (tussen €4.544,- en €5.901,- o.b.v. 36 uur​). Bereken hier jouw netto salaris.

  • een contract voor 24-36 uur per week voor onbepaalde tijd. We werken vanuit vertrouwen, dus je krijgt meteen een vast contract.

  • een vakantietoeslag en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%.

  • 166 verlofuren en 35 levensfase-uren o.b.v. 36 uur. Zo willen we bijdragen aan een goede werk-privébalans.

  • een jaarlijks balansbudget van €1.000,- naar rato. Dit budget kun je besteden aan iets waar jij blij van wordt. Denk aan een cursus, extra salaris of verlofuren, aan jou de keuze.

Boven alles bieden we je een uitdagende en afwisselende baan met de ruimte om jezelf professioneel en persoonlijk te ontwikkelen via opleidingen, trainingen en interne scholing.

PrOMO
Masterpsychologen en orthopedagogen kunnen bij ons een intern ontwikkelprogramma volgen, waarmee startende gedragswetenschappers hun kennis ten aanzien van diagnostiek en behandeling kunnen uitbreiden. Meer weten? Alles over PrOMO lees je hier.

Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn conform de CAO GGZ. Heb je vragen? Laat het ons weten.

Klaar om te solliciteren?

Past deze manier van behandelen bij jou en voldoe je aan de functie-eisen? Solliciteer dan via de sollicitatieknop.

Zodra we een passende kandidaat hebben gevonden, kunnen we de vacature eerder sluiten.

Eerst weten hoe dit in de praktijk werkt?

Benieuwd hoe volledig online behandelen er voor een masterpsycholoog in de praktijk uitziet? Of wil je meer weten over de caseload, behandelmethoden of samenwerking met de regiebehandelaar? neem dan contact op met Carlos Croes, klinisch psycholoog/manager zorg, via +31 6 53479468.

Een referentiecheck maakt onderdeel uit van het aannamebeleid. Bij indiensttreding vragen we om een actuele Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG). GGz Online vraagt deze voor je aan en vergoedt de kosten.

Highlights

Je behandelt volwassenen met onder andere angst, depressie en trauma volledig online. Met bewezen behandelmethoden én digitale technieken werk je gericht aan kortdurende, intensieve behandelingen.

Operating within Nelnet’s GenAI delivery team, this role translates the Forward Deployed Engineer’s scoped requirements into production data pipelines on Google Cloud, working closely with the GCP/Gemini Enterprise Engineer to ensure data is structured, classified, and access-controlled appropriately for AI use.   • Design, build, and maintain data pipelines using BigQuery and Dataflow (or Cloud Composer/Apache Airflow) to ingest, transform, and serve client data for GenAI use cases.

Data Classification & AI Readiness

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Direct experience with BigQuery and Dataflow (or Cloud Composer/Apache Airflow) strongly preferred; candidates with strong GenAI/AI-adjacent data engineering experience on other platforms who can ramp quickly on Google Cloud will be considered.

  • Experience partnering with client or partner technical teams to extract and integrate data from legacy or third-party systems (SIS, ERP, casework systems).

jobs.excerpt: About DarkroomDarkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow.
jobs.description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the role

We are looking for a highly analytical, commercially-minded Associate Director who is motivated by the challenge of building a retention program for a high-growth consumer technology company. You will lead a team of lifecycle marketing experts to drive subscriber growth and revenue, and partner with cross-functional colleagues to go deeper on customer behavior — with a specific focus on activation, loyalty, and long-term customer value.

You are building this program from the ground up rather than optimizing one that already exists. The list starts near 20,000 and scales rapidly behind a significant acquisition investment. Sending volume ramps to 40–60 emails a month, and increasingly granular segmentation is what drives that output. Automation is the engine: lead capture, welcome series, and the first-conversion funnel come first, then subscription activation, loyalty, and repeat purchase. The program runs on enterprise tooling — Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, , or comparable.

You own the top-line retention revenue number for your client. You build the forecast, defend it, and lead the team that hits it.

We are open to candidates in NYC, NJ, Florida and Texas.

You should apply if this sounds like you

You are a growth marketer first and a lifecycle marketer second. You think in cohorts, conversion rates, and payback periods. You are energized by a program that does not exist yet and a list that is about to grow 10x.

  • 7+ years of experience in digital, growth, or lifecycle marketing, including time spent on subscription or SaaS products.

  • You have owned a revenue or subscriber target and built the forecast behind it — you can model list growth, conversion, activation, and churn and explain what moves each one.

  • You have scaled a lifecycle program through a period of rapid list growth, and you know what breaks when volume goes from a handful of sends to 40–60 per month.

  • You have built the funnel that matters here: lead capture, welcome series, first conversion, and subscription activation. You know the difference between a welcome flow that greets people and one that converts them.

  • You are fluent in subscription economics — trial-to-paid, activation, free-to-paid, upgrade and downgrade paths, involuntary churn, and win-back.

  • You have developed loyalty, referral, or rewards programming that measurably improved repeat purchase and LTV. Driving loyalty and repeat purchase is a core outcome of this role, not a side project.

  • You have worked in an enterprise-grade ESP such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, or , and you understand what these platforms make possible: complex segmentation, event-driven journeys, in-app and push alongside email, and integration with a real product data stream.

  • You love making data-driven decisions and excel at turning analysis into lifecycle strategy that drives revenue. You are comfortable building the reporting yourself when you need to.

  • You are used to a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple workstreams for yourself, your team, and your client.

  • You have had at least one direct report before, or exceptional leadership skills working with cross-functional teams.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to articulate complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people at any level.

  • You dedicate time to staying on the cutting edge of consumer technology, subscription, and lifecycle marketing.

A day in the life

  • Serve as the senior point of contact for your client, meeting weekly to review performance and shape current and future initiatives.

  • Own the retention revenue forecast — build it, update it, and bring the recommendations that close any gap to plan.

  • Set the segmentation and lifecycle strategy that drives the program's output, and prioritize the roadmap of flows, campaigns, and tests behind it.

  • Own subscription activation and retention: the trial and onboarding journeys, the conversion moments, and the loyalty, repeat purchase, and win-back programming that extends customer lifetime.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with your direct reports, manage workload and capacity, and train the team to help them grow into experts.

  • Develop the strategic campaign calendar and partner with your specialists to deliver it at volume.

  • Review all client briefs and creative for approval before they reach the client.

  • Set the client's KPI framework and work with the team to turn results into insights and actionable recommendations.

  • Coordinate cross-departmentally with the Performance Marketing and Strategy teams so that acquisition investment and lifecycle programming reinforce each other.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + US holidays: Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.

  • Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage.

  • Finances, growth, and retirement: Darkroom offers a robust 401(k) program with company match and profit-sharing opportunities to help you save and grow as the company grows.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

  • Compensation: The base salary range for this role is $100,000-$120,000 per year. This range represents the anticipated minimum and maximum for this position and applies to candidates based in New York, including New York City, in compliance with the New York State Pay Transparency Law and the New York City Salary Transparency Law. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We’re seeking a skilled Infrastructure Engineer to build the next-generation data management and artificial intelligence platform for maritime domain awareness.

Spear AI is a growing defense contracting company dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions that support our nation’s security. As we expand, we’re building a culture where innovation meets mission-critical work. We operate with a flat organizational structure that empowers every team member to make an impact, collaborate directly with leadership, and contribute to projects that matter. Whether you’re joining our Hardware, Software, or Services division, you’ll work alongside talented professionals who are committed to excellence and advancing the capabilities that keep our nation safe and secure.

Spear AI builds sonobuoy sensors that are deployed into the water and collect edge data. We also work with the U.S. Navy to collect and process their SONAR data. You’ll have an opportunity to work on real-world projects that directly impact warfighter capabilities and mission success.

What you’ll do

We’re a small team wearing many hats, and you’d have a wide variety of responsibilities that include:

  • Design and implement cloud architecture.

  • Develop Infrastructure as Code using Pulumi.

  • Build CI/CD and DevSecOps pipelines.

  • Continuously deploy to AWS cloud and air-gapped environments.

  • Monitor applications/services with OpenTelemetry, Sentry, and SigNoz.

  • Enforce CMMC compliance policies and rules.

  • Manage secrets and configuration.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone with strong Software Engineering skills who shares our most important values:

  • You’re fanatical about polish. Every detail matters. You love to make sure your code is linted, formatted, fully typed, and has 100% test coverage.

  • You care about correctness. You take pride in the fact that downstream consumers trust libraries and services you build.

  • You obsess over performance. You daydream about Lighthouse scores and query speed.

  • You dive deep. It’s important for you to really know how things work. You’re always building prototypes and setting up experiments to reinforce your understanding.

  • You live on the bleeding edge. You’ve got a long list of upcoming platform features you’re excited about and can’t wait for the next nightly to drop.

  • You’re a great teacher. You know how to break down a concept for a specific audience and make it click with them in a way that gets them excited.

Why work with us

  • We ship — We don’t work on 18-month projects that are irrelevant before they’re even finished.

  • Our work has impact — We build products that are deployed to U.S. submarines and integrate with the sonobuoys we manufacture.

  • We’re growing responsibly — We have the resources to hire a lot more people, but we don’t want to build a massive team of people who don’t share our values.

  • We’re remote — Work from wherever you want. We collaborate in real time on Slack or asynchronously via GitHub.

  • We’re profitable — We aren’t burning through cash trying to make the business work. But we also have investors who believe in us and are committed to our success.

  • We care about doing great work — You don’t need permission to sweat the details here.

  • We don’t take ourselves too seriously — We’re building products that make the world safer. But we don’t let that get to our heads.

Important skills

  • Expert in Infrastructure as Code using Pulumi or Terraform.

  • Expert in Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Expert in CI/CD and DevSecOps with GitHub Actions.

  • Proficiency in AWS and/or other cloud services.

  • Proficiency in TypeScript and Go.

  • Proficiency with networking.

  • Familiar with cybersecurity compliance frameworks like CMMC, PCI, or SOC.

  • Familiar with Single Sign-on and Identity Providers (IdP) like Authentik and Keycloak.

  • Experience deploying to air-gapped environments.

  • Experience self-hosting on bare metal servers.

Nice to have

  • Familiar with working in monorepos.

  • Experience with Change Data Capture.

  • Experience with IoT devices and sensors.

  • Digital signal processing experience.

  • Geospatial analysis and GIS experience.

What we offer

  • Unlimited PTO — Take the time you need to recharge and maintain work-life balance.

  • Dedicated sick time — Your health and well-being come first.

  • Comprehensive health and benefits – Medical, dental, and vision coverage to keep you and your family protected.

  • 11 Paid Holidays — Enjoy time off throughout the year to celebrate and spend time with loved ones.

  • Professional development — Educational opportunities and resources to help you grow your skills and advance your career.

  • Collaborative environment — Work directly with leadership in our flat organizational structure, where your ideas and contributions matter.

  • Mission-driven work — Contribute to projects that directly support national security and make a real-world impact.

  • Growth opportunities — Join us during an exciting expansion phase where you can help shape our future.

Additional benefit opportunities when you choose Spear AI:

  • 401(k) with company match.

  • Onsite / Remote / Flexible work arrangements or hybrid options (position dependent).

  • Relocation assistance (position dependent).

  • Referral bonuses.

  • Performance bonuses.

  • Life insurance and disability coverage.

  • Technology home office setup stipend.

  • Professional certification reimbursement (position dependent).

We offer competitive compensation tailored to your experience, location, and the impact you’ll make. We’re committed to equitable pay and will share a range aligned to your level and geography during the hiring process. In accordance with state law, candidates in jurisdictions such as CA, CO, WA, NY, and others, where applicable, will be provided a good-faith salary range upon request and throughout the hiring process. This is a full-time, exempt position under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and is not eligible for overtime pay.

Compensation for this position is provided on a salaried basis and is not subject to reduction based on hours worked. At Spear AI, you’ll find more than just a job; you’ll join a mission-driven team where your work directly contributes to national security. Our flat organizational structure means your voice matters, your ideas reach leadership, and your impact is visible. As we grow, we’re committed to building robust processes and infrastructure that support both our mission and our people. We value collaboration, continuous improvement, and the expertise each team member brings to the table. If you’re looking for a place to grow professionally while working on projects that truly matter, we’d love to hear from you.
