We are looking for a Telesales Operations Associate to join our Retention Team as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.


About M-KOPA

M-KOPA has connected 10 million customers to life-changing technology and services, unlocking $2B+ in credit across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana, and South Africa. With 35,000+ field agents and 2,300+ employees, we've built one of Africa's largest asset financing platforms, one where 86% of customers report improved quality of life and 55% are accessing formal financial services for the first time. We call them Every Day Earners, and everything we build exists to expand what's possible for them.

Role overview

As Telesales Operations Associate, you'll provide the operational backbone for our Telesales Team in Nigeria, a hybrid role based in our office and working alongside colleagues across the UK, Europe, and Africa. You'll report to the Telesales Team Lead and be the connective tissue between sales agents, shop teams, and delivery partners, making sure every sale that gets closed actually gets fulfilled.

This is a hybrid role, you would be working from our office in Nigeria, partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across the UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Telesales Team Lead.


What makes this different

This isn't back-office admin for its own sake. Every account you create, every delivery you unblock, every stock shortage you catch early is a customer who gets their product on time instead of falling out of the funnel. You'll have direct visibility into where the sales process breaks and real ownership over fixing it.

What You'll Do

  • Supporting telesales agents through account creation, device unlocking, and closing out compliance and documentation before handover

  • Coordinating delivery requests with DSRs and shop teams, chasing down delayed or failed deliveries until resolved

  • Monitoring stock levels across shops and escalating shortages before they disrupt sales

  • Keeping CRM and internal systems updated with accurate fulfilment and delivery status

  • Any other tasks as assigned by the Telesales Team Leader.

What You'll Need

  • A Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Sales, or a related field

  • 3 – 5 years' experience in telesales operations, sales administration, customer service, or operations support (an added advantage)

  • Strong CRM experience (FreshDesk, 3CX, or similar), sharp organisational instincts, and comfort working in a fast-paced, target-driven environment

The honest part

Sales moves fast, and things go wrong: deliveries stall, stock runs short, documentation gets missed. You'll be the person tracking it all down and getting it sorted, often under time pressure. If chasing loose ends to closure sounds satisfying rather than draining, you'll fit right in.

Ready to help us get the small moments right, at scale? Let's talk.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

jobs.description:
Mission

EdReports.org is at the forefront of the curriculum reform movement. By increasing the capacity of educators to identify and demand the highest quality curriculum, EdReports.org is both disrupting a multibillion-dollar market and transforming the way students are taught and ultimately perform. With the firm belief that what is taught matters and that all students deserve high quality materials, EdReports.org publishes free, online, evidence-rich reviews of instructional materials. Explore our organization's core competencies in greater detail here.

Planning to use Artificial Intelligence (AI) for your application, interview prep, or for other means of assistance throughout the hiring process? Click here to review our AI guidance before proceeding.

Purpose

EdReports seeks an experienced Writing Editor to provide approximately 25 hours of substantive and technical editorial support for the Multilingual Learner (MLL) Early Math tools and supporting resources.

The Writing Editor will strengthen the clarity, organization, readability, flow, precision, consistency, and accessibility of these materials while preserving their technical meaning and the integrity of the underlying evidence, criteria, and intended interpretations.

This engagement requires more than proofreading or copyediting. The contractor must exercise editorial judgment about structure, language, audience, consistency, and meaning while recognizing when a proposed revision requires consultation with an EdReports content or subject-matter expert.

Scope and Level of Effort

This engagement is limited to approximately 25 total hours of editorial services. At the start of the engagement, EdReports and the contractor will confirm the materials and editorial priorities to be addressed within the available hours.

The contractor will prioritize work that has the greatest impact on:

  • clarity, readability, and organization;
  • precision and consistency of language;
  • preservation of technical meaning;
  • usability and accessibility for intended audiences; and
  • overall editorial quality.

If the volume or complexity of the assigned materials exceeds what can reasonably be completed within 25 hours, the contractor will notify the project lead, identify outstanding work, and recommend priorities before proceeding.

Scope of Work

Within the agreed-upon level of effort, the contractor will:

  • Review prioritized materials to identify significant issues related to organization, flow, readability, terminology, precision, consistency, and accessibility.
  • Substantively and developmentally edit assigned content to improve organization, sequencing, clarity, transitions, directions, explanations, and relationships among concepts, evidence, criteria, and guidance.
  • Edit for clarity and precision by reducing ambiguity, unnecessary complexity, repetition, and wordiness while preserving the nuance and intended meaning of the content.
  • Preserve technical fidelity by reviewing proposed edits to ensure they do not unintentionally change mathematical concepts, multilingual learner considerations, evidence statements, criteria, scoring guidance, or intended interpretations.
  • Identify and document substantive questions requiring review by EdReports content or subject-matter experts rather than independently resolving questions outside the contractor's editorial expertise.
  • Strengthen consistency across prioritized materials, including terminology, definitions, directions, examples, language conventions, and related explanations.
  • Copyedit and conduct quality control for grammar, syntax, punctuation, spelling, mechanics, usage, and editorial consistency.
  • Incorporate one consolidated round of EdReports feedback and conduct a final editorial review of the agreed-upon materials, as time permits within the 25-hour engagement.

Compensation & Contract Period

This contract is expected to require up to 25 hours of work and will be compensated at $100 per hour, for a maximum contract amount of $2,500. The contractor may not exceed 25 hours without prior written approval from EdReports. The contract period is approximately October 2026 through November 2026.

Deliverables

Within the 25-hour engagement, the contractor will provide:

  1. Edited Priority MaterialsSubstantive, developmental, and copy edits to the materials identified as priorities at the start of the engagement.
  2. Editorial Questions and RecommendationsClearly documented questions, ambiguities, technical concerns, or substantive issues requiring decisions from EdReports content experts.
  3. Editorial Style/Decision LogA concise record of recurring terminology, usage, capitalization, formatting, and other editorial decisions identified through the work.
  4. Final Revised MaterialsIncorporation of one consolidated round of feedback and a final editorial quality-control review of agreed-upon materials within the available contract hours.

Successful Completion

The engagement will be considered successfully completed when the contractor has:

  • completed the agreed-upon priority work within the 25-hour level of effort;
  • improved the clarity, organization, precision, readability, and consistency of the materials addressed;
  • preserved the technical meaning and intent of the underlying content;
  • appropriately identified issues requiring subject-matter expert decisions;
  • consistently applied agreed-upon editorial decisions; and
  • provided EdReports with edited materials and documentation sufficient to support any remaining or future revisions.

Completion of the engagement is based on the agreed-upon level of effort and prioritized deliverables, rather than completion of an unlimited volume of MLL Early Math materials.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Demonstrated professional experience editing complex educational, technical, research-based, instructional, or comparable content.
  • Demonstrated experience with both substantive/developmental editing and copyediting.
  • Strong technical editing skills, including the ability to improve organization, clarity, readability, and language while preserving accuracy, nuance, and intended meaning.
  • Exceptional command of English grammar, syntax, punctuation, usage, mechanics, and editorial conventions.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify ambiguity, inconsistencies, terminology conflicts, unsupported wording, and subtle differences in meaning within complex written materials.
  • Ability to translate or edit complex ideas into clear, precise, reader-centered language without oversimplifying the content.
  • Experience applying style guides and maintaining consistent editorial conventions across related materials.
  • Experience creating or maintaining editorial style sheets, terminology guides, decision logs, or similar tools.
  • Ability to distinguish between editorial issues and substantive content questions requiring review by a subject-matter expert.
  • Experience collaborating effectively with authors, researchers, curriculum specialists, content experts, or other subject-matter experts.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to independently manage work, communicate questions or risks promptly, incorporate feedback, and meet agreed-upon deadlines.
  • Understanding of K–12 education and educator audiences through professional editing, curriculum development, instructional materials, education research, teaching, or comparable experience.
  • 5+ years of professional writing and/or editing experience, including demonstrated experience substantively editing complex, technical, research-based, educational, or similarly specialized content.
  • Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education, training, and professional experience.

Preferred:

  • Professional editing experience with K–12 instructional materials, curriculum, assessments, educator-facing guidance, education research, or instructional-materials reviews.
  • Background or demonstrated subject-matter knowledge in mathematics education, particularly early mathematics or elementary mathematics.
  • Background or demonstrated subject-matter knowledge in multilingual learner education, English learner education, language development, or linguistically responsive instruction.
  • Experience editing materials that integrate education research, evidence statements, rubrics, criteria, indicators, or scoring guidance.
  • Experience editing materials intended for multiple education audiences, such as teachers, instructional leaders, district leaders, reviewers, researchers, or curriculum decision-makers.
  • Familiarity with plain-language, readability, inclusive-language, and accessibility principles as applied to educational or technical content.
  • Experience working within collaborative document-development environments and version-controlled editorial workflows.

Contractor Expectations

Work is normally performed in a remote office environment including, but not limited to standing and sitting for long periods of time; and fine-finger and hand manipulation to operate a computer and keyboard. Contractor is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as preparing and analyzing electronic information, transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, and extensive reading.

Project Management and Invoicing

The contractor will participate in limited project check-ins or editorial consultations as mutually agreed upon and necessary to complete the work.

The contractor will track hours against the 25-hour project maximum and alert the project lead when approaching the agreed-upon limit. Invoices should identify the applicable materials or deliverables and provide sufficient detail regarding the editorial work completed.

Any work beyond the agreed-upon 25-hour scope must be discussed and approved separately before the additional work is performed.

We Value All Voices

Nice to Have

  • Open-source contributions in ML systems or inference tooling

  • Background in distributed systems or low-latency services

Why Join Us

  • Real ownership over performance-critical systems

  • Direct impact on product reliability and unit economics

  • Close collaboration with research, infra, and product

  • A team that cares about engineering quality, not hype

Gerade für kleine Unternehmen muss es oft schnell gehen. Chancen warten nicht und Liquiditätsengpässe können über Nacht entstehen. Um voranzukommen und zu wachsen, brauchen KMU Finanzierung, die genauso flexibel und reaktionsschnell ist wie sie selbst.

Wir haben bereits mehr als 150.000 Unternehmen mit über 4,5 Milliarden Euro unterstützt. Unser Team setzt alles daran, noch mehr Mittelständler*innen zum Erfolg zu verhelfen - durch besseren Zugang zu Finanzierung und zusätzliche Services, die den Geschäftsalltag einfacher machen. Unsere Mission? Eine Million Unternehmen in ihren entscheidenden Momenten zu unterstützen und so einen nachhaltigen Beitrag zu leisten- sowohl für die Unternehmen selbst, als auch für ihr wirtschaftliches Ökosystem und die deutsche Gesamtwirtschaft.

Die Stelle

Als Account Manager*in bist du die direkte Schnittschnelle zu unseren Kund*innen und die Stimme von iwoca. Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio von Neu- und Bestandskund*innen und unterstützt eigenverantwortlich Unternehmer*innen während unseres Kreditprozesses und der gesamten Kreditlaufzeit. Dabei legst du höchsten Wert auf Kundenservice und ermöglichst unseren Kund*innen durch deine Kommunikation die optimale Nutzung unserer Produkte.
Ein grundlegender Baustein für unseren Erfolg ist es, Kund*innen und Partner*innen von unserer Mission zu überzeugen und zu begeistern - das reicht bei unseren Kund*innen vom Frisörsalon bis zur Zahnarztpraxis und bei unseren Partner*innen von der Finanzberatung bis zu den Mitarbeiter*innen der Bankfiliale.

Zusammen arbeiten, gemeinsam wachsen: Bei uns erwartet dich ein Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen wirklich etwas bewegen. Dass unsere Kultur nicht nur auf dem Papier gut klingt, zeigt auch unser Kununu-Score von über 4,4 – ein Team, auf das man sich jeden Tag freuen kann!

Grundlegend:

  • Zeigt Neugier im Umgang mit KI-Tools und Interesse daran, diese weiter zu erlernen. Du nutzt KI bereits sicher in der Praxis, um Probleme zu lösen, effizienter zu arbeiten und die Qualität deiner Arbeit zu verbessern. Wir suchen Menschen, die smart, bodenständig und motiviert sind und sich ständig weiterentwickeln wollen. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, trifft im Idealfall Folgendes auf Dich zu:

Über Corominas Consulting:

Wir bei Corominas Consulting haben eine klare Mission: Wir sind die Experten für das Marketing von Anwalts- und Steuerkanzleien. Unsere Vision ist es, die unangefochtene Nummer eins im deutschsprachigen Raum zu werden. Wir helfen Kanzleien dabei, sich voll auf ihre Mandanten zu konzentrieren, während wir ihr Marketing und ihre digitalen Prozesse auf das nächste Level heben.

Wenn du Lust hast, mit uns gemeinsam eine ganze Branche zu modernisieren – dann lies weiter.

Wir leben Effizienz, modernste Software-Workflows und messbare Ergebnisse. Zur Verstärkung unseres eigenen Wachstums suchen wir einen ambitionierten Sales Setter (m/w/d), der den Grundstein für seine Karriere im High-Ticket-Vertrieb legen möchte.

Diese Position ist deine gezielte Vorstufe zur Rolle als Closer. Wir stellen Closer nicht extern ein, sondern bilden unser Top-Personal ausschließlich intern aus.

Aufgaben

Deine Kernaufgaben:

  • Qualifizierung von Inbound-Leads: Du bist unser strategischer Filter. Du prüfst neue Anfragen via Google Meet oder Nachricht und entscheidest, ob die Interessenten perfekt zu unseren Lösungen passen.
  • Strategisches Terminmanagement: Du führst die Erstgespräche und buchst qualifizierte Termine für unsere Sales-Experten.
  • Follow-up & Reaktivierung: Du bleibst an Bestands-Kontakten dran und fasst konsequent bei Leads nach, um keine Potenziale liegenzulassen.
  • CRM-Pflege & Dokumentation: Du arbeitest in einer sauberen digitalen Struktur (Airtable/CRM), damit das Team jederzeit weiß, wo ein Projekt steht.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil:

  • Du bist kommunikationsstark und liebst es, Menschen in Video-Calls zu überzeugen.
  • Du denkst ergebnisorientiert und hast den nötigen Biss im Follow-up.
  • Du arbeitest hochgradig strukturiert und schätzt klare To-do-Systeme.
  • Du hast Lust auf eine steile Lernkurve und willst Verantwortung übernehmen.

Benefits

Was dich bei Corominas Consulting erwartet:

  • 100 % Remote-Infrastruktur: Arbeite von wo du willst – wir nutzen Google Meet und die besten digitalen Tools am Markt.
  • Attraktive variable Vergütung: Neben deinem Fixum profitierst du von einem transparenten Provisionsmodell. Dein Erfolg zahlt sich direkt aus – nach oben gibt es keine Deckelung.
  • Strukturierte Karriere-Roadmap: In den ersten Wochen durchläufst du eine intensive Ausbildung zum Setter. Bei entsprechender Performance folgt deine Beförderung zum Closer.
  • Exzellentes Setup: Wir bieten dir eine hochwertige technische Ausstattung und eine Arbeitskultur, die auf Eigenverantwortung und klaren Prozessen basiert.
  • Teamkultur 2.0: Wir setzen auf echten Zusammenhalt und Teambonding, das über den Standard-Smalltalk hinausgeht.

Werde Teil unserer Reise.

Wir bauen gerade etwas auf, das es in dieser Form im deutschsprachigen Raum noch nicht gibt – und wir suchen Leute, die diese Reise mit uns gehen wollen. Wenn du dich hier wiedererkennst und Bock hast, mit uns die Kanzleiwelt zu verändern, dann melde dich.

Deine Bewerbung: Wir brauchen keine langen Anschreiben. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze zu deiner Motivation.

jobs.excerpt: Welcome to a workplace where everyone passionately believes in one purpose!
jobs.description:
Welcome to a workplace where everyone passionately believes in one purpose!

Our company's commitment extends beyond tasks; it's about infusing every action with purpose. We are dedicated to bringing unparalleled passion and customer focus to every facet of our business, creating an environment where your contribution truly matters.

With 70 years of experience, we are the leading strategic partner, providing specialized solutions for airlines, airports, and enterprises across 21 countries throughout The Caribbean and Latin America.

At GCG, we believe the secret recipe for a perfect team blends talent, focus, and discipline. We seek these qualities in candidates eager to thrive in a diverse and multicultural environment.

Our comprehensive solutions include Sky Dining, Airport Dining, Aviation Support, and Culinary. With a team of over 5,500 highly skilled experts dedicated to excellence, we uphold the highest standards of quality and service. We are committed to elevating travel & culinary experiences for all our customer's journeys, becoming the top choice in the region.

JOB PURPOSE

Lead the strategy, delivery, and continuous improvement of the Group’s technology infrastructure across all stations in Latin America & the Caribbean. The role ensures a secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient infrastructure that enables business growth and operational excellence. This leader owns infrastructure roadmaps (network, compute, storage, cloud, collaboration, endpoint, connectivity), orchestrates a multi-country delivery model with cluster and station IT teams, and drives program/portfolio management for all infrastructure initiatives.

This role co-owns the Cybersecurity Program (policies, controls, remediation, awareness, DR/BCP) in partnership with the Cybersecurity Manager, ensuring implementation, compliance, remediation, and operationalization of controls across the Group.



Duties & Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Strategic leadership & execution

  • Build and execute a 24-month rolling Infrastructure Strategy & Roadmap aligned to business priorities, budgets, and Project Atlas (SAP S/4HANA) timelines; translate strategy into funded programs with clear milestones and KPIs.
  • Establish a portfolio management cadence: intake, prioritization, capacity planning, delivery tracking, realization; chair monthly Infra Portfolio Reviews with stakeholders.
  • Own the infrastructure operating model (Group/Cluster/Station): RACI, standards, service definitions, SLAs, and escalation paths.
  • Drive cost optimization (licenses, links, datacenter footprint, cloud consumption) while protecting availability, performance, and security.

Program & project management

  • Act as overall program owner for infrastructure initiatives (e.g., network refresh, WAN/SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, datacenter/server virtualization, M365/endpoint modernization, backup/DR, cloud migrations, connectivity/Starlink or backup links).
  • Institutionalize PMO discipline: business cases, charters, RAID logs, change control, stage gates, stakeholder comms, and post-implementation reviews.
  • Standardize project artifacts and ensure every project has scope, timeline, budget, resourcing plan, risks/mitigations, and measurable outcomes.

Operations & service reliability

  • Ensure high availability and performance for network, servers, storage, voice/data, collaboration, and site connectivity across all stations; own incident, problem, capacity, and change management practices.
  • Define and monitor SLA targets (uptime, MTTR, change success rate, backup success, patch compliance) and publish monthly scorecards.
  • Maintain DR/BCP readiness through tested recovery runbooks, defined RPO/RTO targets and periodic end-to-end exercises aligned with business criticality; own and drive infrastructure resilience and DR remediation plans resulting from audits, incidents and risk assessments.

Cybersecurity program (co-ownership with Cybersecurity Manager)

  • Execute the cybersecurity roadmap: hardening baselines, identity & access, endpoint protection/EDR, patching, vulnerability management, email security, logging/SIEM, and awareness.
  • Ensure stations implement required controls; track closure of findings, and report on cybersecurity KPIs and risk posture to SteerCo/EC.
  • Maintain secure configurations for firewalls, remote access, and network segmentation; enforce least privilege and separation of duties.

Architecture, standards & compliance

  • Own the Group identity, endpoint management and device governance framework, ensuring centralized management, appropriate administrative privileges, patching, configuration standards and security controls across corporate endpoints.
  • Own Group infrastructure standards (network, server, storage, cloud, endpoint, backup, monitoring) and lifecycle plans (EOL/EOS refresh).
  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies, vendor licensing, data protection, and applicable regulatory requirements across countries.

Vendor & budget management

  • Lead sourcing and performance management for ISPs, telco, hardware, software, MSPs, and OEMs; negotiate contracts and SLAs.
  • Own the infrastructure budget (OPEX/CAPEX), forecasts, and variance reporting; pursue TCO reduction through consolidation and right-sizing.

People leadership

  • Lead and develop Cluster IT Managers, IT Coordinators, and Field Support; build succession pipelines, coach performance, and foster a high-accountability culture.
  • Elevate managerial rigor: objectives/KPIs, 1:1s, quarterly talent reviews, and recognition for delivery excellence.

Qualifications & Skills


Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; master’s degree is a plus.
  • Bilingual: English and Spanish (mandatory).
  • Formal project management training required (e.g., PMP/Prince2, or equivalent). ITIL v4 Foundation preferred. Cloud/network/security certifications are a plus (e.g., CCNP, Azure/AWS associate, Fortinet/Palo Alto).

Experience

  • 12+ years progressive IT experience, ideally within multi-country operations in aviation, travel services, or food & beverage manufacturing/retail.
  • 8+ years leading complex infrastructure programs/projects (business cases, budgets, risk/issue management, scope/change control, benefits).
  • Proven success managing distributed teams and vendors across multiple countries and cultures, delivering to SLAs and budgets.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic Agility & Execution: Converts strategy into an actionable portfolio with clear KPIs; consistently ships on time and on budget.
  • Program/Project Leadership: Establishes governance, stage gates, RAID discipline, and stakeholder comms; unblocks delivery.
  • Service Reliability Mindset: Designs for availability, resilience, and observability; data-driven on SLAs and incident metrics.
  • Cybersecurity-by-Design: Implements controls and remediation in partnership with Cybersecurity; enforces standards and patch hygiene.
  • Vendor & Cost Management: Negotiates SLAs, optimizes TCO, and manages multi-vendor ecosystems effectively.
  • Influence & Communication (EN/ES): Fluent in English and Spanish; able to influence executives and align station managers to Group standards.
  • Analytical Problem Solving: Structures complex issues, uses data to decide, and drives root-cause corrective actions.
  • Ownership & Accountability: Takes end-to-end ownership for commitments and outcomes; proactively identifies roadblocks, escalates when required, and drives issues to resolution without transferring accountability to vendors, peers or other functions.

Travel requirements

The position requires regular domestic and international travel across GCG locations in Latin America and the Caribbean, based on project, operational, audit and business requirements.

Embark on a journey with us, where every day brings new opportunities for growth and success. If you thrive in a dynamic environment and want to be part of a team that celebrates achievements, come, be a part of our story. Your career adventure starts here!

Job Title:

Growth Marketing Manager

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Position Summary

As a Growth Marketing Manager on our B2B Marketing & Sales team, you’ll own the execution and optimization of integrated demand generation programs across organic, inbound, paid, and email channels. This remote role, based in the United States or Canada, is ideal for a data-driven marketer who understands the technical layer behind modern B2B growth — from SEO, AEO, GEO, and CRO to marketing automation, website performance, analytics, and AI-enabled execution.

You’ll report to the Director of Marketing Strategy, B2B, and work closely with performance analysts, content specialists, sales partners, GTM teams, digital advertising teams, and client-facing program leads to turn campaign strategy into measurable pipeline impact.

What you will do in this role

In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.

  • Plan and execute integrated demand generation programs across organic, inbound, paid, and email channels with clear pipeline objectives and KPIs at each funnel stage.
  • Develop go-to-market campaign programs, including audience segmentation, messaging frameworks, asset briefs, launch sequencing, and performance tracking.
  • Coordinate with digital advertising teams on paid social and search campaign strategy and briefing, bringing audience insight, messaging direction, and optimization recommendations.
  • Partner with sales and GTM teams on campaign launches by delivering briefing materials, demand signals, campaign updates, and performance insights they can act on.
  • Track organic social and thought leadership content as demand generation channels, monitoring engagement-to-pipeline contribution and feeding insights back to the content team.
  • Own organic search strategy, including keyword research, topic clustering, on-page optimization, and content gap analysis aligned to pipeline intent.
  • Build content and page structures optimized for AEO and GEO, helping content surface in AI-generated summaries, LLM citations, and conversational search results.
  • Monitor AI engine visibility alongside traditional search rankings and brief content teams on emerging gaps, trends, and opportunities.
  • Lead CRO across key landing pages and campaign pages by developing hypotheses, testing improvements, and implementing changes that move conversion metrics.
  • Manage form strategy, lead capture logic, and marketing automation workflows, including nurture sequences, lead scoring, lifecycle triggers, and CRM sync.
  • Maintain working knowledge of tag management, UTM architecture, site speed, and Core Web Vitals to diagnose issues and collaborate credibly with web and RevOps teams.
  • Use AI tools — including Claude and Microsoft Copilot — as a core part of planning, research, audience analysis, copy iteration, campaign briefing, workflow development, and reporting.
  • Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows that help the team work faster, improve quality, and increase output capacity over time.
  • Translate campaign briefs into live programs, surface performance insights that sharpen future campaigns, and own your contribution to pipeline.

Your qualifications

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.

Concentrix is a great match if you:

  • Have 5–7 years of B2B demand generation or growth marketing experience, ideally in SaaS, technology, professional services, or a B2B marketing services environment.
  • Have demonstrated success owning and executing multi-channel demand generation programs with measurable pipeline impact.
  • Bring strong working knowledge of SEO fundamentals, plus practical experience with AEO and GEO as emerging visibility channels.
  • Are proficient in at least one major marketing automation platform, such as HubSpot or Marketo, including workflow building, lead scoring, segmentation, and reporting.
  • Have hands-on experience using tools such as LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Looker, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Claude, and Microsoft Copilot.
  • Understand technical marketing concepts such as GTM, UTM frameworks, form logic, tracking QA, and basic web performance.
  • Are analytical and data-driven, with the ability to define success before launch, measure rigorously, and use results to guide the next decision.
  • Bring an experimentation mindset — you test, document, scale what works, and move quickly from what does not.
  • Have demonstrated experience shipping work with AI tools as a productivity and quality multiplier.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently, whether writing a sharp campaign brief, a senior stakeholder update, or a structured performance report.
  • Are comfortable working in a high-level client-facing environment with occasional travel for client or team offsites.
  • Thrive in a role that values speed, rigor, creativity, ownership, and measurable outcomes.

It will be a plus if you:

  • Have experience working in an agency, embedded contractor, or multi-client environment while managing concurrent programs.
  • Have hands-on experience building or refining ABM programs, including account selection, intent signal integration, and personalized campaign orchestration.
  • Are familiar with intent data platforms such as 6sense, Bombora, Clay, or equivalent tools, and know how to operationalize signals in campaign targeting and sales handoff.
  • Have experience briefing or managing paid media campaigns across LinkedIn and Google, including knowing what makes a strong brief and how to interpret performance data.
  • Are comfortable building process in ambiguous environments — writing the playbook while running the play.

What's in it for you

We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW.

In this role, we offer benefits that help support your unique lifestyle:


The base salary range for this position is $86,000 - $97,000 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

Darkroom is hiring an Associate Director of Creator, Social Commerce to drive our content and influencer strategy across client campaigns. Reporting to the Managing Director of Social Commerce, this is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who lives at the intersection of creative and performance - building influencer relationships, shaping the content that goes to market, and using data to make it work harder.

You’ll own the relationships with creators and influencers who bring our clients’ brands to life, and you’ll translate performance signals into sharper hooks, briefs, and content direction. This is a hands-on role: less about running a team, more about being the person who knows what content is working, why, and what to make next.

You’ll partner closely with the Directors of Strategy, Media Buying, and Creative to ensure content and influencer output is aligned with brand goals, platform best practices, and campaign performance targets.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone (9-5) and all business is conducted 100% in English.

  • Content Strategy: Own content initiatives across client campaigns — shaping what gets made, testing new formats and angles, and keeping content aligned with brand goals and platform best practices.

  • Hook & Brief Development: Write and iterate on hooks and creative briefs, translating what you see in the data into clearer, sharper direction for creators and the creative team.

  • Data-Driven Optimization: Analyze content and campaign performance to identify what’s working and why, then feed those insights back into briefs, hooks, and content direction.

  • Creative Collaboration: Partner with Strategy, Media Buying, and Creative to align content and influencer output with client objectives and campaign timelines.

  • Performance Reporting: Report on content performance, influencer contribution, and creative quality trends using structured KPIs and platform data.

  • Trend & Platform Fluency: Stay ahead of platform trends, emerging formats, and creator behavior, bringing fresh ideas that keep client content competitive.

  • 4+ years of relevant experience in content strategy, influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or social commerce.

  • Proven track record building and managing influencer/creator relationships and sourcing partners who deliver high-performing content.

  • Strong content instincts paired with a performance mindset — you can write a hook, read the data behind it, and know what to change.

  • Comfortable working with performance data to inform creative decisions; you treat content as something to test, measure, and improve.

  • Deep fluency in social platforms (TikTok, Instagram, and emerging channels), current formats, and creator behavior.

  • Proficient with influencer/creator sourcing and tracking tools (e.g., TikTok Creator Marketplace, UpPromote, or similar CRM platforms).

  • Highly self-directed — this is an individual-contributor role that owns outcomes without a team underneath it.

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

Compensation:

The base salary range for this role is $90K to $100K/per year. This range represents the anticipated minimum and maximum for this position and applies to candidates based in New York, including New York City, in compliance with the New York State Pay Transparency Law and the New York City Salary Transparency Law. Description

Dragonfli Group is a cybersecurity and IT consulting firm providing services to federal agencies and Fortune 100 enterprises. Headquartered in Washington, DC, Dragonfli supports clients in securing mission-critical systems across on-site, hybrid, and fully remote environments.

Dragonfli Group is seeking a Mid-Level Penetration Tester to join a consolidated enterprise Penetration Testing program supporting a large federal agency. You will also support validation of CISA WAS and FAST findings, KEV exposure items, and coordinate retesting to confirm closure, using approved AI-enabled tools to improve reconnaissance and ATT&CK/ATLAS mapping while maintaining human oversight. This role calls for approximately 5 to 8 years of relevant experience leading or independently executing penetration testing engagements.

This is a multi-year contract position involving a large US federal agency. Candidates with previous federal contracting experience are preferred. U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residency is required. If hired, all work related to this role must be performed within the continental U.S.

  • Support validation of CISA WAS, CISA FAST, KEV exposure, and external-facing asset findings, and coordinate retesting to confirm closure.

Bei TE Connectivity geben wir Ihnen Raum zur beruflichen Entfaltung, und die Möglichkeit über Länder und Kulturen hinweg mit Kollegen zusammenzuarbeiten, mit dem Ziel eine sicherere, nachhaltige, produktive und vernetzte Zukunft zu gestalten.

Jobübersicht

Die Industrial Business Unit von TE Connectivity sucht einen Global Product Manager (m/w/d), der die Strategie, Innovations-Roadmap und die geschäftliche Performance des Portfolios für Board Connectors & Industrial Interconnect Systems vorantreibt. In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie die globale Verantwortung für zugewiesene Produktlinien - definieren die strategische Ausrichtung, gestalten Wachstumsprogramme und ermöglichen die Umsetzung in einer globalen Matrix aus Engineering-, Sales-, Operations-, Finance- und regionalen Produktmanagement-Teams.

Diese Position erfordert eine ausgeprägte strategische Denkweise, tiefes Kunden- und Marktverständnis sowie die kommerzielle Disziplin, das Portfolio durch die Einführung neuer Produkte, exzellente Go-to-Market-Strategien und die Expansion in angrenzende Anwendungen zu skalieren. Sie managen den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus und sind direkt verantwortlich für Umsatzwachstum, Margensteigerung, Wettbewerbsfähigkeit des Portfolios und operative Leistung.

Sie überzeugen durch Einflussnahme, indem Sie funktionsübergreifende Teams mobilisieren, globale Abstimmung schaffen und Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten und Kunden-Insights vorantreiben. Dies ist eine hochsichtbare, wirkungsvolle Rolle im Zentrum der strategischen Agenda von TE Industrial.

Stellenanforderungen

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer umfassenden globalen Portfoliostrategie zur nachhaltigen Umsatz- und Margensteigerung in Schlüsselmärkten
  • Identifizierung von Durchbruchmöglichkeiten (neue Anwendungen, Plattformen, Technologien, Geschäftsmodelle und gezielte M&A-Chancen), die die Wettbewerbsposition von TE stärken
  • Übersetzung von Markttrends, Kundenbedürfnissen, Technologieveränderungen, regulatorischen Änderungen und Wettbewerbsaktivitäten in klare strategische Maßnahmen
  • Aufbau und Pflege von Produkt- und Technologie-Roadmaps in Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering, Sales und Operations, um TE in bestehenden und neuen Segmenten erfolgreich zu positionieren
  • Leitung von VOC- und Anwendungs-Insight-Programmen zur Entwicklung differenzierter Produktvorschläge und zur Steuerung von Investitionsentscheidungen
  • Unterstützung strategischer Partnerschaften und M&A-Aktivitäten, einschließlich Zielanalyse, strategischer Begründung, Markt-/Portfolio-Fit-Bewertungen sowie Post-Merger-Integration mit Fokus auf Portfolioharmonisierung, Produktlinienkonsolidierung und Roadmap-Ausrichtung
  • Definition von Ressourcenanforderungen und Führung der globalen Preisstrategie, einschließlich wertbasierter Preisgestaltung, Rabatt-Governance und Margenoptimierung, bei gleichzeitiger Sicherstellung konsistenter Umsetzung, kommerzieller Bereitschaft und lokaler Marktreaktionsfähigkeit
  • Übernahme der vollständigen P&L-Verantwortung für globale Produktlinien, Erzielung von überdurchschnittlichem Wachstum durch NPI-Adoption, Kundendesign-Gewinne und Marktanteilssteigerungen in Zielsegmenten
  • Überwachung der Performance im Vergleich zum Jahres- und Langfristplan, Risikomanagement und Schaffung von Wettbewerbsvorteilen durch Produktdifferenzierung, operative Effizienz und strategisches Kostenmanagement

Was Sie mitbringen sollten:

  • Bachelor-Abschluss in Ingenieurwesen oder Wirtschaft; MBA oder gleichwertige Erfahrung in P&L-Verantwortung bevorzugt
  • 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in Produktmanagement, Strategie, Business Development oder vergleichbaren Bereichen innerhalb der industriellen Technologie oder angrenzender Märkte
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge in Portfoliostrategie, Lifecycle-Management, Roadmap-Erstellung und Identifizierung von Produktlücken
  • Erfolgsbilanz bei Umsatzwachstum, Kostenoptimierung und Margenverbesserung
  • Erfahrung in industriellen Märkten bevorzugt (Geräte, Steckverbinder, elektromechanische Komponenten, industrielle Automatisierung etc.)
  • Ausgeprägte finanzielle und quantitative Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Insights abzuleiten und disziplinierte Entscheidungen zu treffen
  • Reisebereitschaft bis zu 25% weltweit
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse erforderlich

Kompetenzen

Werte: Integrität, Verantwortlichkeit, Inklusion, Innovation, Teamarbeit

ÜBER TE CONNECTIVITY

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) ist ein weltweit führendes Industrie- und Technologieunternehmen, das eine sicherere, nachhaltige, produktive und vernetzte Zukunft ermöglicht. Als verlässlicher Innovationspartner entwickelt TE Konnektivitäts- und Sensorlösungen, die die Verteilung und Übertragung von Strom, Signalen und Daten unterstützen und Innovationen in den Bereichen Transport der nächsten Generation, Stromnetze, industrielle Automatisierung, KI-Rechenzentren und vieles mehr vorantreiben. Mit mehr als 90.000 Mitarbeitenden, darunter 10.000 Ingenieurinnen und Ingenieure, arbeitet TE Seite an Seite mit Kundinnen und Kunden in rund 130 Ländern zusammen. In einer Welt, die sich rasant weiterentwickelt, bleibt TE seinem Leitsatz treu: EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Erfahren Sie mehr auf und auf LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram und X (ehemals Twitter).

Was TE Connectivity anbietet:

Wir freuen uns Ihnen ein spannendes Gesamtpaket anbieten zu können, das auch flexibel auf sich wechselnde Lebenssituationen angepasst werden kann – das Wohlbefinden unserer Mitarbeiter steht an oberster Stelle!

  • Attraktives Gehaltspaket
  • Leistungsorientiere Bonuspläne
  • Sport- und Fitnessangebote
  • TE-Aktienkaufprogramm
  • Lokale gemeinnützige Aktionen
  • TE-interne Interessensgruppen (z.B. „Women in Networking“)
  • Gelebte Inklusion und Diversität

Wichtiger Hinweis bezüglich Betrug im Bereich Rekrutierung:

TE Connectivity ist auf betrügerische Rekrutierungsaktivitäten von Personen oder Organisationen aufmerksam geworden, die fälschlicherweise behaupten, TE Connectivity zu vertreten.
Bitte beachten Sie, dass TE Connectivity in keiner Phase von Bewerbungen Zahlungen oder Gebühren von Bewerbern verlangt.

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

Abridge is expanding beyond physicians and into broader care team workflows, and Nursing is one of Abridge’s most important new product areas. Nurses carry a large share of documentation and care coordination, especially in inpatient and ED settings. Their workflows involve frequent handoffs, fragmented data, and significant administrative load.

As PM Lead for Nursing, you will own the nursing journey end to end. You will lead discovery with nurses and nursing leaders, set product strategy, and work closely with engineering, design, clinical science, machine learning, and customer teams to build experiences that nurses return to throughout their shifts. The opportunity is to combine conversations, longitudinal chart context, and explicit nurse direction to help nurses understand their patients, document efficiently, coordinate care, and get work done.

You will shape the end-to-end Nursing experience across Abridge surfaces and EHR integrations and partner closely with clinical experts, engineering, design, and health system leaders.

This is a hybrid role, with a preference for this PM to be based out of NYC, but open to SF.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead Nursing product strategy and discovery. Define the product vision and roadmap for Nursing across inpatient, ED, and ambulatory use cases. Identify and prioritize workflows that create real time time savings, operational ROI, and measurable impact for health systems.

Conduct deep user research with nurses, nurse managers, and CNIOs to understand documentation patterns, care coordination gaps, and device-specific workflows. Test hypotheses quickly and iterate based on adoption, retention, and perceived time savings.

  • Deliver high quality Nursing workflows. Partner with engineering and design to build intuitive and reliable documentation and handoff experiences across mobile, desktop, and EHR surfaces. Support workflows like many-to-one documentation, team-based notes, carry-forward, and handoff summaries.

  • Integrate deeply with EHR and enterprise environments. Work across Epic, Cerner, and Meditech workflows to ensure we meet table stakes expectations and can scale nursing adoption inside large hospital systems. Ensure data and context flows align with our broader strategy of leveraging clinical context to create defensible value.

  • Define success and measure impact. Establish KPIs such as time saved per shift, documentation completeness, task throughput, and workflow adoption. Build a clear path to monetization and demonstrate early value through design partners and beta deployments.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience with 0 to 1 ownership in a complex domain.

  • Strong ability to understand and design for highly variable workflows across settings and roles.

  • Experience partnering closely with engineering, design, and ML teams

  • Ability to translate strategic goals into clear product decisions, sequencing, and measurable outcomes.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure where little exists.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, especially with clinical audiences.

Bonus Points If…

  • Experience working with clinical SMEs, and health system stakeholders.

  • You have worked directly with nursing, inpatient, or ED operational workflows.

  • You have experience with Electronic Health Records like Epic, Cerner, Meditech.

  • You have built productivity tools, workflow automation, or ambient intelligence products.

  • You have worked in health systems, health IT, or clinical operations roles.

  • You have hands-on experience shipping products that deliver measurable operational or financial ROI in healthcare.

What We’re Looking For

  • We are looking for a candidate who is a “consumer / user PM” with a B2B background

    • Reference: Peter Deng’s five types of PMs (link)

  • Key specific competencies for success in nursing include:

    • Deep user empathy + product taste [rationale: experience is the #1 risk in nursing]

    • Track record to execute on complex, cross-functional initiatives to deliver outcomes [rationale: alignment with inpatient, managing Epic dependencies]

    • Ability to synthesize complex and sometimes conflicting information (from market context to engagement data) to define roadmap [rationale: important to be able to cut through multiple factors, e.g. commercial / business context; team has, in the past, gotten stuck in the dynamics of Mayo + Epic]

    • Grit + resilience [rationale: building nursing is hard]

  • Candidates don't necessarily need to spike on nursing/healthcare expertise or insane technical depth (e.g. uthat of a research/platform PM). These can all be coached by leadership for someone with a growth mindset, or supported by engineering

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

Obsidian Security is a global leader in cyber security protecting the SaaS and non-human identity layer modern enterprises run on — from Salesforce and Snowflake to the AI agents now deployed inside them. The Obsidian Security platform gives unified visibility into every human and machine identity, app, and integration across their SaaS estate, detects identity-based and supply chain attacks in real time, and enforces least-privilege access before it's exploited. Trusted by major Fortune 500 companies T-Mobile, Workday, Snowflake, and S&P Global, Obsidian ranked No. 95 on the 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™, growing nearly 1000% from 2021–2024 — helping CISOs turn an unmonitored attack surface into one they can govern with confidence. Obsidian has also been recognized by Forbes as America's Best Startup Employers in 2026.

In August 2026, Obsidian raised $85 million in Series D financing led by Crescent Cove Advisors, with participation from existing investors including Greylock Partners, Menlo Ventures, Norwest Venture Partners, IVP, Wing Ventures, and GV — pushing Obsidian's valuation to $1.1 billion, crossing into unicorn status. Obsidian is using the funding to deepen its R&D in agentic AI security and extend its platform as the standard for governing what AI agents can access and do inside third-party applications.

With global momentum, a growing partner ecosystem including SentinelOne, Databricks, and Google Cloud, and fresh capital from its Series D behind it, Obsidian is scaling rapidly toward long-term growth and IPO readiness.

You'll be responsible for developing and executing against a comprehensive account/territory plan whilst working collaboratively with our internal and external resources. This is a 100% remote role with preference for candidates located in the Greater London Metro.

  • Align with our partners and alliances to optimize opportunities
  • Partner with internal resources across Sales Engineering, Customer Success and Professional Services
  • Demonstrate accurate pipeline forecasting and management
  • Actively participate in our sales enablement training

About You:

  • 5+ years of enterprise sales experience
  • Working knowledge of sales concepts, methods and techniques
  • Experience evangelizing new technology into large enterprise accounts.
  • Able to maintain and manage existing client relationships and accounts.
  • Able to utilize existing client and/or C-Level relationships, as well as build new relationships across IT Security as well as other lines of business.

  • Strong ability to understand a customer's business issues and needs and be able to articulate and map back value to a solution.
  • Strong prospecting skills, deal qualification, and POV management skills, leading to acquisition of new business.
  • Team player with the ability to collaborate well with internal stakeholders or partners to drive opportunities to closure.

jobs.excerpt: As a forward-deployed engineer, you’ll work on-site with customers — writing code, integrating systems, and solving hard problems in the field.
jobs.description:
As a forward-deployed engineer, you’ll work on-site with customers — writing code, integrating systems, and solving hard problems in the field. You’re part engineer, part technical advisor, and wholly accountable for making the mission succeed. The position requires a current or active U.S. Secret clearance.

Spear AI is a growing defense contracting company dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions that support our nation’s security. As we expand, we’re building a culture where innovation meets mission-critical work. We operate with a flat organizational structure that empowers every team member to make an impact, collaborate directly with leadership, and contribute to projects that matter. Whether you’re joining our Hardware, Software, or Services division, you’ll work alongside talented professionals who are committed to excellence and advancing the capabilities that keep our nation safe and secure.

Spear AI builds sonobuoy sensors that are deployed into the water and collect edge data. We also work with the U.S. Navy to collect and process their SONAR data. You’ll have an opportunity to work on real-world projects that directly impact warfighter capabilities and mission success.

What you’ll do

We’re a small team wearing many hats, and you’d have a wide variety of responsibilities that include:

  • Design and implement cloud architecture.

  • Develop Infrastructure as Code using Pulumi.

  • Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD and DevSecOps pipelines.

  • Continuously deploy to AWS cloud and air-gapped environments.

  • Monitor applications/services with OpenTelemetry, Sentry, and SigNoz.

  • Enforce CMMC compliance policies and rules.

  • Manage secrets and configuration.

  • Deploy, configure, and troubleshoot infrastructure within customer and air-gapped environments.

  • Support RHEL/Linux-based platforms using Kubernetes, Podman, Docker, and Helm in operational environments.

  • Partner directly with customer engineering teams to integrate, test, and resolve infrastructure issues.

  • Travel to customer sites as needed to support deployments, upgrades, and mission execution.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone with strong Software Engineering skills who shares our most important values:

  • You’re fanatical about polish. Every detail matters. You love to make sure your code is linted, formatted, fully typed, and has 100% test coverage.

  • You care about correctness. You take pride in the fact that downstream consumers trust libraries and services you build.

  • You obsess over performance. You daydream about Lighthouse scores and query speed.

  • You dive deep. It’s important for you to really know how things work. You’re always building prototypes and setting up experiments to reinforce your understanding.

  • You live on the bleeding edge. You’ve got a long list of upcoming platform features you’re excited about and can’t wait for the next nightly to drop.

  • You’re a great teacher. You know how to break down a concept for a specific audience and make it click with them in a way that gets them excited.

Why work with us

  • We ship — We don’t work on 18-month projects that are irrelevant before they’re even finished.

  • Our work has impact — We build products that are deployed to U.S. submarines and integrate with the sonobuoys we manufacture.

  • We’re growing responsibly — We have the resources to hire a lot more people, but we don’t want to build a massive team of people who don’t share our values.

  • We’re profitable — We aren’t burning through cash trying to make the business work. But we also have investors who believe in us and are committed to our success.

  • We care about doing great work — You don’t need permission to sweat the details here.

  • We don’t take ourselves too seriously — We’re building products that make the world safer. But we don’t let that get to our heads.

Important skills

  • Expert in Infrastructure as Code using Pulumi or Terraform.

  • Expert in Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Linux system administration, and Podman.

  • Experience deploying and managing containerized environments using Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and Podman.

  • Expert in CI/CD and DevSecOps, including GitLab CI/CD and GitHub Actions.

  • Proficiency in AWS and/or other cloud services.

  • Experience with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, Go, or TypeScript.

  • Proficiency with networking.

  • Familiar with cybersecurity compliance frameworks like CMMC, PCI, or SOC.

  • Familiar with Single Sign-on and Identity Providers (IdP) like Authentik and Keycloak.

  • Experience deploying to air-gapped environments.

  • Experience self-hosting on bare metal servers.

  • Active Secret clearance required

Nice to have

· Experience supporting classified DoD or Navy environments.

· Experience deploying infrastructure into air-gapped environments.

· Familiarity with observability tools such as OpenTelemetry, Sentry, or SigNoz.

· Experience supporting edge computing, maritime systems, or sensor platforms.

· Experience with AWS GovCloud or other secure cloud environments.

· Experience working directly with government customers in operational environments.

What we offer

  • Unlimited PTO — Take the time you need to recharge and maintain work-life balance.

  • Dedicated sick time — Your health and well-being come first.

  • Comprehensive health and benefits – Medical, dental, and vision coverage to keep you and your family protected.

  • 11 Paid Holidays — Enjoy time off throughout the year to celebrate and spend time with loved ones.

  • Professional development — Educational opportunities and resources to help you grow your skills and advance your career.

  • Collaborative environment — Work directly with leadership in our flat organizational structure, where your ideas and contributions matter.

  • Mission-driven work — Contribute to projects that directly support national security and make a real-world impact.

  • Growth opportunities — Join us during an exciting expansion phase where you can help shape our future.

Additional benefit opportunities when you choose Spear AI:

  • 401(k) with company match.

  • Onsite / Remote / Flexible work arrangements or hybrid options (position dependent).

  • Relocation assistance (position dependent).

  • Referral bonuses.

  • Performance bonuses.

  • Life insurance and disability coverage.

  • Technology home office setup stipend.

  • Professional certification reimbursement (position dependent).

We offer competitive compensation tailored to your experience, location, and the impact you’ll make. We’re committed to equitable pay and will share a range aligned to your level and geography during the hiring process. In accordance with state law, candidates in jurisdictions such as CA, CO, WA, NY, and others, where applicable, will be provided a good-faith salary range upon request and throughout the hiring process. This is a full-time, exempt position under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and is not eligible for overtime pay.

Compensation for this position is provided on a salaried basis and is not subject to reduction based on hours worked. At Spear AI, you’ll find more than just a job; you’ll join a mission-driven team where your work directly contributes to national security. Our flat organizational structure means your voice matters, your ideas reach leadership, and your impact is visible. As we grow, we’re committed to building robust processes and infrastructure that support both our mission and our people. We value collaboration, continuous improvement, and the expertise each team member brings to the table. If you’re looking for a place to grow professionally while working on projects that truly matter, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Title:Senior Ruby Developer

As a Senior Ruby Developer, you will help build our Ruby API powering our family of LGBTQ+ mobile dating apps. We are looking for engineers who are passionate about architecture and monads! What you'll do:

  • Build a modern API application atop a functional architecture in Ruby, Ruby on Rails, and/or Sinatra
  • Build well factored, maintainable, and tested code using RSpec with Test & Behavior Driven Development (TDD & BDD)
  • Prioritize well-architected code that is not only accelerated by AI, but also maintains strict architectural patterns and consistency
  • Help us advance our portfolio of architectural rules using RubyZen, our ruby architectural linter (see more about our approach to architectural linting on the client side, and watch some of our DroidCon videos)
  • Support our AWS infrastructure using the latest AWS DevOps tools and approaches like Terraform
  • Debug and diagnose production issues in the AWS console, Airbrake, Datadog, and Cloudwatch
  • Maintain a complex backend which processes more than 300 million web server requests per day
  • Have a strong sense of OO programming and Architectural patterns
  • Be able to work with, mentor, and guide a distributed team of developers
  • Team members will be expected to align to the working and pairing hours of their team in their respective regions. Our team writes code in pairs, and engineering teams screen-share with each other a minimum of 4 hours per day.
You can see more about our architectural approach to client and server-side engineering on our Engineering blog here.

Requirements

Timezone requirements:
  • Because we are a global, remote, distributed company, timezone alignment is critical
  • If you are EU-based, you must be available to work between 11am CET and 8pm CET (Winter) or 12pm CET and 9pm CET (Summer)
  • If you are Brasil-based, you must be available to work between 8am EST and 5pm EST
  • If you are North America-based, you must be available to work between 8am EST and 5pm EST
Candidates must:
  • Be available to collaborate between 9a EST and 1p EST, regardless of your present timezone.
  • Have experience working for remote, global teams
  • Be excited about and open to pair programming
  • Be open to learning languages outside their current server specialty, such as Swift, Kotlin, Python or JavaScript
Who you are:
  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in computer science, related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • 5+ years of software development experience using Ruby
  • 5+ years of devops (AWS or equivalent) experience
  • Experience using design and architecture patterns
  • Strong sense of ownership, ability to work independently, and proven track record of driving products
  • Shipped consumer API used concurrently by thousands of users.

Bonus if you have experience with:

  • Full stack knowledge of technologies like Ruby, SQL, Linux, React, and AWS would be highly desirable
  • Experience working with big data technologies and ETLs like Spark, S3, and Redshift
  • Experience with analytics platforms, CRM, and engagement platforms (e.g., Mixpanel, Amplitude, Moengage, Quicksight)
  • Advanced DevOps experience - Docker, k8s, linux/unix
  • Experience completing product iterations based on insights from data
  • Knowledge of Python, Scala, Spark, Athena, or Databricks
And one more thing...
We encourage all candidates to read this 60-second blog post, which we believe applies equally to job applications as it does to generated code. In addition, we spend a lot of time describing our technology and our approach on our Engineering Blog. If you want to impress us, take the time to read our blog posts, and let us know how what we've done compares to, or could have helped with, your experience. Given the volume of applications we read, the most impactful applications contain cover letters with specific examples, demonstrate understanding of the business in which we operate, and include updated and detailed LinkedIn profiles.

A 100% remote, 100% global team
