jobs.description:
Vaga 100% remota

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

Sensedia é uma multinacional brasileira provedora de plataforma de gerenciamento de APIs, governança de agentes e soluções de integração, além de serviços profissionais. A companhia impulsiona a transformação digital de grandes empresas habilitando arquiteturas mais ágeis, modernas e escaláveis, possibilitando assim que seus clientes ofereçam produtos e experiências digitais a todo o seu ecossistema.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.
Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Conheça + em nosso site:


Qual a missão do Cargo?

A missão dessa posição é desenhar e construir soluções de arquitetura que traduzam as necessidades de negócio dos clientes em soluções técnicas robustas, escaláveis e seguras, atuando desde o assessment e definição da arquitetura até o acompanhamento da implementação nas squads.

A pessoa também será responsável por apoiar diferentes projetos da BU HIRE, orientar clientes em decisões arquiteturais e promover o uso estratégico das soluções Sensedia, APIs, integrações, cloud e IA.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Conduzir assessments de arquitetura, entendendo o cenário atual, as necessidades do negócio e as dores dos clientes.
  • Desenhar arquiteturas de APIs, microsserviços, integrações e soluções orientadas a eventos.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas utilizando os produtos Sensedia e tecnologias de mercado.
  • Participar de workshops, discoveries e reuniões de decisão com públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Definir estratégias de segurança, governança, observabilidade, CI/CD e implantação.
  • Apoiar as squads durante a implementação, revisando códigos, contratos de APIs e configurações de gateway.
  • Elaborar diagramas, ADRs, roadmaps e guias técnicos.
  • Antecipar riscos, avaliar trade-offs e acompanhar as soluções até a entrada em produção.
  • Desenhar soluções envolvendo IA, AI Gateway, LLMs e arquiteturas agênticas.
  • Apoiar pré-vendas, RFPs e provas de conceito.
  • Compartilhar conhecimento e apoiar o desenvolvimento de profissionais mais juniores.
  • Atuar em diferentes projetos da BU.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Experiência sólida em tecnologia, com atuação consistente em arquitetura de soluções e projetos de integração.
  • Domínio do desenho e do ciclo de vida de APIs REST, incluindo OpenAPI, contratos, versionamento, paginação, idempotência e tratamento de erros.
  • Experiência prática com plataformas de API Management ou API Gateway, como Sensedia, Apigee, Kong, AWS API Gateway, Azure API Management ou WSO2.
  • Conhecimento aplicado de arquitetura de microsserviços e padrões de integração.
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos e mensageria, como Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS/SNS ou Pub/Sub.
  • Conhecimento em segurança de APIs e identidade: OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, TLS/mTLS e gestão de segredos.
  • Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes, incluindo operação e troubleshooting.
  • Domínio de pelo menos um provedor de cloud: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Conhecimento em ao menos uma linguagem backend, como Java, Kotlin, Go, Node.js, Python ou C#.
  • Experiência na condução de assessments, workshops, discoveries e conversas técnicas com clientes.
  • Capacidade de traduzir decisões técnicas para públicos técnicos e de negócio.
  • Entendimento funcional de LLMs, soluções de IA e arquiteturas agênticas.
  • Conhecimento dos principais riscos de segurança em IA, como prompt injection, vazamento de dados e autorização excessiva de agentes.
  • Uso fluente e crítico de assistentes de IA no trabalho de engenharia e arquitetura.
  • Comunicação clara, postura consultiva, autonomia, proatividade e senso de dono.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens pontuais a clientes.

Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

  • Experiência com Open Finance, Open Insurance ou outros ambientes regulados de compartilhamento de dados.
  • Vivência em modernização de sistemas legados, decomposição de monólitos, Strangler Pattern e descomissionamento de ESB/EAI.
  • Conhecimento em Infrastructure as Code e GitOps, utilizando Terraform, Helm ou Pulumi.
  • Experiência com observabilidade, utilizando OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog ou Dynatrace.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de dados, CDC, data streaming e event sourcing.
  • Certificações AWS, Azure, GCP Architect, CKA, TOGAF ou de plataformas de API Management.
  • Experiência com pré-vendas, RFPs, provas de conceito e elaboração de propostas técnicas.
  • Vivência com AI Gateway ou LLM Gateway, incluindo roteamento de modelos, quotas por token, cache semântico, observabilidade e controle de custos.
  • Experiência com RAG e sistemas multiagentes em produção.
  • Conhecimento em LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel ou Spring AI.
  • Conhecimento de FinOps e otimização de custos de arquitetura.
  • Participação ativa na comunidade técnica por meio de palestras, artigos, eventos ou projetos open source.
  • Experiência orientando profissionais de arquitetura e desenvolvimento menos experientes.

Aqui você vai encontrar:

  • Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.

  • Temos #WorkWhereYouBelong como proposta de valor, que é um modelo flexível de trabalho que nos ajuda a aumentar o senso de pertencimento dos Sensediers.
    Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.

Esta oportunidade também é para PCD! ;)

Suas experiências são compatíveis? Se candidate e venha conhecer a maior referência de APIs no Brasil! Queremos você em nossa equipe!!

  • Pensando em promover times cada vez mais diversos e ambientes de trabalho plurais, nossa missão é mapear os diferentes públicos que alcançamos com ele! Por isso, faremos algumas perguntinhas relacionadas à diversidade*, tudo bem? =)
*Os dados pessoais e dados pessoais sensíveis coletados serão tratados de acordo com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados - Lei n° 13.709/2018

jobs.title: Visual Content Specialist
jobs.excerpt: ROLE SUMMARYThe Visual Strategist & Content Manager owns Mindful Souls' creator content engine end to end — from the first script idea tied to a hero product, through sourcing and vetting the talent who bring it to life, to the contract, shipment, and invoice that close out the collaboration.
jobs.description:
ROLE SUMMARY

The Visual Strategist & Content Manager owns Mindful Souls' creator content engine end to end — from the first script

idea tied to a hero product, through sourcing and vetting the talent who bring it to life, to the contract, shipment, and

invoice that close out the collaboration. This role sits at the intersection of creative strategy and creator-economy

operations: equal parts copywriter, talent buyer, and program manager. It is the internal owner of every piece of

creator-made Paid Ad content for Mindful Souls across its subscription boxes and single-item product lines.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Creative Strategy & Script Development

  • Write scripts and hook concepts tailored to Mindful Souls' current focus products, spanning both subscription

boxes and single-item SKUs.

  • Translate active promotions, seasonal moments, and product priorities into creator-ready content angles and

briefs.

  • Maintain fluency in current short-form platform trends and hook conventions (TikTok/Meta) so scripts stay

native to what's performing, not dated to what worked last quarter.

Talent Sourcing, Vetting & Pipeline Growth

  • Source and onboard 4–7 new creators per month, in addition to maintaining the existing active creator pool for

a total of 8-12 creators per month.

  • Vet potential new creators through unpaid/gifted product partnerships to confirm brand alignment before

extending any paid opportunity.

  • Graduate top-performing gifted creators into the paid creator database once alignment and content quality are

proven.

  • Nurture creator relationships over time to support repeat, high-performing collaborations rather than one-off

content.

  • Evaluate and prioritize creators on engagement quality, audience fit, and content-to-conversion potential —

not follower count alone.

Contracts, Negotiation & Rights Management

  • Negotiate content deliverables, pricing and usage rights on a per-creator, per-collaboration basis.
  • Draft, send, and manage monthly retainer agreements for ongoing creators via PandaDoc (written agreement

via email is also ok with clear consent)

  • Structure and defend compensation consistently across flat-fee, commission, and hybrid deal types depending

on creator tier and deliverable scope.

Production Management & Creator Operations

  • Create content briefs and brand/content guidelines for every collaboration.
  • Manage product shipping, timing, and content delivery ETAs across the full active creator roster.
  • Track deliverables against deadlines and follow up to keep the content pipeline moving on schedule.

Budget & Financial Administration

  • Manage invoicing and payment processing for all creator partnerships.
  • Track budgets spend against the monthly influencer/content budget, keeping actuals at or below plan.
  • Report on cost-per-content-piece and cost-per-creator to inform ongoing budget and roster decisionson a

monthly basis,

Requirements

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong short-form scriptwriting and copywriting ability, grounded in current social hook and storytelling

formats.

  • Negotiation experience covering rates, deliverable scope, and usage rights.
  • Proven organizational and project-management skills able to run a multi-creator pipeline against concurrent

deadlines.

  • Working proficiency with contract/e-signature tools (PandaDoc or equivalent).
  • Comfort with budget tracking, invoicing, and basic financial reconciliation.
  • Relationship-management instincts — creators experience this role as a partner, not a vendor manager,

meaning managing potential needs for revisions and redo’s if the content is not meeting the requirements

outlined in the brief/content guidelines, while not impacting the flat fee or long-term relationship.

  • Working knowledge of reading performance data beyond follower counts.
  • Active awareness of platform algorithm shifts and emerging content trends across TikTok and Instagram.

TOOLS & PLATFORMS

  • PandaDoc — creator contracts and monthly retainer agreements
  • Invoicing / payment processing tools for creator payouts
  • Shipping and logistics tracking for product-to-creator fulfilment
  • Affiliate/attribution tracking and shop analytics (e.g., TikTok Shop) — increasingly standard for tying creator

content to revenue rather than reach.

SUCCESS METRICS

  • Minimum KPI: 7–12 content projects delivered per month, sourced from 4–7 newly onboarded creators plus

the maintained current creator roster

  • Monthly influencer/content spend at or below approved budget
  • On-time content delivery against agreed ETAs across the active ad deadlines.
  • Conversion rate of gifted/vetted creators into the paid retainer database
  • Revenue or conversion performance per creator/content piece, tracked alongside — not instead of —

engagement and brand-fit quality.

jobs.excerpt: Role: Director of Product, EdTech Team: Product Reports to: VP, Product Location: Flexible (Fully-Remote or Hybrid | Offices in NYC and Miami) WHO WE ARE The ASU+GSV Summit Now in its 18th year, the ASU+GSV Summit is the world's most important gathering of “PreK to Gray” education and workforce leaders.
jobs.description:
Role: Director of Product, EdTech
Team: Product
Reports to: VP, Product
Location: Flexible (Fully-Remote or Hybrid | Offices in NYC and Miami)

WHO WE ARE

The ASU+GSV Summit
Now in its 18th year, the ASU+GSV Summit is the world's most important gathering of “PreK to Gray” education and workforce leaders. Held every April in San Diego, the 2026 event drew over 7,000 registrants to tackle the transformation of learning and skills delivery through generative AI, virtual reality, and other emerging technologies.
As of July 2025, GSV Summit became part of Hyve Group's portfolio, joining forces with Bett to create the largest and most impactful education innovation community in the world, now reaching an audience of over 100,000 participants across five events on four continents.

WHO IS THE PRODUCT TEAM?

The Product Team is the creative and strategic engine behind the ASU+GSV Summit experience. We design and deliver content that inspires action — each year we work with over 850+ speakers, curating high-production keynotes with global thought leaders to provocative panels and interactive workshops – and we build experiences that create the space and opportunities for truly transformational connections and conversations. Our team meets the moment by launching new stages like Multiple Choice in response to the growing conversation on education pluralism and building THE FORCE, a dedicated program and community space, in order to further our community growth with enterprise learning and talent leaders.
We sit at the intersection of marketing, partnerships, and community, collaborating with education leaders, practitioners, entrepreneurs, investors, policymakers, researchers, and thought leaders to shape the conversations and community experiences that matter most in “PreK to Gray” learning.
Our work is structured around three core verticals — PreK-12, Higher Education, and Workforce — but the real power is in what we call “the magic in the mix.” EdTech is the connective tissue across all three: it's where the innovation, investment, and company-building happen that shape every vertical. Program often develops across verticals, so every team member takes a collaborative approach. We lean in to build the right program for the right audience at the right time, staying agile to launch new programs and rethink existing ones as needed.
ROLE OVERVIEW
We're looking for a strategic, entrepreneurial Director of Product, EdTech to be GSV's core EdTech voice — owning the programs and relationships that put the global EdTech ecosystem at the center of the ASU+GSV Summit. This is a builder's role: part programming, part community, part company-building and investing, all in service of positioning GSV as the world leader in educational innovation.
You'll report to Lucy Baldwin, VP of Program, and act as her true partner on all things EdTech — while Lucy continues to be deeply engaged across the EdTech portfolio, this role owns the day-to-day execution and is expected to bring independent judgment, ideas, and follow-through.
You'll lead GSV Cup end-to-end, help scale GSV 150, curate and execute Star Track, as well as our Building & Investing stage and integrate EdTech programming across the PreK-12, Higher Ed, and Workforce verticals — including the founders, investors, and companies at the building and investing stage. You’re a true “company junkie” — one of the foremost minds and relationship-builders spanning early-stage, growth-stage, PE-backed, and public EdTech, as well as the investment side. You know who’s creating true market share and impact at scale today, and who the changemakers, breakout startups, and early-bet investors are — the “stars of tomorrow.””
The role blends product and program management, community building, and business development, requiring creativity, precision, and deep sector insight.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
As the Director of Product, EdTech, you will be responsible for:
Ecosystem Building & Relationship Management
  • Serve as GSV’s foremost connector across the global EdTech ecosystem — engaging daily with the founders, investors, operators, and policymakers shaping the industry, and ensuring GSV’s content and programming stay ahead of what’s next.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Product, and Community teams to position GSV as the thought leader and the premier platform for EdTech companies at all stages, from ideation to growth to IPO.
  • Work with the Community Team to engage, nurture, and grow the EdTech community year-round, using research and community insights to shape programming, sponsorship opportunities, and emerging topics.
Programming: GSV Cup, GSV 150 & StarTrack
  • Grow GSV 150's reach and representation across geographies and sectors, and increase EdTech representation across all programming to amplify the EdTech voice at Summit.
  • Learn the GSV150 formula and maintain the list accurately year-round; lead on annual announcement and surrounding marketing activities, including press release, personalized CEO invitations, GSV 150 market map creation, and social media campaigns.
  • Lead end-to-end GSV Cup and co-lead Star Track programming, from identifying and recruiting the most promising startups through seamless execution of GSV Demo Day.
  • Develop productization and sponsorship strategies to grow revenue across GSV Cup, GSV 150, and StarTrack — including receptions, list and sponsorship packages, media partnerships, and the Founders x Founders matching program.
  • Run the Community Events surrounding the Entrepreneur and Investor community, including the Entrepreneur & Investor Happy Hour and other events that connect founders with investors and build pipeline for the ASU+GSV brand.
  • Co-curate the EdTech Building and Investing stage — tracking emerging startups, funding rounds, and the investors backing them — to keep programming and partnerships ahead of the market.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for EdTech speakers, moderators, founders, investors, and partners — delivering exceptional service and responsiveness.
  • Streamline operations by automating registration, selection, and scheduling, and eliminate conflicts across overlapping EdTech sessions.
Product Development & Partnership Engagement
  • Co-curate and execute the EdTech program vision end-to-end — from idea generation through final session delivery — with exceptional documentation of session details and speaker logistics.
  • Identify, cultivate, and manage relationships with partners to strengthen EdTech programming, co-creating activations that drive partner value and revenue growth alongside the partnership team.
  • Develop new engagement opportunities — workshops, mentorship opportunities, regional meetups, and other high-engagement events — that build the ASU+GSV brand and pipeline into sponsorship.
Technology & Process Excellence
  • Use Airtable, Cvent, generative AI, and other tools to streamline workflows and enhance program delivery, and help test new technologies that improve efficiency and business outcomes.
  • Partner with the Product team to develop and improve edtech ecosystem knowledge mapping and building across the team.
WHO YOU ARE
Experience
  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Significant experience in the global EdTech industry — spanning startups, growth-stage companies, investing, or corporate EdTech — with AI in education experience strongly preferred. You bring the industry standing and stage presence to represent GSV publicly, including moderating high-profile programming such as Star Track.
  • Excellent networks in EdTech and education and a strong system for staying engaged and up to date with founder communities
  • Demonstrated success in product or program management, or driving revenue through strategic partnerships, or B2B sales in EdTech or adjacent sectors.
  • Familiarity with the growth and investing landscape — you understand how founders build and how investors evaluate opportunities at the earliest stages.
Skills & Qualities
  • EdTech Expertise: You have direct experience in or adjacent to the EdTech ecosystem — startups, investing, or company-building — and not only understand how it intersects with PreK-12, Higher Ed, and Workforce, but are driven by a deep intellectual curiosity for innovation.
  • Connector & Relationship Builder: You have a talent for building authentic relationships and connecting ideas to opportunity — especially in complex, cross-sector spaces. You're energized by collaborating with founders, investors, and leaders at all levels.
  • AI-obsessed: You bring deep curiosity about how AI is and will impact education and EdTech, and you're excited to explore emerging technologies with founders, investors, and thought leaders.
  • Strategic Thinking Meets Execution: You're both a big-picture thinker and a detail-oriented executor. You thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy toggling between high-level vision and practical execution.
  • Strong Communicator: You can synthesize complex ideas into crisp, compelling messaging — whether you're writing speaker invitations, crafting session descriptions, or pitching a new idea to a partner.
  • Entrepreneurial Energy: You approach ambiguity with optimism, creativity, and a bias toward action. You're energized by building, iterating, and moving fast to bring ideas to life — while staying organized and calm under pressure.
  • Collaborative & Curious: You're a skilled collaborator who values feedback, iteration, and cross-functional teamwork — and a true thought partner to the VP of Program. You're always learning, especially when it comes to AI, tech, and the evolving PreK to Gray landscape.
  • Tech-Forward & Tech-Savvy: You're facile with tools like Airtable, Cvent, Google Workspace, and AI-powered platforms that boost efficiency, creativity, and business outcomes.

This role requires a willingness to travel and work extended hours in the weeks leading up to the Summit, as well as supplemental travel throughout the year.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Telesales Team Lead to join our Retention team, as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets.


Role Overview

We're hiring Telesales Team Leads for our Customer Retention team in Nigeria, covering both our Inbound and Outbound functions. Every conversation your team has determines whether a customer stays in a financial product that's genuinely changing how they live and work.

About M-KOPA

M-KOPA has extended over $2 billion in credit to 10 million customers across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana, and South Africa. 86% of our customers report improved quality of life, and 55% are accessing formal financial services for the first time. We're scaling fast, and we need frontline leaders who can scale with us.

This is a hybrid role, you would be working from our offices in Nigeria, partnering with a diverse group of employees from our different markets and locations across the UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Customer Retention Manager.

What makes this different

This isn't a call center chasing volume for shareholders. You're protecting financial access for people building businesses and securing their families' futures, and you'll have real ownership over how your team performs, not just a script to enforce.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach, and mentor telesales agents across voice and non-voice channels (Freshdesk, Fresh Chat, social media, calls), and drive outbound teams to consistently hit sales, revenue, and conversion targets

  • Monitor performance against KPIs, sales volume, conversion rates, wait times, QA scores, CRM accuracy, daily, weekly, and monthly, addressing gaps proactively and conducting regular reviews with actionable goals

  • Collaborate cross-functionally across Inbound, Outbound, Growth, Product, Retail, and marketing teams to execute sales strategies, campaigns, and retention initiatives

  • Oversee sales and operations fulfilment, including delivery coordination between agents, DSRs, and retail teams, stock availability, and escalation of fulfilment risks

  • Ensure quality and compliance across all channels, managing call quality standards, resolving escalated customer issues, and identifying upselling opportunities during interactions

  • Use data analytics to spot customer interaction patterns and trends, and turn insights into recommendations for senior management.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, marketing, communications, or a related field

  • Demonstrated 2+ years of experience in leadership role either in telesales, customer service, or sales management, specializing in non-voice channels such as email, chat, or social media

  • Strong leadership and team management ability, with proficiency in CRM systems, telephony, and sales automation tools

  • Proven analytical skills, trend recognition, and data-informed decision-making.

The honest part
This role means managing live performance conversations while holding your team to standards that directly affect vulnerable customers, and depending on which function you lead, you may also be chasing deliveries, stock, and fulfilment alongside sales targets. Some days that's demanding. If you thrive on coaching people through pressure rather than just monitoring dashboards, this is built for you.

Ready to lead a team that actually changes lives? Let's talk.

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

The Support Project Manager (PM) ensures the shift runs without disruption. While the Senior PM owns the project end-to-end, the Support PM owns the shift. Keeping production flowing, tasks moving, and issues resolved within their assigned hours.

This role exists in two engagement tracks with distinct scopes of responsibility:

At Staff level, the PM applies foundational project management knowledge and skills to assigned tasks, with impact scoped to the individual task or shift rather than a full project. People management responsibility is limited to self. The role does not yet carry team leadership accountability. There is no financial or budget ownership at this level.

Freelance Support PM

  • Accountable for accurate, on-time completion of assigned tasks within the shift

  • Escalates blockers or issues to the in-house shift lead or SPM as appropriate

  • Does not carry shift lead authority or team-level escalation responsibility

  • Operates within a clearly defined task scope agreed upon per engagement

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Task Execution

  • Execute assigned PM support or coordination tasks accurately within the shift

  • Follow task briefs and guidelines provided by the SPM or in-house shift lead

  • Complete deliverables within agreed timelines and flag blockers proactively

  • Maintain clear task logs and update status as required

Escalation Handling

  • Freelance: Escalate blockers directly to the in-house shift lead or SPM as directed

  • Document escalations and resolutions for Senior PM visibility and audit trail

Quality Control Support

  • Support QC activities during the shift as needed for both tracks

  • Apply QC at the task level as directed; flag issues upward to shift lead

Communication & Coordination

  • Maintain clear communication with the Senior PM during and after the shift on all notable events

  • Provide task status updates to the shift lead or SPM as required

SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

Shift Operations & Task Management

  • Ability to manage multiple moving parts across a shift without losing visibility

  • Strong task prioritization and traffic management skills (In-House emphasis)

  • Familiarity with production workflows and task management tools

  • Comfortable working with urgency and maintaining composure under shift pressure

Communication & Coordination

  • Clear, professional written communication, particularly for handoff notes, shift logs, and escalation reports

  • Ability to relay information accurately and concisely between layers of the team

  • Proactive in flagging issues without waiting to be asked

Problem-Solving & Judgment

  • Freelance: Exercises judgment within the task scope; escalates rather than improvises outside it

  • Stays calm and methodical in escalation scenarios

Quality Awareness

  • Working knowledge of QC standards and review processes

  • Attention to detail in reviewing or executing production output during the shift

  • Consistent application of quality standards set by the Senior PM

jobs.excerpt: Curewiki operates a patient-initiated clinical research discovery platform live across Europe.
jobs.description:
Curewiki operates a patient-initiated clinical research discovery platform live across Europe. The platform is gaining real traction with top-tier pharma sponsors and CROs, our hospital footprint is expanding through technology partnerships anchored in EU interoperability initiatives, and the commercial organisation is being built out around it. The story is strong and getting stronger; what it needs now is an owner. You join as the first dedicated marketing hire, reporting into the COO, with real ownership from day one and the announcement calendar of a scaling company ahead of you.

The MarCom Lead owns how Curewiki speaks to the world. You'll run the full marketing communications function across B2B and B2C audiences and build the systems that let content, campaigns, events, and press scale without losing precision.

This is a role for someone who thinks before they publish. We work in a highly regulated space, where how we say something matters as much as what we say. Every piece of output has to hold the patient-initiated line, and you'll shape Curewiki's tone of voice and communication principles as the company scales.

Your responsibilities:

Content & digital marketing

  • Build and run an AI-leveraged content engine that produces a steady, high-quality pipeline across B2B and B2C, so output scales without turning every piece into a one-off — formats span articles, video, social, and more, tailored to both the research and patient communities
  • Make sure content aligns with our commercial objectives and lands with each audience, driving engagement and quality leads for the sales and partnerships teams
  • Lead the execution of digital campaigns across channels, reading performance and adjusting in real time
  • Use marketing automation to streamline email, retargeting, and social scheduling, in coordination with the outbound engines run by the commercial team
  • Partner with external collaborators on co-branded work such as webinars and joint campaigns, keeping messaging consistent with our brand and positioning

Press & announcements

  • Own Curewiki's press and announcement calendar, including partnership and milestone communications, working with our PR agency on a relationship-led approach focused on thought leadership and storytelling
  • Sequence owned-channel announcements and press activations deliberately, timing each to the strongest proof point rather than the earliest possible moment
  • Guard claim accuracy in all external output: no overclaiming on product capabilities, partnerships, or results

Events

  • Own Curewiki's presence at industry events: keep the calendar current, coordinate preparation with the commercial team, and make sure we show up well
  • Track how events and press perform and what they contribute to awareness and pipeline

Requirements

  • You've built and run a content or communications function that scaled: more output, same or higher quality, and you can show the system that made it possible
  • You've worked in a regulated or high-accuracy context (healthcare, life sciences, finance) and treat accuracy and positioning as part of the craft, not an afterthought
  • You're an excellent writer and editor in English, across both B2B and B2C audiences, and it shows in work you can share
  • You run AI-first: you already use AI tools to multiply your production, and you can explain where you draw the human-judgment line
  • You manage content calendars, campaigns, press moments, and multi-channel work without dropping threads

Nice to have

  • Dutch, French, German, or Spanish, given our markets

Benefits

  • Real ownership from day one as the first dedicated marketing hire.
  • A strong story to tell: real traction with top-tier pharma sponsors and CROs, and an expanding hospital footprint to build campaigns and announcements around
  • Remote work within the EU
  • A fast, transparent hiring process: intro call, hiring-manager deep-dive, practical working session, founder conversation, references — feedback at every step, completed in weeks not months
  • A high-velocity, mission-driven team that writes things down, moves fast, and takes AI leverage as a baseline in every role
  • The chance to define Curewiki's tone of voice and communication principles as the company scales.

jobs.description:
About Workstreet

At Workstreet, we’re on an exciting journey to help businesses scale securely by designing and implementing cutting-edge security and compliance programs. As a fast-growing startup, we specialize in a wide range of GRC (governance, risk, and compliance) services that support frameworks across SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, CMMC, NIST 800-171, NIST 800-53, and FedRAMP. We empower companies to meet regulatory requirements and enhance their cybersecurity posture from day one.

About Workstreet

At Workstreet, we’re on an exciting journey to help businesses scale securely by designing and implementing cutting-edge security and compliance programs. As a fast-growing startup, we specialize in a wide range of GRC (governance, risk, and compliance) services that support frameworks across SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, CMMC, NIST 800-171, NIST 800-53, and FedRAMP. We empower companies to meet regulatory requirements and enhance their cybersecurity posture from day one.

Get to know the Trust Services Team

In addition to GRC services, we also have a Trust Services team. We move at a fast, focused, and reliable pace – completing deliverables within 1 to 3 business days for customers with 5 clients and customers with 500 clients. We work directly with our customers’ security and sales points of contact, meaning clarity, teamwork, and problem-solving are at the forefront of everything we do to help our customers drive sales and renewals by using security and compliance as differentiators. If you want to be part of a team that builds the bridge between sales and security, you’re in the right place.

The Opportunity

Workstreet is looking for a results-oriented Trust Services Engineer to support our Trust Services team. Your primary responsibility will be to complete customer security questionnaires and other due diligence requests. Your work will be reviewed by Senior Engineers and Managers, giving you exposure to on-the-job feedback. This role is primarily focused on efficiently and accurately entering information from our customers’ existing compliance resources into standardized responses.

What you’ll do

  • Complete and submit security questionnaires - serve as the primary responder for customer due diligence requests, leveraging established response frameworks, internal policy documentation, and compliance control libraries to deliver accurate, on-time submissions.
  • Research and validate responses - dig into client-specific questions that fall outside standard frameworks, sourcing supporting evidence from compliance platforms and coordinating with internal security and compliance teams to verify accuracy before submission.
  • Maintain consistency and quality across all deliverables - ensure every response reflects current, approved language and aligns with the customer’s broader security posture; flag gaps or outdated documentation when identified.
  • Collaborate with internal teams - coordinate with compliance and security teams to verify information and ensure consistency across all submissions.

Who You Are

  • High-velocity SLA executor - Driven by time-sensitive deliverables and compressed turnaround targets, executing rapid data entry and technical responses without compromising quality.
  • Decisive risk navigator - Handles ambiguous security queries by making definitive, justifiable choices, utilizing sharp communication to escalate critical data gaps rather than operating on guesswork.
  • Proactive workflow coordinator - Commands strong workload prioritization instincts, systematically tracking assigned tasks and communicating blockers early to keep production lines moving.
  • Precision process guardian - Applies exceptional attention to detail and absolute structural discipline when executing established response workflows and data entry procedures.
  • Technical policy parser - Sharp ability to deconstruct dense corporate security policies, internal control libraries, and technical documentation to extract precise, accurate answers for client portfolios.
  • Third-party risk specialist - Directly processes specialized vendor security questionnaires across custom Excel matrices and cloud portals, mapping responses accurately against control domains, risk tiering, and subprocessor ecosystems.
  • Foundational GRC analyst - Grounded in core information security frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR), data definitions (PII vs. PHI), and technical security controls like authentication, logical access, and encryption.

What will help you succeed

  • Structural grasp of cloud environments - Baseline exposure to cloud infrastructure architectures and data hosting environments, specifically AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Operation of compliance automation engines - Direct execution or data mapping within automated compliance platforms such as Drata, Vanta, or Secureframe.
  • Hands-on management of vendor risk portals - Prior deployment or response logging inside enterprise vendor risk management systems, including OneTrust, ServiceNow, Whistic, UpGuard, or Zip.

What We Offer

  • Career Development: Clear path with mentorship and training opportunities.
  • Role-Related Training: Reimbursement for the successful completion of approved training and certification courses relevant to your current role.
  • Competitive Compensation: A competitive base salary with regular performance reviews linked to merit-based appraisals and bonus opportunities.
  • Growth Opportunity: Early-stage company with significant room for career advancement.
  • Remote-First Culture: Flexibility to work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team.

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with candidates, hiring managers, and business leaders across global teams.
  • A reliable, high-speed internet connection and a professional home office environment that supports confidential conversations, virtual interviews, and uninterrupted collaboration.
  • Commitment to working a standard schedule of 8:00 AM–5:00 PM US Eastern Time (ET) to effectively support hiring managers, candidates, and cross-functional teams. Occasional flexibility to adjust working hours is expected to accommodate changing business priorities, global collaboration, and time-sensitive hiring needs.
  • Willingness and ability to travel locally for occasional onsite meetings, team gatherings, or business activities as needed.

Hiring and Selection Process

  • Candidates must participate in live video interviews throughout the hiring process with camera on (non-negotiable) and be prepared to verify their identity during recruitment and onboarding.
  • Employment is contingent upon successful completion of identity verification and background screening, where permitted by law.
  • Selected candidates will participate in structured interviews with hiring managers and cross-functional stakeholders to assess role fit, experience, and alignment with Workstreet’s operating principles.
  • Candidates will receive prompt updates and consistent communication throughout the interview process, ensuring a transparent, smooth, and engaging experience at every step.

jobs.description:
Du bist in der Baufinanzierung zu Hause, brennst für den Vertrieb und willst nicht nur Anfragen abarbeiten, sondern mit uns ein eigenes Empfehlungsnetzwerk aufbauen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Wir suchen motivierte Berater:innen, die nicht nur beraten, sondern Menschen zu echten Fans von Baufi Deutschland machen – als Kund:innen, als Fans und als Multiplikatoren. Du bekommst von uns alles an die Hand, was du brauchst.

Aufgaben

Vertrieb ist für dich Antrieb – kein notwendiges Übel

Du gehst nicht nur ans Telefon, wenn dich jemand anruft – du nimmst aktiv Kontakt auf, weil du weißt: Eine gute Beratung verdient es, weiterempfohlen zu werden. Ein typischer Satz von dir könnte sein: „Wenn du jemanden in deinem Freundeskreis hast, der auch bald eine Immobilie kaufen will – nenne ihm gerne meinen Namen :-)“

Du brennst für echte Ergebnisse. Du willst nicht einfach „beraten“, sondern abschließen, weil du überzeugt hast – mit Kompetenz, Herz und einem klaren Mehrwert für den Kunden.

Du denkst mit – und willst gestalten

Du erkennst Potenziale – bei Kunden, im Prozess, im Vertrieb. Wenn du das Gefühl hast, etwas könnte besser laufen, sprichst du es an und packst mit an.

Zum Beispiel:

  • Du siehst eine Lücke in der Kundenkommunikation? Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team E-Mail-Vorlagen oder Formulare, die besser passen.
  • Du merkst, dass viele Kunden dieselbe Frage stellen? Du schlägst vor, dazu ein kurzes Erklärvideo zu drehen – oder schreibst selbst einen Mini-Leitfaden.

Eigenverantwortung ist für dich keine Belastung – sondern ein Privileg

Du bekommst bei uns nicht täglich neue Aufgaben zugewiesen. Du bekommst Freiraum – und das Vertrauen, ihn sinnvoll zu nutzen.

Das bedeutet auch:

  • Du setzt dir selbst Tagesziele
  • Du organisierst deine Woche eigenständig – und entscheidest selbst, wann du deinen Fokus auf Abschluss oder Nachbetreuung legst.

Kundenbeziehungen sind dir wichtiger als „schnell fertig“

Du willst langfristig Vertrauen aufbauen – nicht nur ein Produkt verkaufen.

Das bedeutet:

  • Du hörst genau hin: „Was ist dem Kunden wirklich wichtig?“
  • Du gehst auch mal den Extra-Schritt: z. B. erklärst du die Kreditverträge nochmal in Ruhe oder bereitest für den Kunden eine Übersicht auf, die er dem Partner/der Partnerin zeigen kann.

Und: Du bleibst auch nach der Auszahlung ansprechbar – weil du weißt, dass aus einem zufriedenen Kunden oft der nächste entsteht.

Du bist remote – aber nicht allein

Auch wenn du im Homeoffice arbeitest: Wir leben Teamgefühl.

  • Wöchentliche Austausch-Calls mit Kolleg:innen
  • Kurze Feedbackschleifen im Whatsapp-Chat oder 1:1 Call
  • Gemeinsame Planung von Aktionen (z. B. für Empfehlungen, Kundennachfassaktionen etc.)
  • 2x pro Jahr treffen wir uns LIVE und verbringen eine schöne und lustige Zeit miteinander.

Qualifikation

Erfahrung, auf die du bauen kannst

  • Du bist geprüfte:r Immobiliardarlehensvermittler:in (§34i) oder Bankkaufmann/-frau mit fundierter / mehrjähriger Beratungserfahrung in der privaten Baufinanzierung. Beratungserfahrung in der privaten Baufinanzierung.
  • Du hast bereits als Finanzierungsvermittler erfolgreich gearbeitet und kannst deine Erfolge der letzten Jahre nachweisen.
  • Du kennst dich mit Annuitätendarlehen, KfW-Förderungen, Forward-Darlehen und Anschlussfinanzierungen nicht nur theoretisch aus – sondern weißt, wie man Kunden sicher durch diese Themen führt.

Du willst Abschlüsse – nicht nur Gespräche

  • Du berätst nicht nur kompetent, sondern zielorientiert – am Ende zählt für dich der Mehrwert für den Kunden und der Abschluss.
  • Du freust dich über Wettbewerb – und nimmst ein Konkurrenzangebot nicht als Hindernis, sondern als Herausforderung an, es besser zu machen.

Du bist selbst Starter statt Zauderer

  • Du wartest nicht, bis jemand dich „mit Kunden versorgt“. Du nutzt deine Beratungsgespräche, um Empfehlungen zu gewinnen, denkst mit und klingelst auch mal durch, wenn du einen guten Draht spürst.
  • Du hast Spaß daran, dir selbst ein Portfolio aufzubauen, z. B. über Makler, Steuerberater oder Familien, die dich weiterempfehlen.

Kommunikation ist dein Handwerk

  • Du kannst komplexe Inhalte verständlich erklären – am Telefon, per Video oder Mail.
  • Du bist charmant, verbindlich, klar – und behältst auch in stressigen Phasen einen kühlen Kopf.

Benefits

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

Du erhältst ein echtes Profi-Setup

  • Hochwertiger Homeoffice-Arbeitsplatz mit allem Drum und Dran: höhenverstellbarer Tisch, starker Rechner, zwei Monitore, Profi-Headset, ergonomischer Stuhl.
  • Unser modernes CRM-System ist extra für digitale Baufinanzierungsberatung gebaut – damit du mehr Zeit für Kunden hast und weniger für Excel-Listen.

Volle Power für deinen Erfolg

  • Du bekommst regelmäßig Leads – Kunden, die finanzieren wollen.
  • Du willst mehr? Super! Wir unterstützen dich aktiv beim Aufbau deines eigenen Empfehlungsnetzwerks. Zum Beispiel durch ein Empfehlungsprogramm, das deine Kunden incentiviert, dich weiterzuempfehlen.
  • Du kannst mit Immobilienmaklern kooperieren – wenn du willst, geben wir Gas mit dir!

Du entwickelst dich weiter – wann du willst

  • Ein eigenes Schulungsportal mit Video-Tutorials, konkreten Leitfäden und Best-Practice-Beispielen.
  • Kolleg:innen, die ihr Wissen teilen – wir leben Teamplay, auch im digitalen Raum.

Gutes Geld für gute Leistung

  • Faires Fixgehalt + lukrativer variabler Anteil (nach oben unbegrenzt).
  • 32 Tage Urlaub, freie Zeiteinteilung, unbefristeter Vertrag – du entscheidest, wann und wie du performst.

Wenn du also jemand bist, der Eigenverantwortung liebt, Kunden ernst nimmt und mit klarem Fokus auf Vertrieb arbeitet, dann wirst du dich bei uns zuhause fühlen.

jobs.title: Architecte infrastructure IT (H/F)
jobs.excerpt: Le contexte: Notre practice Infra Cloud & Cyber accompagne des clients grands comptes sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie de leurs infrastructures : conception, transformation, sécurisation et maintien en condition opérationnelle.
jobs.description:
Le contexte:

Notre practice Infra Cloud & Cyber accompagne des clients grands comptes sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie de leurs infrastructures : conception, transformation, sécurisation et maintien en condition opérationnelle. Nos environnements sont majoritairement hybrides, mêlant datacenters privés, cloud public et contraintes fortes de sécurité et de conformité.

Vous intervenez comme architecte infrastructure référent, sur des sujets de refonte de datacenter, de modernisation, de virtualisation, de stockage, de réseau et de plans de continuité.

Une practice en construction, et vous en êtes acteur. Notre practice est engagée dans une démarche de structuration : construction d'offres packagées, développement d'accélérateurs, industrialisation de nos référentiels. Vous ne rejoignez pas une organisation figée — vous aurez la possibilité réelle de faire évoluer la practice, de contribuer à la définition de nos offres et de laisser votre empreinte sur nos standards techniques

Vos missions:

Architecture et conception:

  • concevoir des architectures d'infrastructure cibles : compute, stockage, réseau, virtualisation, sauvegarde
  • Réaliser des audits d'infrastructure existante et construire les trajectoires de transformation
  • Définir les architectures hybrides et les stratégies d'interconnexion avec le cloud public
  • Concevoir les plans de reprise et de continuité d'activité (PRA/PCA) et les valider par des tests 2.

Transformation et delivery

  • Piloter techniquement les projets de migration, de consolidation ou de refonte de datacenter
  • Définir les standards d'industrialisation et d'automatisation : IaC, gestion de configuration
  • Garantir la cohérence entre les choix d'infrastructure et les exigences de sécurité portées par notre verticale Cyber

Avant-vente et réponse aux appels d'offres

  • Participer à la rédaction technique de nos réponses aux appels d'offres : conception de la solution, argumentaire technique, dimensionnement, chiffrage
  • Défendre nos propositions en soutenance client
  • Contribuer à la qualification technique des besoins et à la construction des trajectoires proposées

Contribution à la structuration de la practice

  • Construire et faire évoluer nos offres packagées sur le domaine infrastructure : contenu, livrables types, modèle de chiffrage
  • Développer nos accélérateurs : référentiels d'architecture, matrices de choix technologiques, modèles de dimensionnement, kits d'audit
  • Contribuer à la structuration de la verticale Infrastructure : standards, bonnes pratiques, capitalisation des retours d'expérience
  • Animer la communauté technique de la verticale
  • Participer aux entretiens techniques de recrutement et à la qualification des profils

Le profil que nous recherchons:

Diplôme et expérience

  • BAC+5, diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent
  • Expérience : 8 ans minimum en infrastructure, dont 3 ans en position d'architecte

Compétences techniques

  • Virtualisation : VMware vSphere, et ouverture aux alternatives (Proxmox, Nutanix, Hyper-V) dans un contexte de marché en recomposition
  • Systèmes : Linux (RHEL, Debian) et Windows Server, Active Directory
  • Stockage et sauvegarde : SAN/NAS, solutions de sauvegarde et de réplication
  • Réseau : routage, switching, segmentation, load balancing, firewalling
  • Automatisation : Ansible, Terraform, scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python)
  • Supervision et observabilité : Zabbix, Prometheus, Grafana ou équivalents
  • Culture cloud hybride : compréhension des modèles IaaS et des mécanismes d'interconnexion
  • Sensibilité forte aux enjeux de sécurité : durcissement, segmentation, gestion des accès à privilèges

Certifications

  • VMware VCP, certifications Red Hat (RHCE), Cisco (CCNP) ou équivalentes appréciées
  • Une certification cloud, niveau associate minimum, est un plus

Savoir-être

  • Capacité à prendre de la hauteur sans perdre le contact avec la réalité opérationnelle
  • Pédagogie et clarté dans la formalisation : vos livrables sont lus par des décideurs
  • Envie de construire : la structuration d'une practice demande de l'initiative autant que de l'expertise
  • Rigueur et sens du risque : sur ces environnements, l'erreur coûte cher

Ce que nous vous proposons:

  • Un rôle qui dépasse la mission : contribution directe à nos offres, à nos accélérateurs et à la structuration de la practice
  • Une implication en avant-vente : rédaction technique des appels d'offres et soutenances client
  • Un budget formation et certification dédié, avec un plan individualisé construit avec votre référent de verticale
  • Un accès à notre lab technique
  • Une communauté technique structurée : weekly de verticale, monthly de practice, temps d'échange réguliers
  • Un parcours d'évolution vers l'expertise (architecte principal, référent de verticale) ou vers le management
  • Des sujets de fond, sur des infrastructures critiques chez des clients exigeants

« Notre développement international et notre position de leader sur le marché de l’Ingénierie et du conseil en Technologies nous confèrent une responsabilité sociale, sociétale et environnementale envers l’ensemble de nos interlocuteurs et parties prenantes », Simon Azoulay – Président Directeur Général d’ALTEN.

ALTEN accompagne la stratégie de développement de ses clients dans les domaines de l’innovation, de la R&D et des systèmes d’information technologiques.

Plus qu’un poste, découvrez l’aventure ALTEN !

jobs.title: Total Rewards and Payroll Manager
jobs.excerpt: About GigaGiga is building gigawatts of AI data centers to hasten a future of intelligence and abundance.
jobs.description:
About Giga

Giga is building gigawatts of AI data centers to hasten a future of intelligence and abundance. We build data centers fast and at scale by combining the capabilities of an equipment supplier, engineering firm, general contractor, and real estate developer under one roof. Our team moves quickly and thinks practically. If you're ready to make an impact in an industry that matters, we're looking for people like you.

Why join Giga

  • The Pace: We're building at a speed most companies talk about but never actually operate at. If you've been bored somewhere else, you won't be here.
  • The Impact: Every person at Giga touches the work that matters. No layers, no waiting for approval chains. You'll see your fingerprints on what we ship.
  • The Team: A team of operators defining the future of AI infrastructure. We recruit A-players from the most innovative companies in the world, and they choose Giga because the work here means more.
  • The Moment: AI doesn't run without power, and that's us. Giga is the picks and shovels behind the AI revolution. This industry is about to explode, and you'll be in the room where it's already happening.

What you'll do

Giga is hiring a Sr. Manager, Total Rewards & Payroll to be the first dedicated owner of the employee rewards stack: payroll, benefits, compensation, and equity administration. Today, payroll sits inside a busy accounting team, benefits and compensation work is spread across People and Finance, equity administration sits with external counsel, and no single person is accountable for the whole system. You will change that.

You will run payroll end to end for a growing, multi-state workforce: scheduled cycles, off-cycle corrections, per diems, bonuses, deductions, garnishments, and the day-to-day questions that come with hundreds of employees. You will own the controls around it, from pre-close reconciliation and payroll tax coordination with accounting to year-end processing and audit-ready records. You will operationalize benefits, from enrollment and eligibility through employee issues, broker and vendor management, renewals, and utilization, so employees understand and use what Giga offers. And you will administer Giga's compensation, incentive, and equity programs: maintaining salary bands with People leadership, supporting benchmarking, running bonus eligibility, calculations, communications, and payouts with a clean trail, and bringing equity administration in-house, owning grant records, vesting schedules, exercises, and reporting with support from external counsel.

You will not design Giga's compensation philosophy or incentive architecture; those principles stay with company leadership. Your job is to turn them into programs and processes that operate reliably at scale, and to be the first line of defense on pay and rewards questions.

This role works at the center of Giga's People and Finance teams. Payroll execution and controls stay tightly connected to Giga's Controller and accounting team, and benefits direction and the compensation calendar run with People leadership. The reporting home for this role will be confirmed with the selected candidate. Either way, you will own the outcomes below end to end.

In your first 90 days, you will take over the payroll cycle, stabilize the recurring calendar, and document the existing processes, controls, and exceptions. By the end of your first year, Giga should have clean payroll operations, benefits employees understand and use, compensation and equity administration that runs on schedule, and reporting leadership trusts.

Where you'll work

This is a full-time, 100% remote role with no recurring office requirement. You may work from any location in the United States where Giga is able to employ you. You will work with teams across U.S. time zones and occasionally with Giga's international operations, so reliable overlap hours, strong written communication, and clear handoffs matter.

Occasional travel may be required for company onsites or team planning.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end payroll for a multi-state workforce: regular cycles, off-cycle runs, corrections, bonuses, per diems, deductions, and garnishments, with every cycle accurate and on time.
  • Maintain payroll controls: reconciliations, variance review, payroll tax registrations and filings with the accounting team, year-end processing, and audit-ready records.
  • Own benefits administration: enrollment, eligibility, employee issues, broker and vendor relationships, renewals, and utilization.
  • Administer compensation, incentive, and equity programs: maintain salary bands and leveling data with People leadership, support benchmarking, run bonus eligibility, calculations, communications, and payouts, and own day-to-day equity administration (grant records, vesting, exercises, and reporting) with external counsel support.
  • Own Giga's payroll and rewards systems and data, including Rippling configuration for payroll and related data, reporting, and the quality of employee and pay records.
  • Answer employee payroll and benefits questions with accuracy, urgency, and confidentiality, and fix root causes when the same issues repeat.
  • Partner with the Controller and accounting team on payroll accounting, cash funding, and controls, and with People leadership on benefits strategy and the compensation calendar.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of payroll for a multi-state workforce, including hands-on processing, corrections, garnishments, and year-end. You have personally run payroll, not just overseen a vendor.
  • Strong payroll controls and compliance fundamentals: reconciliations, multi-state tax coordination, approval and segregation rules, year-end processing, and audit-ready records working alongside accounting.
  • Working depth in benefits administration: enrollment, eligibility, broker or vendor management, renewals, employee issues, and utilization, not just plan selection.
  • Experience administering compensation and equity programs: salary structures or bands, benchmarking support, and bonus or incentive calculations and payouts with a clean audit trail, including day-to-day equity administration (grant records, vesting, exercises, and reporting) with external counsel support.
  • Systems fluency with modern payroll and HRIS platforms such as Rippling or comparable tools, including configuration, reporting, and data quality.
  • Discretion and judgment with sensitive employee and compensation data, and clear, direct communication with employees, executives, and vendors.

Bonus points

  • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) or a comparable payroll certification.
  • You have built or rebuilt payroll operations at a scaling company, including taking payroll over from a distributed or part-time model.
  • Experience with mixed hourly and salaried workforces, field or project-based teams, or multiple legal entities.
  • Hands-on experience with equity administration platforms such as Carta or Shareworks, or comparable cap-table tools.
  • Experience in energy, infrastructure, manufacturing, construction, or another physical operating environment.

How We Work

We value people who take ownership, raise risks early, communicate directly, and follow through. Incomplete information is part of the job. Make the best decision you can, document it, and adjust as the facts change. Move quickly on reversible decisions and take more care when security, safety, financial, employee, or customer risk is involved.

Benefits

  • Subsidized health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Equity (options) in a rapidly growing startup
  • 401(k) with 4% employer match
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Parental leave
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) or Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Commuter benefits, where applicable
  • Opportunities to collaborate in person at periodic team and company on-sites

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

Giga Energy is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Giga Energy complies with all applicable labor laws, including the California Fair Employment and Housing Act (FEHA) and other relevant state and federal regulations. We provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and encourage applicants who require accommodations during the hiring process to contact us.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Reporting Analyst
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionSprout Social is looking to hire a Senior Financial Reporting Analyst to join the Finance team.
jobs.description:
Description

Sprout Social is looking to hire a Senior Financial Reporting Analyst to join the Finance team.

Why join Sprout’s Finance team?

As a member of Sprout’s finance team, you’ll help better position Sprout for future growth while maintaining compliance and integrity at the highest level. No matter your role, everyone on the team has the opportunity to be a part of creating best-in-class processes and practices that can scale with the organization. Our team is unique because we value transparency and direct ownership of responsibilities—meaning, you’ll always have our trust to help contribute to our overall goals and success as a department and organization.

What you’ll do

  • Assist in the preparation of Sprout’s SEC filings, such as 8-Ks, 10-Qs and 10-Ks, including the associated XBRL tagging requirements
  • Prepare financial statements, footnotes, MD&A, and other disclosures in accordance with U.S. GAAP and SEC reporting requirements
  • Create underlying workpapers and analyses to support the company’s disclosures and prepare the disclosure checklist
  • Work cross-functionally with various stakeholders, including Legal, Investor Relations, Finance and Accounting, in order to complete Sprout’s SEC filings
  • Ensure SOX compliance throughout our financial reporting and related processes
  • Interface with external auditors and facilitate their procedures over Sprout’s SEC filings
  • Perform ad hoc disclosure benchmarking research of peer group companies
  • Prepare share-based compensation entries and reconciliation for month-end close and provide equity-related analysis
  • Utilize artificial intelligence to enhance Sprout’s financial reporting and technical accounting processes
  • Participate in other technical accounting and SEC reporting workstreams and ad hoc projects

What you’ll bring

We are looking for an individual who is self-motivated with strong attention to details, proven ability to work both independently and cross-functionally and drive to take on new challenges. If you have a background in financial reporting and are passionate about delivering quality results and driving continual improvement in a dynamic, high-growth environment, we’d love to talk to you!

The minimum qualifications for this role include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent business degree
  • 2-5+ years of relevant industry or public accounting experience

Preferred qualifications for this role include:

  • CPA license or actively working towards obtaining license
  • Understanding of U.S. GAAP and SEC disclosure and reporting requirements
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills with an ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization
  • Experience with SEC reporting software a plus (e.g. Workiva)

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Experiencing Sprout’s in-depth onboarding, covering everything from our company mission and values, hearing directly from executives and founders, to deep training on our products and the value that Sprout delivers to our customers
  • Making a plan with your manager to set initial priorities, aligning on expectations for your role, planting goalposts for your career, and learning about Sprout’s approach to scaling key business operations to support a high-growth NASDAQ publicly traded company

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Being proficient in using Sprout’s accounting system (NetSuite) in order to retrieve data needed to prepare financial reporting
  • Becoming proficient in Workiva in order to prepare the required external filings, such as the 10-Q and 10-K.
  • Obtaining a broad understanding of Sprout’s financial reporting process and timelines
  • Preparing financial statements, footnotes and other disclosures for Sprout’s external filings
  • Building connections with business partners and finance teammates

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Taking on additional responsibility over the financial reporting process, including interfacing with the external auditors and preparing the quarterly close and reporting calendar

jobs.title: Technical Research Consultant, Identity Verification
jobs.excerpt: Summary: The ideal candidate must move quickly from an identity-verification concept to evidence.
jobs.description:
Summary: The ideal candidate must move quickly from an identity-verification concept to evidence. Find the right providers and data sources, test them hands-on, document market and regulatory constraints, and give Product clear recommendations backed by working prototypes and traceable research.

Why 1Kosmos?

1Kosmos builds identity verification and authentication technology used by enterprises and government organizations. Our Identity Verification product spans physical identity documents, electronic IDs, authoritative data sources, biometrics, fraud signals, and reusable verified identity.

The market changes constantly. Governments release new identity documents and digital IDs, vendors add or retire APIs, fraud techniques evolve, and regional rules determine whether a technically viable integration can actually be used in production. We need a technically capable researcher who can keep pace with those changes and turn them into product decisions.

About the Engagement

This is a three-to-six month consulting engagement embedded with the Identity Verification Product team. You will investigate providers, integrate and test APIs, build lightweight prototypes, evaluate market and regulatory constraints, and leave behind reusable research systems rather than one-off reports.

The role is remote. Reliable overlap with the U.S. Eastern time zone for Product-team collaboration is required.

What You Will Do

Provider and Data-Source Research

  • Identify identity-verification, authoritative-data, eID, document-verification, biometric, liveness, deepfake, fraud-signal, bank-verification, and related providers that can fill specific product requirements.
  • Research regional options where global vendors may have weak coverage, with near-term emphasis on markets such as Southeast Asia and other priority international regions.
  • Determine whether a provider is technically available and operationally usable, including production eligibility, onboarding requirements, per-customer approvals, geographic restrictions, licensing, minimums, and commercial dependencies.
  • Separate vendor claims from verified evidence by using primary sources, technical documentation, independent benchmarks, public test results, standards, and hands-on validation.

Hands-On API Evaluation and Prototyping

  • Integrate third-party REST APIs and SDKs in a sandbox or test environment using lightweight Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Postman, curl, or similar tools.
  • Build small proof-of-concept applications or test harnesses that demonstrate what a provider actually returns, how difficult it is to integrate, and where failure modes appear.
  • Evaluate API authentication, request/response structure, error handling, webhooks, latency, rate limits, sandbox-to-production differences, observability, documentation quality, and integration effort.
  • Prototype fraud and biometric concepts when useful, such as connecting a deepfake-detection API and comparing its results against public or independently available test data.
  • Document enough implementation detail that Product or Engineering can reproduce the test without starting over.

Country, Regulatory, and Operational Research

  • Research how identity verification works in specific countries, including available government eIDs, authoritative sources, physical documents, identity attributes, and approved access models.
  • Translate business requests into technical and vendor-evaluation criteria. Example: a request to support Singpass should become a documented view of integration options, approval requirements, entity prerequisites, production constraints, data flows, and implementation choices.
  • Identify privacy, consent, data-residency, retention, licensing, certification, and local-government constraints that could affect architecture or time to market.
  • Flag operational dependencies early, including manual-review requirements, provider onboarding lead times, customer-specific approvals, or compliance reassessment implications.

Coverage Intelligence and Change Monitoring

  • Maintain a structured view of provider coverage by country, document type, electronic ID, authoritative source, and capability.
  • Track new or changed identity-document templates and provider support so Product can anticipate verification failures rather than discover them only through customer escalations.
  • Monitor vendor release notes, government identity programs, standards, API changes, and relevant product announcements, recording both the source and effective date.
  • Create concise periodic updates that tell Product what changed, why it matters, and whether action is required.

Research Automation and Agents

  • Build lightweight research agents or automated workflows that monitor defined sources, detect changes, preserve citations, and produce reviewable summaries.
  • Automate repetitive research tasks such as checking supported-document lists, comparing vendor coverage, identifying newly released document templates, or watching government digital-ID programs.
  • Design workflows so a human can verify the source and reasoning before research is used for a product or compliance decision.

Decision Support for Product

  • Create a repeatable vendor scorecard covering coverage, technical fit, evidence quality, integration complexity, fraud controls, operational model, regulatory constraints, data handling, commercial considerations, scalability, and vendor maturity.
  • Recommend whether 1Kosmos should integrate, partner, defer, or continue researching, and clearly state the evidence and assumptions behind the recommendation.
  • Present findings in concise written briefs and working sessions with Product, Engineering, Security/Compliance, and other stakeholders.
  • Maintain a research repository so prior work can be reused for roadmap planning, customer requirements, RFPs, and future vendor evaluations.

Example Initial Research Queue

Priorities will change during the engagement, but representative assignments include:

  • Evaluate bank-account and identity-data providers such as Plaid for verification use cases and determine the most appropriate integration pattern.
  • Identify and test document-verification and authoritative-source providers for Southeast Asian markets.
  • Research Singpass and other national eID programs, including production approval requirements and customer-specific constraints.
  • Evaluate eID and mobile-ID aggregation options and determine where direct government integrations versus aggregators make sense.
  • Compare DMV/AAMVA-like authoritative-source options and third-party aggregators for U.S. identity verification.
  • Prototype and evaluate deepfake or biometric fraud-detection providers, including tools such as Paravision or comparable specialist vendors.
  • Build a repeatable process for detecting new identity-document templates and tracking when upstream providers add support.

Requirements

You Are the Right Person for This Engagement If You Have

  • Strong hands-on experience consuming third-party APIs and SDKs. You can go from documentation to a working test without needing a full engineering team.
  • Comfort with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or a similar scripting language, plus REST/JSON, OAuth or API-key authentication, Postman, curl, Git, and basic cloud tooling.
  • Excellent technical research skills and the discipline to distinguish primary evidence, independent testing, vendor marketing claims, and your own conclusions.
  • Experience translating ambiguous business questions into structured evaluation criteria and defensible recommendations.
  • Strong written communication. Your research should be concise enough for an executive while detailed enough for an engineer to reproduce the work.
  • Experience presenting technical findings to Product, walking Engineering through API test results, and discussing regulatory constraints with Security or Compliance.
  • High agency and comfort working independently in an environment where priorities can change quickly.
  • Dependable collaboration overlap with the U.S. Eastern time zone.
  • Experience in identity verification, KYC/KYB, fraud prevention, biometrics, digital identity, cybersecurity, fintech, payments, or trust and safety.

Additional Pluses

  • Familiarity with government eID programs, mobile driver licenses, authoritative identity data, document verification, or identity-assurance standards.
  • Experience evaluating biometric, liveness, presentation-attack, deepfake, or document-fraud technology.
