jobs.excerpt: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

Mozilla’s Customer Experience team helps users, organizations, and partners successfully adopt, use, and get sustained value from Mozilla products. Historically, much of Mozilla’s support work has focused on consumers. As Mozilla expands its business and organizational offerings, we are building a support operation designed for the needs of B2B customers, including dependable service delivery, clear customer commitments, global coverage, and close coordination with Product and Engineering.

As Staff Enterprise Support Operations Manager, you will be Mozilla’s first dedicated B2B support operations leader. You will not inherit a mature operation; you will build one. You will design and launch the operating model, vendor strategy, processes, tooling, training, metrics, capacity planning, and governance required to provide high-quality technical support to organizations deploying and managing Mozilla products.

Beyond building the support operation, you will serve as the operational bridge between Enterprise customers, CX, Product, and Engineering, ensuring insights from customers and support teams inform the broader Enterprise experience.

This is an individual contributor role with broad end-to-end ownership. You will be the day-to-day owner of Mozilla’s external B2B support vendor relationships and the operational processes connecting vendor agents with Mozilla teams. You will use customer demand, service performance, and cost data to determine when and how the operation should expand across geographies, languages, coverage models, and support offerings. As the business grows, you will also help define the structure and capabilities of Mozilla’s future B2B support team.

You will participate in a defined incident coverage model and periodically lead the operational response to major customer incidents. In those moments, you will ensure vendors follow established procedures, coordinate escalation and handoffs to Mozilla engineers, drive cross-functional resolution, communicate clearly with customers and internal leaders, and oversee post-incident reviews and root cause analysis.

This position requires a rare combination of support operations expertise, vendor management, program development, technical fluency, and calm leadership under pressure. Our ideal candidate is a practical builder who can move between strategy and execution, create structure where none exists, and earn the trust of customers, vendors, engineers, and senior leaders.

What you’ll do:
  • Build and launch Mozilla’s first B2B support operations capability, including its operating model, workflows, escalation paths, governance, and continuous-improvement processes.
  • Own external support vendor relationships end to end, including future vendor selection and contracting support, onboarding, workforce planning, performance management, invoicing, renewals, and investment recommendations.
  • Create and maintain vendor training, support playbooks, standard operating procedures, quality frameworks, knowledge materials, and coordination with product teams for release-readiness plans.
  • Forecast customer demand and support capacity, balancing staffing, coverage, language needs, service quality, cost, and business growth; recommend when to expand into new geographies or service models.
  • Define service objectives, metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and operating reviews for quality, speed, customer experience, productivity, and cost.
  • Hold vendors accountable for performance, identify service gaps, and lead corrective-action and continuous-improvement plans.
  • Own Mozilla’s operational enterprise escalation framework while designing and managing operational handoffs between vendor agents and Mozilla teams so complex issues reach the right Engineering, Product, Security, or business partners with sufficient context and urgency.
  • Lead the operational response to major B2B incidents, coordinating vendor execution, engineering engagement, customer and leadership communications, resolution, and post-incident review.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, Legal, Finance, Procurement, and other teams to align customer commitments with operational capacity and improve the support experience.
  • Participate in customer-facing meetings to understand operational challenges, explain support processes, gather feedback, and strengthen the customer support experience.
  • Translate support trends and customer feedback into actionable insights, partnering cross-functionally to improve customer journeys, products, documentation, processes, tooling, automation, and responsible uses of AI, while helping define the future structure of Mozilla’s B2B support organization.
What you’ll bring:
  • 5+ years of experience in B2B or enterprise technical support operations, service delivery, customer operations, vendor management, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience building a new support capability or substantially scaling or transforming an existing support operation.
  • Experience managing outsourced support vendors or BPO partners, including training, workforce planning, quality assurance, performance governance, and corrective action.
  • Experience with vendor selection, statements of work, contracts, budgets, forecasts, invoices, renewals, or related procurement and commercial processes.
  • Experience with support platforms such as Zendesk/CRMs and issue-tracking systems such as Jira, including reporting, workflow design, and operational analytics.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise support and service-management practices, including service levels, severity models, escalations, incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis.
  • Experience leading high-severity technical incidents and coordinating customers, support teams, engineers, executives, and other stakeholders under pressure.
  • Experience defining operational metrics and using dashboards, reporting, and workforce planning to improve quality, customer outcomes, efficiency, and cost.
  • Technical fluency sufficient to coordinate issues involving enterprise software, browsers, endpoint management, identity, certificates, proxies, networks, security tools, and managed customer environments; deep software engineering expertise is not required.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to explain complex situations clearly and move work forward across distributed teams.
  • Ability to operate independently across regions, cultures, and time zones, exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations, and build support experiences worthy of long-term customer trust.
  • Experience with multilingual or multi-region support operations is desired.
  • Experience building and leading B2B or enterprise technical support operations teams is desired.
  • Familiarity with GDPR, enterprise security requirements, regulated customer environments is desired.
What you’ll get:
  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

jobs.description:
Want to advise the world's best brands on their content strategy? Contently needs experienced content strategists to lead the brands we work with into the forefront of inventive content.

Contently’s approach to content strategy is different from what you might be used to. We don’t believe in consulting for consulting’s sake. Our strategy work is always focused on actionable plans that lead to publication.

As a Contently Content Strategist your primary responsibility is to educate clients about and help them explore the possibilities of branded content — working hand in hand with them to develop objectives and strategy. You will do this by leading discovery sessions to clients uncover their objectives, identify or create assets that can be developed into content, design and implement frameworks that brands and agencies can utilize to maximize content on Contently, and ultimately to project manage campaigns to ensure the strategy delivers on its promise.

You’ll teach marketers what constitutes great content on Contently, and also how to build holistic strategy from organic discovery to paid promotion. You’ll share best practices and inspire better ones with Contently's top clients.

The position is freelance, performed remotely, typically range from 5 hours to 20 hours per week. Pay is competitive.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead and customize ½ and full-day strategy sessions as part of the Contently Studio.
  • Ideate, build and help achieve content strategies that communicate and achieve client objectives
  • Educate clients about the importance and opportunities of branded content
  • Attend and/or lead meetings with clients

Who Your Are:

  • Experience in driving or contributing to content strategies on the client side or as an account planner, comms planner, digital strategist or community manager
  • Experience in publishing technology from CMS platforms to analytics
  • Alignment to Contently’s vision and core value.
  • 5-7 years of experience in a publishing or agency environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work face-to-face with client teams
  • Extensive knowledge of the native advertising and branded content spaces
  • Ability to write clearly and without jargon
  • Avid consumer of media, of all types
  • Strong PowerPoint and Keynote skills.

Location:

Primarily remote at your own location. Travel to Contently office and client sites.

About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with U.S. and Canadian companies building high-performing remote teams. We believe strong operations talent should be able to do meaningful work from anywhere, with clear expectations, structured support, and opportunities to grow alongside the companies they support.

For this role, you will support a B2B import/export and supply chain operation serving customers across international markets, including Latin America.

About the Role

As a Logistics Coordinator, you will support the Operations team across logistics, procurement, claims, inventory movements, and customer order workflows. You will coordinate domestic and international shipments, maintain accurate records, review shipping documentation, and help ensure goods move from order through final delivery without unnecessary delays.

This role is heavily email-based, so strong professional written communication is essential. You will work with carriers, freight forwarders, warehouses, suppliers, internal teams, and Spanish-speaking customers while keeping information accurate and stakeholders updated.

This is a strong fit for someone who already understands B2B logistics and wants a remote role with broad exposure to international supply chain operations.

  • Track shipments from dispatch through final delivery and proactively flag delays, exceptions, or missed delivery milestones
  • Keep suppliers, warehouses, drivers, customers, and internal teams updated with clear and timely shipment communications
  • Prepare, review, and validate shipping documents including bills of lading, packing lists, commercial invoices, and customs documentation
  • Identify and escalate discrepancies involving weights, quantities, shipping records, documentation, or delivery details

  • Manage inventory transfers and warehouse logistics while maintaining accurate movement records
  • Enter customer orders and maintain order information in the company’s Order Management and ERP systems
  • Prepare recurring and ad hoc logistics, order, claims, and shipment reports for the Operations team

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • 1-3+ years of experience in logistics, shipping, supply chain, transportation, or a closely related operations role
  • Experience working in a B2B logistics or import/export environment with international shipments
  • Hands-on experience coordinating domestic and international shipments
  • Working knowledge of shipping documentation such as bills of lading, packing lists, commercial invoices, and customs paperwork
  • Fluent written English with strong professional email communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail and experience following structured processes and SOPs

Nice to Have:

  • Experience processing logistics claims, product quality claims, shipment discrepancies, or documentation exceptions
  • Experience reviewing mismatches involving quantities, weights, invoices, or shipment documentation

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreJoin a team that puts its People First!
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Join a team that puts its People First! First American's Direct division provides comprehensive title insurance protection and professional settlement services for real estate purchases, refinances and equity loans. Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

What We Do

Dive into your love of history and research to help us provide critical data to our teams and customers in the real estate space. First American sets the standard for excellence in this industry with its state-of-the-art technology and best-in-class escrow and underwriting teams.

First American is looking to add a Title Examiner to our team. This position plays a key role in coordinating the resolution and completion of the title process. Primary responsibilities include searching public records and examining titles to determine the legal condition of property title—primarily for cooperative properties across New York (including NYC boroughs and surrounding counties)—and developing solutions to cure title issues.

This role includes working within New York’s unique title environment, including ACRIS, county clerk systems, and cooperative (co-op) transactions, as well as preparing and revising coop lien searches in accordance with NY underwriting practices. The right candidate must be able to work remotely and independently, utilizing experience to examine title of varying complexity, establish chain of title, and identify risks specific to New York real estate.

What You’ll Do:

  • Perform title examinations and analyze for cooperative properties throughout New York State, including NYC (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island)
  • Conduct detailed searches using ACRIS (NYC) and county clerk/land record systems (e.g., Nassau, Suffolk, Westchester, Rockland, etc.)
  • Examine and interpret NY-specific documents, including deeds, mortgages, satisfactions, assignments, CEMA transactions, and transfer documents
  • Perform co-op searches, including review of proprietary leases, stock certificates, recognition agreements, and managing agent documentation
  • Conduct and analyze UCC lien searches at the state and county level, and identify filings affecting cooperative interests and real property
  • Review tax records, water/sewer liens, ECB violations, and municipal charges impacting title (especially within NYC)
  • Identify and resolve title issues common in NY, including:
    • Missing or improperly recorded satisfactions
    • Open mortgages or assignments
    • Judgments and liens (including federal, state, and local)
    • Name variations and vesting issues
    • Breaks in chain of title
  • Prepare clear, concise coop lien searches and curative requirements for underwriting and closing teams
  • May provide underwriting interpretation within established NY guidelines
  • Other duties as assigned

What You’ll Bring:

  • 4+ years of directly related New York title examination experience
  • Strong working knowledge of ACRIS and NY county recording systems
  • Experience with NY co-op transactions and cooperative title review
  • Familiarity with UCC searches (NY State and county-level) and lien resolution
  • Knowledge of NYC-specific items such as ECB violations, municipal liens, and tax-related searches
  • Detail-oriented with a strong focus on accuracy and quality
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • High School diploma or equivalent
Pay Range: $23.37 - $31.15 Hourly, RemoteThis hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location.

What We Offer

By choice, we don’t simply accept individuality – we embrace it, we support it, and we thrive on it! Our People First culture is inclusive for all employees - not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it's the key to our success. We are proud to foster an authentic and inclusive workplace For All. You are free and encouraged to bring your entire, unique self to work. First American is an equal opportunity employer in every sense of the term.Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Wanderlog is hiring a full-time engineer to help build and scale our web and mobile travel planning products. This is a permanent, full-time role reporting to the co-founders at Wanderlog.

Role details

  • Employment type: Full-time

  • Location: Remote — United States

  • Reports to: Co-founders

  • Salary range: $110,000-$170,000 USD, depending on experience

About Wanderlog

Wanderlog helps make leisure travel easier. We believe that travel makes the world better, and are building tools that lower the bar to it.

Our core product, built starting in 2019, is a travel planning app, but we’re also helping travelers book hotels (without hidden fees), providing them with information through pages such as best attractions and restaurants, and more.

We’re a small, engineering- and product-driven team building tools used by travelers worldwide.

Wanderlog was founded by twin brothers Peter Xu and Harry Yu, who previously built successful travel products before starting Wanderlog.

What you'll do

As an engineer, you’ll be responsible for owning portions of the product. You’ll be expected to:

  • Build new features on our website and mobile app. (Our stack is Javascript (Typescript): modern React on the web, React Native on mobile, and Node.js/Express on the server.)
  • Design and decide what to build based on what would help travelers and drive growth. You won’t be handed a spec; you’ll be coming up with it!
  • Build data pipelines to crawl, process, and synthesize data from various sources around the web.
  • Write tests and build out engineering infrastructure. Our code is fully typed (Typescript) and tested.
  • Debug and fix bugs and scale the infrastructure as it grows.
  • Review code written by other engineers.
  • Be fast and nimble: figure out the best way to build new features at the lowest cost in time and future technical debt.
What you might work on
  • New, user-friendly hotel booking interfaces that make finding a place to stay easier.
  • AI-powered tools that read articles and watch videos for you and summarize the places they mention.
  • Improvements to our React Native mobile app so that it runs faster on slower Android phones.
  • A Chrome extension to let travelers quickly compare possible places to visit, airfares, and hotels.
  • Better invite and collaboration tools to encourage people to use Wanderlog to get more friends to join them.
  • A better profile page that lets travelers on Wanderlog show off where they’ve been, see how many people they’ve helped, and follow other friends and their trips.
What it's like to work here

We’re an engineering- and product-heavy team. A typical week involves talking to users, prioritizing tasks, designing in Figma, and continuously building and shipping improvements.

Our values include putting travelers first, owning the product end-to-end, treating teammates with respect, and moving fast by being thoughtful about what we build.

We believe work should fit into your life. We also hold twice-annual travel off sites to collaborate more closely and enjoy visiting new places together.

Hiring process
  • Two short asynchronous programming challenges, including an automated coding assessment
  • A live coding interview with one of the founders
  • A half-day final-round virtual onsite conducted via video call

Requirements

  • Have at least 2 years of experience doing full-stack, product development work. We have a wide salary range, as we do want to accept a range of candidate experiences properly.
  • Are a Javascript developer comfortable with React and/or React Native.
  • Are a product person: you’ve built products end-to-end before, and really care about the people who use them.
  • Are comfortable with picking up various technologies for the task at hand. We quickly evaluate libraries and tools that could help our product, and variously use Redis, Elasticsearch, and Python as needed too.
  • Are entrepreneurial: excited about joining a small, high-growth team and talking to users, doing product and design, and wearing a variety of hats.
  • Love travel and believe in it as a positive force personally and for the world.

Benefits

  • Medical
  • Vision
  • Dental
  • FSA or HSA plans
  • Paid sick leave

jobs.excerpt: About the Company At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business.
jobs.description:
About the Company
At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business.

A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight.

Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer.

Meet the Team

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer – Camera Models, you will develop and deploy machine learning models that power camera-based perception for autonomous trucks. The Camera Models team builds and maintains core vision systems that enable the autonomy stack to understand the environment, detect and localize objects, and estimate scene structure from camera data.

Working closely with teams across perception, data, and infrastructure, you will own the development and improvement of robust, scalable camera-based models that support safe and reliable autonomous driving in real-world freight environments.
This role focuses on owning model development for scoped problem areas, improving system performance through iteration, and delivering production-ready machine learning solutions within the autonomy stack.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and deploy deep learning models for camera-based perception (e.g., object detection, segmentation, depth estimation, scene understanding)
  • Own end-to-end model development for scoped areas, from data curation and training to evaluation and deployment
  • Write production-quality ML code to support scalable training, evaluation, and inference pipelines
  • Analyze model performance across diverse driving scenarios, identify failure modes, and improve robustness and generalization
  • Contribute to and improve large-scale training pipelines, including dataset preparation, distributed training, and experiment tracking
  • Partner with data teams to improve dataset quality, including labeling strategies and coverage of edge cases
  • Collaborate with perception, simulation, and validation teams to evaluate and integrate models into the autonomy stack
  • Improve tooling, workflows, and infrastructure to accelerate experimentation and model iteration
  • Contribute to model architecture decisions and technical discussions within the team
  • Mentor junior engineers on implementation, debugging, and best practices

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related technical field with 6+ years of industry experience, OR Master’s degree with 3+ years OR PhD with 1+ years of experience
  • Experience developing and deploying deep learning models for computer vision or perception systems
  • Strong programming skills in Python and PyTorch, with experience writing production-quality ML code
  • Experience training and evaluating models using large-scale datasets and distributed compute environments
  • Solid understanding of modern deep learning architectures used in perception (e.g., CNNs, transformers, multi-task models)
  • Experience debugging model behavior, analyzing performance metrics, and improving model reliability
  • Ability to translate ambiguous problems into structured ML solutions and deliver independently
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally to integrate ML models into larger autonomy or robotics systems

Bonus Points:

  • Experience in autonomous driving, robotics, or simulation-based ML systems
  • Experience with multi-task learning or unified perception architectures
  • Experience with large-scale data pipelines, distributed training systems (e.g., Ray), or experiment management frameworks
  • Familiarity with camera calibration, geometric reasoning, or 3D perception from images (e.g., BEV, monocular depth, structure-from-motion)
  • Experience deploying ML models into production or real-world robotics systems

Work Location: For this position, we are open to hiring in either the Ann Arbor, MI OR Blacksburg, VA (U.S.) office work locations in a hybrid capacity. We are also open to hiring Remote in the United States

Perks of Being a Full-time Torc’r
Torc cares about our team members and we strive to provide benefits and resources to support their health, work/life balance, and future. Our culture is collaborative, energetic, and team focused. Torc offers:

  • A competitive compensation package that includes a bonus component and stock options
  • 100% paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees
  • 401K plan with a 6% employer match
  • Flexibility in schedule and generous paid vacation (available immediately after start date)
  • Company-wide holiday office closures
  • AD+D and Life Insurance

At Torc, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We celebrate the uniqueness of our Torc’rs and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, or disabilities.

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications listed for this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.
Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several geographic markets. Pay is based on a number of factors and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Torc's total compensation package will also include our corporate bonus and stock option plan. ROLE TITLE: Director, Prospect Strategy, Management, and Research

POSITION REPORTS TO: MD, Prospect Management & Research

PRIORITY APPLICATION DEADLINE: Friday, October 2nd at 11:59PM ET

LOCATION: Flexible/Remote


WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a member of the Prospect Strategy, Management, & Research (PSR) team, you will play a central role in strengthening TFA’s fundraising strategy by connecting high-quality prospect intelligence with disciplined portfolio and pipeline management. You will help set and execute an enterprise-wide vision for building healthy donor and prospect pools, optimizing fundraiser portfolios, and moving prospects through clear qualification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship stages. In this role, you will provide actionable research, capacity and inclination analysis, relationship mapping, due diligence, and portfolio insights that help frontline fundraisers focus on the right donors, at the right time, with the right strategy.


WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Prospect research support (45%)

  • Deliver timely, accurate, and actionable prospect research for assigned fundraising teams, including deep-dive profiles, meeting briefings, capacity ratings, inclination assessments, philanthropic interest analysis, board and relationship mapping, and strategy recommendations.
  • Lead proactive prospect discovery projects that identify new individual, foundation, corporate, and institutional prospects aligned with TFA priorities, fundraising goals, and enterprise-wide growth opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate, well-documented prospect and donor intelligence in Salesforce, including biographical, philanthropic, wealth, affiliation, relationship, engagement, and capacity data from internal and external sources.
  • Analyze and synthesize complex information from research databases, public records, internal giving history, relationship networks, and fundraiser knowledge into clear insights that inform cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship strategies.
  • Monitor ethical, legal, and privacy considerations related to prospect research, including evolving laws, regulations, and professional standards that affect the access, use, storage, and distribution of information.
  • Provide due diligence research and reputational risk insights to support responsible donor engagement and help monitor TFA’s prospect pipeline for potential concerns.

Prospect Management (45%)

  • Lead regular portfolio reviews with assigned fundraisers and development leaders to assess portfolio composition, stage distribution, pipeline health, qualification progress, next steps, and opportunities for strategic movement.
  • Recommend and manage prospect assignments, reassignments, qualification priorities, and disqualification decisions based on capacity, affinity, engagement, relationship strength, fundraiser bandwidth, and organizational priorities.
  • Track and support movement through the donor lifecycle, ensuring that prospect stages, strategies, opportunities, contact reports, and next steps are consistently documented and used to guide fundraising activity.
  • Evaluate prospecting, assignment, qualification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship processes to identify opportunities for greater consistency, accountability, efficiency, and fundraiser adoption.
  • Create and maintain healthy donor and prospect pools, balanced fundraiser portfolios, and robust pipelines that support revenue growth, campaign readiness, and long-term donor engagement.
  • Build clear reports, dashboards, and visual summaries that make portfolio data, pipeline trends, and prospect management recommendations accessible and actionable for fundraisers and leaders.

Team Membership (10%)

  • Participate in regular team meetings for both the Fundraising Operations team and the larger Development team.
  • Demonstrate the core values and commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusiveness.
  • Engage in Elevate, TFA’s performance review system, to drive performance, learning, and professional growth.

A WEEK IN THE LIFE

In a typical week, you may prepare a research briefing for a high-priority donor meeting, analyze portfolio and pipeline data ahead of a fundraiser review, recommend prospect assignments or stage updates in Salesforce, partner with development leaders to identify upgrade and discovery opportunities, and translate complex prospect intelligence into clear next steps that help fundraisers advance relationships. You may also monitor due diligence questions, update prospect records, and contribute to team conversations about strengthening prospect management systems, reporting, and adoption across the enterprise.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 4+ years of relevant experience in prospect development, prospect management, advancement services, fundraising operations, donor intelligence, prospect research, or a related field.
  • Experience partnering directly with fundraisers or other internal stakeholders to support portfolio strategy, prospect prioritization, relationship management, or fundraising outcomes.
  • Experience with prospect management practices, including portfolio reviews, prospect assignments, pipeline management, moves management, and/or donor lifecycle tracking.
  • Experience conducting prospect research and translating information into actionable insights or recommendations.
  • Experience working with a CRM or other system used to manage prospect, donor, or relationship information.
  • Strong understanding of data quality and the importance of accurate, accessible information for decision-making.
  • Ability to analyze and synthesize information from multiple sources and communicate it clearly to different audiences.
  • Strong attention to detail and discretion when working with confidential and sensitive information.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, stakeholders, and competing priorities in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
  • Curiosity and a continuous learning mindset, with a willingness to learn new systems, tools, and approaches.
  • Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to work through ambiguity and change.
  • Strong written, verbal, and relationship-building skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with Salesforce and/or Microsoft Dynamics or another fundraising CRM.
  • Experience with data analysis, reporting, dashboards, or data visualization.
  • Experience using prospect research platforms such as RelSci, iWave, LexisNexis, Wealth-X, Candid, or similar tools.
  • Ability to leverage emerging technologies, including AI, to improve prospect research, portfolio strategy, data analysis, or fundraising workflows.
  • Experience working across different areas of fundraising or Development, providing a broader understanding of fundraising strategy and operations.
  • Experience launching, improving, or innovating a process, tool, program, or approach beyond the immediate scope of your role.
  • Experience developing workplans, setting project direction, or bringing structure to ambiguous work.
  • Ability to tailor communications and recommendations to different audiences and support change management or systems adoption.
  • Experience presenting complex information through research profiles, briefings, portfolio summaries, dashboards, or other forms of data storytelling.
  • Familiarity with ethical standards and practices related to prospect research, including APRA principles.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office or comparable productivity tools.

YOUR FUTURE TEAM

The Director, Prospect Strategy, Management, and Research sits on the Fundraising Operations team, which is part of Teach For America’s Central Development team. The Development team builds and strengthens philanthropic partnerships by inspiring donors to invest in TFA’s work with students nationally and regionally. The Fundraising Operations team supports Teach For America’s enterprise-wide fundraising efforts by ensuring strong data, technology, reporting, analysis, gift operations, prospect research, and prospect management practices, and by helping fundraisers adopt the tools, insights, and systems that support effective donor engagement. The Fundraising Operations team is comprised of three sub-teams: (1) Data Governance, Reporting & Technology, (2) Gift Operations, and (3) Prospect Strategy, Management & Research. The Development team has members located across the country. While there is limited travel involved in this role for team meetings, most interactions will be conducted virtually.

YOUR COMPENSATION

The applicable salary range for each U.S.-based role is based on where the employee works and is aligned to one of 3 tiers according to a cost-of-labor index in that geographic area. Starting pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. New hires are typically brought into the organization at a salary between the range minimum and the salary range midpoint depending on qualifications, internal equity, and the budgeted amount for the role. The expected salary ranges for this role are set forth below. These ranges may be modified in the future.


Tier A: $74,300 - $97,500

Tier B: $81,000 - $106,300

Tier C: $87,600 - $115,000

jobs.excerpt: At Journal Technologies, we believe our technology can be a force for good in the world ensuring the proper and efficient functioning of some of the most foundational aspects of society - the courts and justice system.
jobs.description:
At Journal Technologies, we believe our technology can be a force for good in the world ensuring the proper and efficient functioning of some of the most foundational aspects of society - the courts and justice system.

We create and implement enterprise software that supports the administration of justice, currently in the United States, Canada, and Australia. While our eSeries product suite enables governments and their employees to deliver continued foundational court processes, our R&D focuses on leveraging emerging possibilities with technology to improve access and efficiency.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, Journal Technologies is a long-time, wholly-owned subsidiary of Daily Journal Corporation (NASDAQ: DJCO). We also have a major office in Logan, Utah, a team in Melbourne, Australia, an office in Victoria, Canada and a growing number of remote staff across North America.

Under our next generation of leadership, we're implementing a new vision for the company that prioritizes building an extraordinary workplace with empowered people at the heart of our business. Great people want to collaborate with great people, and we are actively looking for smart, motivated people who care deeply about the work they do.

Director of Solutions Architecture

Journal Technologies is seeking an experienced technical and justice-domain leader to establish and lead the Configuration Center of Excellence (CCoE).

The CCoE will define how Journal Technologies designs, configures, validates, and maintains customer solutions across the eSeries platform. The Director will establish configuration architecture, standards, technical governance, implementation patterns, training, and quality controls that improve system performance, reduce implementation risk, and create greater consistency across customer implementations.

This position requires extensive hands-on knowledge of software applications and a strong understanding of how justice agencies operate. The Director must understand both the technical capabilities of the platform and the business processes the platform supports, including case initiation, case processing, calendaring, hearings, financials, document management, disposition, reporting, interfaces, and downstream justice-partner exchanges.

The Director will serve as a senior technical authority for configuration practices across Journal Technologies and will work closely with Professional Services, Product Management, Engineering, Support, Cloud Operations, and the PMO.

The CCoE will support lifecycle and implementation teams by providing standards, architecture, technical leadership, training, and escalation support. Lifecycle teams remain accountable for delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Configuration Architecture and Standards

  • Establish and lead Journal Technologies’ Configuration Center of Excellence.
  • Define configuration architecture, engineering standards, and implementation methodologies for eSeries.
  • Establish clear standards for business rules, workflows, events, conditions, validations, system properties, forms, templates, financial configuration, security, interfaces, and other configurable platform components.
  • Define appropriate use of configuration, scripting, integration, and product functionality.
  • Establish patterns that prevent unnecessary customization and configuration technical debt.
  • Develop reference configurations, reusable patterns, templates, and implementation accelerators.
  • Establish configuration naming, documentation, versioning, promotion, and change-management standards.
  • Define standards for configuration performance, maintainability, supportability, and upgrade compatibility.

Technical Governance and Quality

  • The Director owns JTI’s enterprise configuration standards. CCoE standards apply across Professional Services and lifecycle teams unless an exception is approved through the established governance process. The Director has authority to require technical review and remediation of material configuration risks and to escalate unresolved readiness concerns before production deployment. Lifecycle leaders retain accountability for project delivery, customer commitments, staffing, schedules and budgets.
  • Establish technical review processes for complex or high-risk configuration.
  • Define configuration quality gates for implementation milestones, testing, production readiness, and go-live.
  • Establish standards for reviewing business rules, queries, integrations, workflows, and other configuration that can affect application performance or system stability.
  • Develop methods for identifying configuration related performance and scalability risks before Production deployment.
  • Partner with Cloud Operations, Engineering, and Support to analyze configuration-related incidents and convert lessons learned into improved standards.
  • Establish measurable configuration quality and adoption metrics.
  • Experience working within Agile teams or formal training in Scrum or Agile methodologies is considered a strong asset.

eSeries Technical Leadership

  • Serve as a senior technical authority for eSeries configuration across the various business units. 
  • Provide guidance to implementation teams on complex configuration and solution design decisions.
  • Assist teams with difficult configuration, performance, integration, and implementation issues.
  • Identify configurations that should use existing product capabilities instead of custom development.
  • Identify recurring customer requirements that should become standard product capabilities.
  • Maintain reference architectures for common court and justice-system implementation patterns.
  • Ensure configuration approaches account for application architecture, database performance, integration requirements, security, cloud deployment, and operational support. The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed in this job function. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties; additional responsibilities may be assigned.

Justice Domain Leadership

  • Ensure configuration standards reflect the operational requirements of courts and justice agencies.
  • Apply knowledge of justice system models when developing implementation standards.
  • Help implementation teams understand the business and operational consequences of configuration decisions.
  • Establish reusable implementation patterns for common processes and justice-system integrations.

Product and Engineering Partnership

  • Establish a structured feedback loop between implementation teams, Product Management, and Engineering.
  • Identify recurring implementation challenges caused by product gaps or configuration complexity.
  • Recommend product changes that reduce implementation effort and eliminate unnecessary custom configuration.
  • Work with Product Management to distinguish customer-specific requirements from capabilities that should become part of the standard product.
  • Provide field-based technical input into product architecture and roadmap discussions.
  • Evaluate new product capabilities and determine how configuration standards and implementation practices should change as the platforms evolve.

Technical Community and Capability

  • Lead the JTI Technical Lead Community across Implementation Specialists, Data Integration Developers, Solution Leads, and other technical delivery roles.
  • Establish competency expectations for technical implementation roles.
  • Develop structured technical onboarding and continuing education for eSeries.
  • Establish configuration certification or proficiency programs.
  • Conduct technical workshops, architecture reviews, configuration reviews, and mentoring sessions.
  • Build and maintain configuration playbooks, reference implementations, examples, and technical documentation.
  • Develop senior technical resources who can act as configuration authorities within lifecycle teams.

Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze implementation, Support, Production, and upgrade issues to identify recurring configuration problems.
  • Measure adoption of CCoE standards and identify areas requiring additional training or governance.
  • Reduce configuration complexity and technical debt across implementations.
  • Develop automation and tooling for configuration analysis, validation, migration, comparison, and quality assurance.
  • Use implementation experience to improve JTI’s implementation methodology and product capabilities.

jobs.excerpt: About the Role Buyer behavior is shifting.  Compliance leaders increasingly research vendors through AI answer engines - ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Copilot not just a page of blue links.
jobs.description:
About the Role
Buyer behavior is shifting. Compliance leaders increasingly research vendors through AI answer engines - ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Copilot not just a page of blue links. At the same time, our website is where interest becomes pipeline. This role brings both under one owner: a high-performing website that converts, and a deliberate strategy to be discovered, understood and cited by the engines our buyers now trust. You’ll be the person who turns “AEO” from a buzzword into a measurable, company-wide capability at MCO.

Responsibilities
Website & conversion
  • Own the strategy, roadmap and day-to-day performance of mycomplianceoffice.com, with conversion as the primary success metric.
  • Drive conversion rate optimization (CRO): hypothesis-led A/B and multivariate testing, funnel analysis, form and CTA optimization, and continuous improvement of high-intent paths (demo requests, content downloads, contact).
  • Design and optimize landing pages and conversion journeys in partnership with demand generation, so every campaign lands somewhere built to convert.
  • Manage site performance and UX fundamentals - Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile experience, accessibility, information architecture.
  • Own the analytics picture: GA4, heatmaps/session tools, HubSpot reporting; translate data into a prioritized backlog of experiments and fixes.
  • Manage the CMS (HubSpot CMS) and coordinate any external developers, designers or agencies.

AEO leadership
Be the in-house expert
  • Serve as MCO’s authority on Answer Engine Optimization how AI answer engines discover, interpret, trust and cite sources and stay ahead of a fast-moving discipline.
  • Make our content citable and machine-readable: clear, factual, well-structured answers; structured data / schema markup; entity and topical authority; FAQ and comparison formats; technical signals for AI crawlers (e.g., robots directives, llms.txt, crawlability).
  • Strengthen off-site presence that AI engines pull from review platforms (e.g., G2), authoritative third-party sources, and digital PR so MCO shows up credibly beyond our own domain.
Be the evangelist
  • Build internal awareness and buy-in for AEO across marketing, product marketing, content, sales and leadership.
  • Translate AEO from abstract concept into concrete, “here’s why it matters to your work” terms for each audience.
Educate the company
  • Create and run enablement guidelines, playbooks, lunch-and-learns that teach teams what AEO is and the specific things they can do to help (how to write citable content, when to add structured data, how product and sales language shapes what engines surface).
Prioritize the roadmap
  • Own and sequence the AEO backlog: identify the high-intent compliance questions our buyers ask engines, find where MCO is (and isn’t) being surfaced, and prioritize the content, technical and off-site work that moves the narrative fastest.
  • Partner with content and product marketing to shape assets specifically designed to be discovered and cited.
Measure and monitor
  • Stand up AEO measurement from scratch: track MCO’s visibility, mentions, citations and share of voice in AI answers across the key engines; monitor AI-driven referral traffic; benchmark against competitors.
  • Report on AEO performance to marketing leadership and connect it, where possible, to pipeline influence.

Experience and Skills
  • 5+ years in digital marketing, web/SEO, or growth marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS.
  • Demonstrated conversion/CRO results you’ve run experiments that measurably improved website performance, not just managed a site.
  • Strong SEO foundation that you’re actively evolving toward AEO / generative search, with a real point of view on how AI is changing discovery.
  • Fluency with web analytics and experimentation tools (GA4, heatmaps, A/B testing) and comfort turning data into prioritized action.
  • Hands-on CMS experience and a working understanding of structured data/schema and technical on-page fundamentals.
  • Excellent communicator who can teach a non-technical audience and rally cross-functional teams around a new idea.

Nice to Have
  • Experience marketing to financial services, compliance, risk or other regulated, considered-purchase buyers.
  • HubSpot (CMS and Marketing Hub) experience.
  • Early, hands-on experience with AEO/GEO tooling and AI-answer monitoring.
  • Comfort working with developers and briefing/managing agencies.

About MCO (MyComplianceOffice)
MCO is a global leader dedicated to empowering Financial Services firms to manage compliance programs with ease and efficiency. Our mission is to foster a fair, transparent, and trusted financial environment worldwide by helping organizations meet their regulatory obligations to society.

At the heart of MCO’s offering is our unique, unified platform, which seamlessly integrates compliance monitoring and data into a single, comprehensive view. This holistic approach enables firms to maintain compliance across all internal systems, structures, and processes—ensuring peace of mind in an ever-evolving regulatory landscape.

Headquartered in Dublin, MCO has an international footprint, with offices in London, Singapore, Hyderabad, New York, Chicago, Fort Worth, Switzerland, South Africa, Slovenia, and the UAE. Since our founding in 2008, we have evolved from a specialist provider of “best of breed” employee compliance solutions to a pioneer in integrated compliance technology.

Today, our team of over 400 professionals supports more than 1.5 million users in 128 countries. Our diverse customer base includes small businesses, large enterprises, four of the world’s top ten asset managers, twenty of the top seventy-five global banks, and three of the top five investment banks for global M&A transactions.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
jobs.excerpt: We’re growing fast, and our Talent Team needs to grow with us.
jobs.description:
We’re growing fast, and our Talent Team needs to grow with us.

We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who gets curious when a profile is hard to find. Someone who enjoys digging into unfamiliar talent markets, figuring out where the right people are, and finding creative ways to reach them, whether that means a specialized industry expert or a SaaS hire.

You’re naturally curious, know how to turn an unfamiliar profile into a smart sourcing strategy, and take ownership of your pipeline from first search to signed offer. Most importantly, you want your work to have a real influence on who joins Azumuta and how we grow.

If that sounds like you, this could be your seat.

⚙️ About Azumuta

Manufacturing is going through its biggest transformation in decades, and we’re right at the center of it.

Since 2016, Azumuta has helped leading manufacturers across Europe and North America digitize their operations. Now we’re taking that further with AI that generates work instructions automatically, assists operators in real time, and removes repetitive administrative work.

We’re not simply digitizing old processes. We’re rethinking how manufacturing gets done.

And as we grow, the people we bring on board will determine how far we can take that mission. That’s where you come in.

🚀 What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own searches from the start. Get to the heart of each role, understand the recruitment priority, challenge assumptions where needed, and align with hiring managers on the candidate profile and sourcing strategy before starting your search.

  • Run the full recruitment cycle. Take ownership of sourcing, screening, interviewing, case assignments, candidate follow up, and offer negotiations. Whether you’re hiring for a highly specialized profile or a more familiar SaaS role, you bring the same level of rigor and care.

  • Create a candidate experience that feels like Azumuta. Make sure every candidate gets a transparent, engaging, and respectful experience, whether they ultimately join us or not.

  • Become a trusted partner to hiring managers. Advise them on recruitment best practices, help sharpen candidate profiles, train them in competency based interviewing, and support them in making better hiring decisions.

  • Get creative with sourcing. Use tools, networks, communities, partnerships, and your own curiosity to reach people who are not actively looking. Keep experimenting with new approaches and continuously improve how we find specialist and hard to reach talent.

  • Know your talent markets. Build an understanding of where the best candidates are, what motivates them, and how the market is evolving. Turn that knowledge into better searches and smarter hiring decisions.

  • Help build our employer brand. Contribute to national and international recruitment campaigns and initiatives that make the right people curious about Azumuta.

  • Use data to get better. Track recruitment activity and pipeline performance, identify what is and isn’t working, and turn those insights into concrete improvements.

💜 What’s In It for You

We’re a small team doing big things in a market that’s ready for change. Join us and you’ll have a real seat at the table, meaningful ownership, and the opportunity to shape the team behind Azumuta.

That means:

  • Impact from day one. The people you bring in will directly influence our growth, and your ideas will help shape how we recruit as we scale.

  • Room to build. This isn’t a role where every process has already been defined. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, improve our sourcing approach, and help build a recruitment function that can grow with the company.

  • A scale up environment with solid roots. Work in a fast paced international company where autonomy, ownership, and new ideas are genuinely encouraged.

  • A fun, ambitious team. Join colleagues who are building Azumuta’s next chapter together, with plenty of milestones and questionable dad jokes along the way.

  • A visible role in our employer brand. Represent Azumuta at events and initiatives and help strengthen our presence in the tech and manufacturing ecosystem

Requirements

🎯 You’d Be a Great Fit If You Have

  • Around 3 years of recruitment experience, with strong hands on sourcing experience and a track record of looking beyond the obvious channels.

  • Experience recruiting niche, specialist, or hard to find profiles, beyond standard SaaS or tech roles. When there’s no obvious talent pool, you know how to map the market and build a search strategy from scratch.

  • A genuine hunter mindset. You enjoy research, outreach, experimentation, and the challenge of finding someone who isn’t sitting in every recruiter’s LinkedIn search.

  • Strong judgment and curiosity. You ask the questions needed to really understand a role rather than simply working from a job description.

  • A direct and transparent communication style. You give candidates and hiring managers the real picture, including when it isn’t necessarily what they want to hear.

  • A strong sense of ownership. You manage your searches proactively, keep things moving, and don’t wait to be told what comes next.

  • The ability to work autonomously and stay organized in a fast moving scale up environment where priorities can evolve quickly.

Ready to find the people who will build what’s next?

We’d love to hear from you.

Send us a short note about why this role fits where you are in your career. No generic cover letter needed. We’d much rather hear from you.

Highlights

🚀 Ready to shape the future of manufacturing SaaS with us? Apply now and help us build the team that will keep Azumuta scaling!

jobs.excerpt: About Accelerant Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers.
jobs.description:
About Accelerant

Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers. Accelerant was founded in 2018 by a group of longtime insurance industry executives and technology experts who shared a vision of rebuilding the way risk is exchanged – so that it works better, for everyone. The Accelerant risk exchange does business across more than 20 different countries and 250 specialty products, and we are proud that our insurers have been awarded an AM Best A- (Excellent) rating. For more information, please visit .

Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)

Location: Remote (flexible within U.S.)

The Role

We're building business solutions across the enterprise at Accelerant, and we need quality engineering to scale and keep up. You'll help drive the test automation strategy and implementation across our enterprise stack: Salesforce, MuleSoft, D365 and Reporting. You are a key decider about what gets automated, how it gets covered, and what gets pushed back on engineering.

We need someone who can scale it, harden it, expand its reach into systems that have never had real QA coverage, and build modern, AI-assisted QA tooling that lets our team expand its impact.

You'll partner closely with engineering, product, and business teams to identify where quality is leaking, expand automation breadth and depth, and build specialized QA agents that reduce the manual toil. You own end-to-end delivery of the test automation function.

This Is a High-Autonomy, High-Impact Role for Someone Who:

  • Sees a flaky test or a coverage gap and cannot leave it alone. Excels at iterating and shipping the right framework, not the perfect one.
  • Has scaled a real test automation framework in production — not just written tests against one.
  • Has built with Playwright, modern CI, and AI coding assistants long enough to have strong opinions about what fits our needs.
  • Can prototype a QA agent in Cursor and iterate as they go.
  • Operates with autonomy, and can carry a technical discussion on framework design, test architecture, and tradeoffs.
  • Is genuinely curious about applying emerging AI to QA.

What You'll Do

Drive the test automation initiative

  • Own the test automation roadmap end to end. Set the strategy, prioritize the work, and drive execution across the team. You'll partner with QA and engineering on what we automate, how, and when.

Scale the foundational framework

  • A Playwright/JavaScript framework is already built. Take it from foundational to enterprise-grade, with a focus on performance, stability, and reusability.

Expand coverage breadth and depth

  • Push automation into areas that may not have any QA support today, and deepen regression coverage on core systems: Salesforce, MuleSoft, D365 Power Apps, D365 F&O, DCR, and Tagetik.

Implement a scalable design and review process

  • Help build the design and review process that keeps automation quality high as the suite and the team grow - test design standards, code review norms, framework contribution guidelines.

Scale test execution and reporting

  • Build the infrastructure that runs tests fast, reports results clearly, and surfaces signal over noise. Parallel execution, smart retries, actionable dashboards.

Build specialized QA agents using Cursor AI

  • Design and ship AI agents for performance testing, regression analysis, and defect triage (to name a few). Use Cursor as your build environment. Treat the agents as products solving specific problems.

Host QA agents on the AI fabric

  • Partner with the AI platform team to deploy your agents on the org's AI fabric. Make them discoverable, governed, and reusable across functions.

What You'll Bring

Must-Haves

  • Proven experience designing and scaling test automation frameworks in production.
  • Deep hands-on expertise with Playwright and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience automating against complex enterprise SaaS - ideally Salesforce, MuleSoft, D365 (Power Apps and/or F&O).
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs and AI coding assistants - Cursor in particular. Bonus if you've built and deployed agents.
  • Solid grasp of API testing, contract testing, and integration testing patterns - especially across layers like MuleSoft.
  • Ability to define test strategy, coverage targets, and quality metrics - and defend them to engineering leadership and the business.
  • Strong communication skills - you can explain a flaky-test root cause to a junior engineer and a coverage gap to a product lead.
  • Demonstrated bias for action and ability to operate autonomously in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in insurance, fintech, or other regulated financial services industries.
  • Familiarity with insurance concepts (underwriting, claims, actuarial workflows) or willingness to learn them deeply.
  • Strong working knowledge of CI/CD, and reporting/observability for test suites.
  • Experience deploying AI agents on an internal AI platform or fabric (governance, eval harnesses, prompt/version management).

·Performance testing background.

Why This Role

You won't be buried in a QA backlog writing yet another regression script. You'll set the automation strategy, scale the framework, and build the QA tooling that defines how this company ships and tests business solutions for the next decade. You'll have direct access to engineering and business leadership, a mandate to move fast, and the autonomy to choose your own tools and approach. If you've been waiting for a role where you can prove what modern AI-enabled QA can actually do inside a real company, this is it.

jobs.description:
Übersicht

Position: Deal Execution Manager im E-Commerce M&A bei BRANDCIRCLE

Arbeitszeit: >40 Stunden pro Woche

Vergütung: 30,00€ - 40,00€ pro Stunde plus attraktive erfolgsabhängige Bonuszahlungen (per Vollzeitanstellung; Einarbeitung auch auf Freelance-Basis/Rechnung möglich)

Ort: 100% Remote (Meetings/Treffen im Nürnberger Office möglich, aber nicht notwendig)

Verfügbarkeit: Ab sofort

Über uns

BRANDCIRCLE ist eine aufstrebende E-Commerce M&A Beratungs-Boutique mit Fokus auf der Abwicklung von M&A-Deals für Online-Händler in der Regel im Bereich von 2-40 Millionen € Jahresumsatz.

Wir als BRANDCIRCLE übernehmen eine strategische und operative Beratertätigkeit beim Verkauf von Assets und/oder Unternehmensanteilen für E-Commerce-Unternehmer, um den höchstmöglichen Verkaufswert für unsere Kunden zu erzielen. Für unsere Alumni, also Kunden, die erfolgreich gemeinsam mit uns verkauft haben, übernehmen wir auch das Management von Zukäufen anderer Marken/Unternehmen – die Tätigkeit erstreckt sich von der Akquise, über die Verhandlung und Dokumentenprüfung bis hin zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.

Wir streben danach, unseren Kunden die bestmögliche Erfahrung mit unserer Beratung zu bieten. Dies erreichen wir durch exzellente Ergebnisse im Unternehmensverkauf und um dies zu schaffen, ist für uns eine vertrauensvolle, offene und zuverlässige Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden von zentraler Bedeutung.

Unser Prinzip: Built by Operators. Executed by Dealmakers. Wir sind keine klassische M&A-Boutique – wir sind Unternehmer, die selbst Marken aufgebaut und verkauft haben. Wir verstehen KPIs, Unit Economics und Pain Points unserer Kunden, weil wir sie selbst erlebt haben. Brandcircle versteht sich als Ökosystem, das Qualität und Kapital systematisch zusammenführt.

Aktuell suchen wir einen Deal Execution Manager (m/w/d), der unsere M&A-Mandate operativ orchestriert und unseren Deal Lead Lucas Beier substantiell entlastet – ohne dabei Geschwindigkeit oder Deal-Qualität zu verlieren.

Du bist der operative Motor jedes Mandats: Du treibst mehrere Live-Deals parallel durch unser D4U-EXIT-System (Optimierungsprozess, Datenraum, Investorenbriefing, Angebotsverhandlung, LOI, Due Diligence, Signing/Migration), steuerst unsere Inhouse-Teams (Finance, Ops, Sales, Marketing/PR) aus und stellst sicher, dass keine Bälle fallen. Strategie, Verhandlungsdesign und finale Entscheidungen bleiben bei Lucas und Christoph – Du bist die Execution-Schicht dazwischen, mit klarem Wachstumspfad in Richtung eigenständiger Mandatsführung.

KI ist dabei für uns kein Buzzword – sie ist unser operativer Hebel. Wir arbeiten täglich mit Claude, n8n und Make, um M&A-Prozesse zu automatisieren, die andere noch manuell abarbeiten. Von KI-gestützter Käufer-Recherche über automatisierte Financial-Analysen bis hin zu intelligenten Outreach-Sequenzen – wir denken Automatisierung in jeder Phase unseres D4U-EXIT-Systems. Wir suchen jemanden, der diesen Hebel nicht nur akzeptiert, sondern aktiv für sich nutzt.

Wir sind ein erfolgsorientiertes Unternehmen und folgen dem Prinzip „Hire for attitude, train for skill" und bilden Dich in allen relevanten Dingen aus. Von Vorteil ist es, wenn Du die gleiche Sprache sprichst wie wir – und zwar nicht nur „E-Commerce M&A", sondern auch fließend Claude. In unserem Arbeitsalltag sind wir von der Lösung zu 100% Remote arbeiten zu können überzeugt und garantieren somit eine hohe Flexibilität!

Wenn Du Lust hast, M&A-Mandate operativ zu treiben, mit KI in jeder Phase echte Hebel zu setzen und vollen Einsatz für unsere Kunden zu geben, dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! :)

Aufgaben

  • Deal-Orchestrierung über alle Phasen: Du steuerst die operative Dealabwicklung über alle Phasen unseres D4U-EXIT-Systems – von Optimierungsprozess, Datenraum-Setup und Investorenbriefing über Angebotsverhandlung, LOI, Due Diligence bis zu Signing und Migration. Du sorgst dafür, dass Schnittstellen sauber laufen und keine Themen verschleppt werden.
  • Mandanten- und Käuferkontakt: Du begleitest Mandanten- und Käufergespräche, übernimmst eigenständige Statusupdates und treibst mit konsequentem Push und Reminder-Management Käufer und deren Teams durch die DD. Im ersten Jahr in Co-Lead mit Lucas, mit wachsender Eigenverantwortung bis hin zur eigenständigen Übernahme kompletter Mandate.
  • Zeit- und Projektmanagement: Du taktest die Mandate zeitlich ein, trackst Meilensteine und koordinierst im Backend über Monday und unseren Performance-Tracker. Pünktlichkeit, Verbindlichkeit und sauberes Tracking sind Dein Standard.
  • Steuerung der Inhouse-Teams: Du steuerst unsere spezialisierten Fachteams (Finance & Tax, E-Commerce & Operations, Deal-Management, Marketing & PR) modular pro Mandat aus.
  • KI-gestütztes Arbeiten: Du nutzt aktiv unseren internen AI-Stack (Claude, GPT n8n, Make, etc.) zur Effizienzsteigerung Deiner eigenen Deal-Workflows. Du arbeitest Dich über KI-aufbereitete Wissensbestände und Aufzeichnungen schnell in unsere Systeme ein und denkst Workflows proaktiv weiter.
  • Unterlagen & Verhandlungsbegleitung: Du bereitest Käuferangebote auf und vergleichst sie, begleitest LOI- und Kaufvertrags-Verhandlungen und unterstützt das Käufermanagement und die Einwandbehandlung in der Due Diligence.

Qualifikation

Hard Skills:

  • Erste M&A-Berührung: ein abgeschlossenes M&A-Praktikum oder eine erste Festanstellung mit Deal-Bezug reicht aus. Grundbegriffe und Prozesslogik (LOI, DD, SPA, Datenraum) müssen sitzen.
  • Sehr hohe Tool- und KI-Affinität: schnelle Einarbeitung in Monday, Google Workspace, Loom, Performance-Tracker und unseren AI-Stack (Claude, n8n, Make). Eigenständige Nutzung von KI für Recherche, Aufbereitung und Workflow-Automation – keine Berührungsängste.
  • Nice-to-Have: E-Commerce-Domänenkenntnis (Amazon FBA, Shopify, D2C, TACOS/ROAS, Sellerboard, Supply-Chain-Mechanik) – falls nicht vorhanden, bauen wir das im Onboarding über externen E-Commerce-Kurs und internen Hardbeat Sales- und Marketing-Kurs auf.
  • Nice-to-Have: 1 bis 4 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einem deal-nahen Umfeld – klassische Quellen: M&A-Boutique, Investment Banking, Big4 Transaction Services, FBA-Aggregator, Strategy Consulting, Founders Associate / Chief of Staff oder Investment Manager bei einem E-Commerce-Investor.
  • Nice-to-Have: vertiefte M&A-Erfahrung mit deutscher LOI-, SPA- und APA-Vertragslogik sowie erste Einblicke in die E-Commerce-Investorenszene (strategische Käufer, FBA-Aggregatoren, Family Offices, kleinere PE-Häuser).
  • Erfahrung mit Projektmanagement-Tools (Monday, Notion, Asana o.ä.)
  • Deutschkenntnisse: Muttersprachler
  • Englischkenntnisse: Fließend

Soft Skills:

  • Sehr hohe Selbstorganisation: Du trackst mehrere Live-Deals parallel, ohne dass Bälle fallen. Pünktlichkeit und Verbindlichkeit sind für Dich nicht verhandelbar.
  • Ausgeprägter Kommunikationswille: aktives Status-Reporting, proaktives Eskalieren, sauberer schriftlicher und mündlicher Ausdruck. Du hältst Mandanten, Käufer und das interne Team transparent auf Stand.
  • Nüchtern und deal-erhaltend: Du sorgst strukturell dafür, dass Deals zustande kommen, statt um den letzten Cent zu feilschen. Du darfst bewusst etwas defensiver agieren als Lucas – Information auffangen, Lucas macht im Anschluss als Senior den Extra-Push.
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe, um Dich in komplexe Deal-Konstellationen, Käufer-Logiken und M&A-Themen einzudenken
  • Offener und vertrauensvoller Umgang und hohes Maß an Loyalität – Du arbeitest direkt mit Mandanten an einem der wichtigsten Themen ihres unternehmerischen Lebens
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Organisationstalent (auch bei der gleichzeitigen Steuerung mehrerer Projekte)
  • Hohes Durchhaltevermögen, Ehrgeiz und Selbstbewusstsein
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe, um sich in komplexe Business-Prozesse und M&A-Themen einzudenken
  • Positive Ausstrahlung und Grundhaltung zum Leben
  • Bereitschaft, wenn notwendig, die Extra-Meile zu gehen

FAZIT: Wir suchen Menschen und keine Abschlüsse

Benefits

  • Einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns und wir mit ihr wachsen.
  • Tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang und motivieren uns gegenseitig Bestleistungen zu erzielen und persönlich zu wachsen.
  • Wir sind ein Team: Wir haben flache Hierarchien, eine offene Feedbackkultur und ein jährliches gemeinsames Team Event, das du nicht verpassen möchtest.
  • Einblick in echte Deals: Du arbeitest nicht an abstrakten Projekten, sondern automatisierst Prozesse für echte M&A-Transaktionen im Millionenbereich – inklusive Kontakt zu erfolgreichen E-Commerce-Gründern und Investoren.
  • Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Extrem steile Lernkurve an der Schnittstelle von KI, Automatisierung und M&A – drei der spannendsten Bereiche der Arbeitswelt gerade. Du sammelst Erfahrung, die am Markt extrem gefragt ist.
  • Attraktive Zukunftsaussichten: Mittelfristige Möglichkeit auf eine Führungsrolle samt exzellenter Bezahlung, zum Teil auf Provisionsbasis.
  • Moderne Arbeitsgeräte: Wir stellen Dir den Laptop deiner Wahl, wobei wir persönlich Apple-Fans sind. :)

This role operates at two altitudes: partnering with marketing leadership to assist in planning what the business needs from its data at a high level, and then personally executing the analysis, reporting, and dashboard development to deliver it. We’re looking for a motivated self-starter who ramps quickly on new businesses, industries, and datasets, sets a high bar for accuracy, and is equally comfortable presenting to executives and writing the SQL themselves.

Salary - $110k - $120k

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Marketing & Business Analytics

  • Analyze customer acquisition performance across paid search, display, affiliate, and organic channels — spend efficiency, conversion rates, cost per acquisition, and cost per subscriber — and recommend optimizations to the performance marketing team.

  • Analyze A/B and pricing test results to guide decisions on page content, UX, offers, and pricing.
  • Investigate anomalies in traffic, conversion, and revenue data; distinguish real business changes from tracking or attribution artifacts before findings reach stakeholders.

Reporting & BI Development

  • Retrieve and aggregate data from multiple sources (web analytics, ad platforms, billing/subscription systems, internal databases) into clear, actionable reporting for stakeholders at all levels.
  • Design, build, and maintain automated dashboards and reporting solutions in our BI platform (Domo), migrating existing manual and legacy reporting into governed, automated pipelines.

Collaboration & Planning

  • Plan the reporting and analytics roadmap at a high level with business owners, then prioritize and execute the work individually and with BI contractors.

Basic Qualifications & Skills
