jobs.description:
At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. Whether you’re looking to start your career or make a change, talk to us and see how you can elevate the power of your work at Iron Mountain.

We provide expert, sustainable solutions in records and information management, digital transformation services, data centers, asset lifecycle management, and fine art storage, handling, and logistics. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways.

Are you curious about being part of our growth stor​y while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.

Iron Mountain is seeking a strategic Senior Account Executive for the DOW – US Navy, US Marine Corps & Space Force to join our Iron Mountain Government Solutions (IMGS) / North America Public Sector team.


In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to drive digital transformation and IT modernization across key defense portfolios including the US Navy, US Marine Corps, and Space Force. Here, your executive sales expertise and federal domain knowledge will help defense leaders assess operational bottlenecks, modernize legacy systems, and deploy scalable data-driven capabilities. You will play a vital role in connecting mission outcomes with secure technology solutions, helping protect and activate critical defense information assets.


What You’ll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Drive Account Strategy & Pipeline Growth: Develop and execute tailored account strategies across the US Navy, USMC, and Space Force to build a high-value pipeline and consistently achieve revenue targets.
  • Lead Consultative Sales Pursuits: Identify and qualify net-new opportunities to convert manual paper workflows and fragmented data repositories into modernized digital solutions.
  • Manage End-to-End Deal Execution: Guide the complete sales cycle from discovery to contract negotiation, collaborating with internal legal, commercial, and leadership teams to close profitable agreements.
  • Shape Proposal Strategy: Lead technical input for RFIs and RFPs, crafting mission-aligned value propositions that maximize win probability for defense contracts.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with Solution Architects, Capture Managers, and channel partners while maintaining accurate opportunity tracking in Salesforce.

What You’ll Bring

The ideal candidate will have:

  • 7+ years of direct federal government sales experience managing large-scale (>$50M) complex IT solution opportunities within the DoD/DoW sector.
  • Strong knowledge of information governance, SaaS content management, electronic document capture, data analytics, and workflow automation.
  • Proven ability in consultative selling, account strategy development, and negotiating with senior federal decision-makers, including flag officers.
  • Demonstrated expertise in leading matrixed internal teams and managing complex capture lifecycles.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and executive presentation skills grounded in strategic selling methodologies.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with experience.
  • Flexible work options/alternative work options to support work–life balance.
  • Comprehensive health, wellness, and retirement plans.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth.

Ready to help modernize defense capabilities and advance critical federal missions? Click apply to connect with our team today!

jobs.description:
Career Category

Information Systems

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Senior UI Developer, AI Studio


What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will offer a unique opportunity to join a fun, innovative engineering team within the AI & Data Science (AI&D) organization. You will own the experience for pre-defined AI products, from understanding user needs and shaping UX designs through interaction design, UI implementation, launch, stabilization, support transition, adoption and measurable outcome.

You will remain hands-on while connecting user discovery, UX design and frontend decisions to turn complex business needs and AI capabilities into secure, accessible, intuitive and reusable user experiences. You will partner with product, backend, data and ML teams to translate designs into production interfaces integrated with APIs, services, data and AI capabilities. Within Applied AI, AI Studio turns prioritized business demand into governed, reusable AI assets with accountable ownership and measurable value across software, data, automation, machine learning, Generative AI, RAG, bounded agents, evaluation, observability and lifecycle operations.


Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Lead user-centred discovery with product and UX partners: define user needs, workflows, roles, intended use, baseline, acceptance criteria, accessibility needs, adoption path, operating owner, value hypothesis and measurable technical and business outcomes.
  • Translate user research, journeys, workflows, rules, handoffs, exceptions, data dependencies and human decision points into clear UX designs, interaction patterns, prototypes and implementable UI requirements.
  • Own the translation of UX designs into responsive UI frontend architecture across human-AI experience, design systems, component composition, state, secure sessions, accessibility, browser performance, API integration, telemetry and graceful failure.
  • Lead modern UI delivery using JavaScript or TypeScript and React, Next.js or comparable component-based frameworks; turn UX designs and prototypes into accessible, performant production interfaces, and contribute full-stack expertise to API contracts, integrations, data flows and production support as needed.
  • Design and implement human-AI UX and UI experiences that integrate model services, LLMs, RAG, search, agents, BI and deterministic automation with access-aware data, clear loading and error states, evidence, human control, feedback and traceable outcomes.
  • Establish risk-based UI, accessibility, integration and end-to-end testing; contribute to CI/CD, staged release, telemetry, rollback, incident response, browser performance, runbooks and support ownership.
  • Coordinate governance and GxP controls, create reusable UI components, patterns and playbooks, lead root-cause analysis, measure adoption and experience quality, mentor engineers and improve frontend delivery practices.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a person with these qualifications


Basic Qualifications and Experience:

  • Doctorate Degree and 1 year of experience in Computer Science, IT or related field OR
  • Master’s degree with 8 - 10 years of experience in Computer Science, IT or related field OR
  • Bachelor’s degree with 10 - 12 years of experience in Computer Science, IT or related field OR
  • Diploma with 12 - 14 years of experience in Computer Science, IT or related field

UX design, frontend and human-AI engineering: User research, journeys, information architecture, interaction design, wireframes, prototypes, accessible frontend architecture, component design, state, forms, secure sessions, streaming, review, correction, approval, uncertainty, feedback, telemetry and recoverable failure.

  • Full-stack integration and application architecture: API contracts, services, events, workflows, persistence, enterprise integrations, data flows, authentication, authorization, resilience and supportable user experiences.
  • AI-enabled product experiences: Production integration of predictive ML, foundation models, embeddings, vector or graph retrieval, RAG, structured output, bounded agents, document or vision capabilities, BI and deterministic workflows with clear human oversight.
  • Testing, cloud, DevSecOps and reliability: Representative testing and AI evaluation, repository governance, architecture decisions, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, quality gates, staged release, SLOs, observability, incidents, rollback, disaster recovery and FinOps.
  • Security, Responsible AI and regulated delivery: Identity, authorization, least privilege, tenant isolation, secrets, OWASP, supply-chain controls, privacy, threat modeling, prompt/tool safeguards, validation, auditability, accessibility and GxP evidence.

Must-Have Skills:

  • Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of UX design and UI delivery for at least one production web application, digital product or substantial user-interface workstream that delivered a measurable outcome.
  • Strong hands-on proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML and CSS, with experience translating UX designs into responsive, accessible interfaces using React, Next.js or a comparable component-based framework.
  • Working full-stack experience with APIs, integrations, data flows and production support, with the ability to partner with backend, data and ML specialists on deeper service, model, RAG, agent and MLOps decisions.

Preferred Skills:

  • UX design and advanced frontend platforms: Experience with user research, journey mapping, interaction design, wireframing, prototyping, design systems, React, Next.js or comparable rendering patterns, multimodal or collaborative interfaces, data visualization, advanced accessibility and safe AI review or approval experiences.
  • Enterprise integration and full-stack delivery: Experience with API gateways, REST or GraphQL APIs, event platforms, durable workflows, stream processing, service mesh, asynchronous updates and enterprise integration architecture.
  • Advanced AI and automation engineering: Experience with vector or graph databases, graph or multimodal retrieval, model and agent gateways, MCP-style tool integration, durable agents, agent evaluation, process mining, UiPath or n8n.
  • Cloud, platform and developer experience: Experience with AWS, Bedrock or SageMaker, Databricks, Spark, Kubernetes, serverless services, infrastructure as code, OpenTelemetry, policy as code or internal developer platforms.
  • Regulated systems and technical breadth: Experience delivering GxP-relevant, validated, pharmaceutical, healthcare or other high-impact systems and evaluating emerging technologies pragmatically.

Product thinking and ability to connect user research, UX design, accessibility and frontend delivery decisions to measurable user, workflow and business value.

  • Strong technical leadership, mentoring and ownership while remaining hands-on.
  • Excellent analytical judgment, troubleshooting and clear communication of evidence, limitations and trade-offs.
  • Cross-functional leadership and close partnership with product, business, UX, architecture, backend, ML, platform and control functions.
  • Pragmatism, resilience and continuous improvement through incidents, feedback, reuse and measured outcomes.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

Job Description

ACTIVE Network, a Global Payments Company, is seeking a talented Account Manager to drive revenue through successful management and growth of their assigned book of business. S/he will manage a high volume of existing clients worth over $7M in revenue by communicating product/services updates, identifying product and client training gaps, ensure the delivery of quality customer and technical services, and resolve attrition issues to renew the client’s business. Account Managers are expected to drive continued market and competitive learning through research and customer outreach, as well as report findings to the team at regular intervals to maintain strong and ever-evolving market knowledge among entire team.


Responsibilities:

  • Drive revenue through minimizing customer attrition and increasing sales to account base.
  • Meet and exceed assigned quota targets.
  • Quote and sell software and services to existing customer accounts.
  • Manage contract renewals for an assigned book of business.
  • Develop and maintain a business consultant relationship with client decision-makers in higher revenue accounts.
  • Analyze client business for new opportunities, suggesting relevant products and services, and presenting market-specific content valuable to client growth.
  • Build relationships with contacts across the organization to drive retention and mitigate attrition risk, primarily through regular, proactive contact.
  • Relay market knowledge and client expertise to influence internal stakeholders with the intent of securing ACTIVE’s position in the market.
  • Improve customer satisfaction and reduce attrition.
  • Identify root causes of client “pain points” and issues.
  • Liaise between teams to facilitate resolution of technical issues.
  • Early identification of at-risk clients and escalate potential risks or challenges to manager.
  • Handle messaging and objection handling with clients regarding technical issues.


Requirements:

  • 3-5 years’ experience in a previous Account Management or Customer Success position preferred
  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Proven experience and success in SaaS based market, preferable in a software sales setting
  • Advanced communication (oral and written), objection-handling, and conflict management skills
  • Ability to leverage technology tools to fuel organization, efficiency, and productivity; advanced use of Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word preferred
  • Experience with using Salesforce.com is a plus
  • Skilled in public speaking; can confidently create and deliver presentations to both client and internal audiences
  • Ability to adapt and respond quickly to change
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize and multi-task in a deadline-driven environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and make sound decisions under the position guidelines with little direct supervision
  • Knowledge of the parks and recreation or YMCA industry a plus

ACTIVE Network® is on a mission to make the world a more active place by connecting people to the things they love, want and need to do. Our SaaS technology platform offers intelligent and intuitive registration, secure payment processing, insightful data and services to help organizers drive increased participation and revenue while streamlining administration. Founded in 1999, ACTIVE Network is headquartered in Dallas, Texas, with offices throughout North America, Europe, and Asia. We are part of Global Payments Inc.(NYSE: GPN), which has been delivering innovative payment solutions for over 50 years. For more information, please visit .

We aspire to ensure fair treatment, access, opportunity and advancement for all team members. We believe all team members should be able to bring their true, authentic selves to the workplace and feel accepted, engaged and understood.

Global Payments offers a comprehensive benefits package to all of our team members, including medical, dental and vision care, EAP programs, paid time off, recognition programs, retirement and investment options, charitable gift matching programs, and worldwide days of service. jobs.description:
Please note: This is not an active vacancy. We are building a talent pool for future opportunities in this area. If you're interested in being considered when a role becomes available, we'd love to hear from you.

The Centre for Information Resilience (CIR) is an independent organisation dedicated to exposing human rights violations and threats to democracy. We achieve this through open source research, digital investigations, capacity-building with local partners, and collaboration with media to amplify our impact.

CIR was born out of a determination to expose those spreading harm – online and offline – around the world, particularly in areas of violent conflict, such as Ukraine, Sudan and Myanmar. Our projects are at the forefront of efforts to investigate and document human rights abuses, war crimes, harms targeting women and minorities, and influence operations. We work closely with multilateral and national justice accountability bodies.

The Role

The OSINT Investigator will work in a team dedicated to investigating malign influence. They will use open-source tools, techniques and methodologies to monitor, collate, verify and analyse information shared across social media platforms and other media outlets, generating products and relevant leads for further investigation. They will also support the team with understanding the entities, networks and infrastructure that conduct and enable malign influence.

Joining our talent pool means you'll be among the first to hear when relevant opportunities arise. While there is no guarantee of a position, our talent community is the first place we look when hiring.

Role Details

Number of roles: 1

Contract Type: Contractor, ASAP for several months

Hours needed: Full-time

Location: Remote

Languages: You must be able to speak and write English and Uzbek

Closing date: Sunday 27th September at 23:55pm

Requirements

Main Responsibilities

  • Apply open-source investigation and analytical techniques to collect, collate, verify and analyse data that relates to malign influence.
  • Design research methodologies that will deliver relevant evidence, to required standards of accuracy and verification, and within deadlines.
  • Conduct research and support research colleagues by collecting data relating to events and associated actors.
  • Record information in databases and code that data to pre-set information fields as required.
  • Analyse data from multiple sources to build comprehensive reports on events and entities to generate insight into patterns of behaviour.
  • Contribute to the design and production of project-wide high-quality reports that effectively communicate key insights, findings, and the evidence and methodology underpinning them.
  • Contribute to internal reviews of effectiveness and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and impact of project activities.

Requirements

Essential Criteria:

  • Proven track record in OSINT-driven investigations.
  • Proficient English and Uzbek language skills.
  • Demonstrated experience researching violent extremist organisations.
  • Experience conducting investigations and research across social media platforms (such as Facebook and TikTok) and niche communication platforms (such as Rocket.Chat and Element).
  • Experience analysing or researching malign influence.
  • Experience conducting due-diligence and/or financial investigations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical terminology for different audiences and to support clear, concise and timely reporting.

How to Apply

Please upload your CV with a brief note about your availability and areas of expertise.

CIR is an equal opportunities employer. If you require adjustments or additional support to complete this process, please let us know in your application.

A candidate’s guide to artificial intelligence (AI) in recruitment at CIR

CIR does not use artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision-making tools at any stage of its recruitment process. All applications are reviewed, and decisions are made, by trained members of staff.

When applying for a role, please do use AI for:

  • Plan your ideas and thoughts
  • Check the spelling and grammar of your CV and cover letter
  • Research CIR
  • Generate mock interview questions for you to practice before your interview
  • Use AI as a support tool, not as a substitute for your own thinking or judgement

Don’t use AI to:

  • Invent or misrepresent your skills and experience
  • Complete any tests provided by CIR
  • Assist you during an interview to help answer the questions being asked by the panel

Database & Data Architecture for Medical Imaging

jobs.description:
🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy

¿Trabajas en Correos o preparas su oposición? Colabora en remoto con Polaris x Ucademy, compatible con tu trabajo, y ayuda a otros a conseguir su puesto fijo.

📮 Buscamos preparadores/as para la oposición de Correos

Correos es una de las oposiciones con más candidatos de España: no exige titulación universitaria y convoca miles de puestos de personal laboral fijo. Buscamos preparadores que conozcan el proceso por dentro para los puestos de:

  • Reparto (motorizado y a pie)

  • Agente de Clasificación

  • Atención al Cliente

🌟 Quiénes somos

En Polaris x Ucademy preparamos oposiciones de una forma más digital, práctica y personalizada. Ya hemos acompañado a miles de opositores y tenemos un objetivo claro: que 10.000 personas consigan su plaza preparándose con nosotros.

Para lograrlo, estamos ampliando nuestro claustro de preparadores de alto rendimiento.

Somos muy digitales, pero lo humano no se negocia. La tecnología nos ayuda a enseñar mejor, y son nuestros preparadores quienes aportan conocimiento, criterio, cercanía y acompañamiento.

🔎 A quién buscamos

  • Personal de Correos (fijo o con experiencia como contratado/a) que conozca el trabajo y el proceso de primera mano.

  • Preparadores/as con experiencia en la oposición de Correos.

  • Personas que dominen el examen y lo que lo rodea: temario, preguntas tipo test, psicotécnicos, méritos y bolsas de empleo.

  • Quienes sepan enseñar y acompañar: explicar con claridad, hacer fácil el temario y motivar a alumnos que muchas veces se enfrentan a su primera oposición.

  • Soltura con herramientas digitales. Si ya utilizas IA en tu día a día, mucho mejor.

🎯 En qué podrás colaborar

Según tu perfil y disponibilidad, podrás participar en uno o varios proyectos:

  • Clases online dinámicas, prácticas y cercanas.

  • Temario explicado desde la experiencia real del trabajo en Correos.

  • Preguntas tipo test, psicotécnicos y simulacros con el formato del examen.

  • Orientación sobre méritos y bolsas de empleo.

  • Seguimiento de alumnos: resolver dudas y ayudarles a avanzar.

  • Vídeos cortos, esquemas y resúmenes.

🤝 Cómo funciona la colaboración

No es un puesto de trabajo a jornada completa ni parcial. Colaborarás con Polaris x Ucademy mediante prestación de servicios en proyectos educativos concretos, compatible con tu actividad profesional.

Si trabajas en Correos, no te pedimos que dejes tu puesto. Queremos que pongas tu experiencia al servicio de otros opositores de una forma flexible.

🌍 100 % remoto
🕐 Horarios y disponibilidad a convenir, compatibles con turnos
📚 Proyectos y entregables definidos desde el inicio
💰 Compensación competitiva según el proyecto y los entregables

🎬 Cómo es el proceso de selección

Queremos conocerte enseñando, no solo leyendo tu CV. El proceso tiene tres pasos:

1. Revisión de perfil. En la candidatura responderás a unas preguntas breves y nos enviarás un vídeo de presentación de 1 minuto. Grábalo con el móvil, sin complicaciones: cuéntanos quién eres, tu experiencia en Correos y por qué quieres preparar a otros.

2. Contacto de validación. Si tu perfil encaja, nos pondremos en contacto contigo por llamada o por escrito para resolver dudas, conocer tu disponibilidad y explicarte cómo colaboramos.

3. Clase de prueba y entrevista. Agendarás tu entrevista y, antes de la fecha, nos enviarás una clase grabada de máximo 5 minutos sobre un contenido del temario o la resolución comentada de varias preguntas tipo test, con un material de apoyo creado por ti. No buscamos una producción perfecta: queremos ver cómo explicas y cómo haces sencillo lo difícil.

Si conoces Correos por dentro y quieres ayudar a otros a conseguir su puesto, queremos conocerte.

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. The role

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join us in supporting our post-purchase experience and international expansion. Design serves a vital role at Affirm: from building narratives through data to creating products that help people make important financial decisions. As a designer, you are responsible for crafting experiences that build trust, confidence and deliver on our principles of honest, transparent financial products.

We’re at a critical inflection point in Affirm’s journey, with millions of people engaging with our products and new opportunities to expand how they use Affirm every day. We’re also growing globally, reaching new customers in new geographies every day.

This Product Designer will help shape our post-purchase experiences, as well as building the next new geographies that Affirm will expand into. You can demonstrate a breadth of design experience leveraging your ability to create delightful experiences that simplify our customers’ payment management experience through Affirm as well as contributing to our wider international expansion strategy. You’ll partner well with design leadership, design research, and content design. You’ll work end-to-end, from contributing towards Design and Product vision to delivering class leading design. You are able to work closely with Product and Engineering to tailor unique customer experiences for our merchants & consumers while ensuring cohesion to the core Affirm experience - championing our customers needs no matter where their journey starts.

What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end design for key initiatives within our UK and international experiences, as well as our post purchase experiences globally, across App and Web. You’ll be driving from discovery through to delivery and iteration—achieving meaningful customer and business outcomes.

  • Own complex flows and ambiguous problem spaces, defining clear problem statements, success metrics, and design direction.

  • Partner closely with product, engineering, and data to make informed trade-offs and deliver intuitive, high-quality experiences.

  • Balance speed and quality, making pragmatic decisions while contributing to a cohesive product experience.

  • Ownership & Initiative: You take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive work forward with minimal oversight.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • You’ll design financial products that genuinely help people.

  • You’ll work on high-impact experiences used by millions of customers.

  • You’ll join a team that values craft, collaboration, and thoughtful iteration.

  • You’ll have the opportunity to grow your scope, influence, and leadership over time.

This is a remote-first position based in the UK with the option to work from our London office for candidates who prefer an office environment.

Compensation & Benefits

Base Pay Grade: L

Equity Grade: UK 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness, and tech spending, and benefits including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. In addition, employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc.

GBR base pay range per year: £101,000 - 149,000

Location: Remote UK

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

The Project Manager’s focus is on understanding the client’s objectives and guiding them through the process from integration kick-off to actively using the Ravelin product(s). Instacart’s product and technology partnerships — spanning logistics, retail technology, and enterprise products — are a core lever for how we build and grow. We’re hiring a Director of Product Partnerships to lead the team and function at the highest level — influencing build-buy-partner tradeoffs with senior leadership, taking first-of-a-kind bets from 0 to 1, and making Instacart one of the most sought-after partners in grocery technology.

jobs.title: Website AEO Manager
jobs.excerpt: About the Role Buyer behavior is shifting.  Compliance leaders increasingly research vendors through AI answer engines - ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Copilot not just a page of blue links.
jobs.description:
About the Role
Buyer behavior is shifting. Compliance leaders increasingly research vendors through AI answer engines - ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Copilot not just a page of blue links. At the same time, our website is where interest becomes pipeline. This role brings both under one owner: a high-performing website that converts, and a deliberate strategy to be discovered, understood and cited by the engines our buyers now trust. You’ll be the person who turns “AEO” from a buzzword into a measurable, company-wide capability at MCO.

Responsibilities
Website & conversion
  • Own the strategy, roadmap and day-to-day performance of mycomplianceoffice.com, with conversion as the primary success metric.
  • Drive conversion rate optimization (CRO): hypothesis-led A/B and multivariate testing, funnel analysis, form and CTA optimization, and continuous improvement of high-intent paths (demo requests, content downloads, contact).
  • Design and optimize landing pages and conversion journeys in partnership with demand generation, so every campaign lands somewhere built to convert.
  • Manage site performance and UX fundamentals - Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile experience, accessibility, information architecture.
  • Own the analytics picture: GA4, heatmaps/session tools, HubSpot reporting; translate data into a prioritized backlog of experiments and fixes.
  • Manage the CMS (HubSpot CMS) and coordinate any external developers, designers or agencies.

AEO leadership
Be the in-house expert
  • Serve as MCO’s authority on Answer Engine Optimization, how AI answer engines discover, interpret, trust and cite sources and stay ahead of a fast-moving discipline.
  • Make our content citable and machine-readable: clear, factual, well-structured answers; structured data / schema markup; entity and topical authority; FAQ and comparison formats; technical signals for AI crawlers (e.g., robots directives, llms.txt, crawlability).
  • Strengthen off-site presence that AI engines pull from review platforms (e.g., G2), authoritative third-party sources, and digital PR so MCO shows up credibly beyond our own domain.
Be the evangelist
  • Build internal awareness and buy-in for AEO across marketing, product marketing, content, sales and leadership.
  • Translate AEO from abstract concept into concrete, “here’s why it matters to your work” terms for each audience.
Educate the company
  • Create and run enablement guidelines, playbooks, lunch-and-learns that teach teams what AEO is and the specific things they can do to help (how to write citable content, when to add structured data, how product and sales language shapes what engines surface).
Prioritize the roadmap
  • Own and sequence the AEO backlog: identify the high-intent compliance questions our buyers ask engines, find where MCO is (and isn’t) being surfaced, and prioritize the content, technical and off-site work that moves the narrative fastest.
  • Partner with content and product marketing to shape assets specifically designed to be discovered and cited.
Measure and monitor
  • Stand up AEO measurement from scratch: track MCO’s visibility, mentions, citations and share of voice in AI answers across the key engines; monitor AI-driven referral traffic; benchmark against competitors.
  • Report on AEO performance to marketing leadership and connect it, where possible, to pipeline influence.

Experience and Skills
  • 5+ years in digital marketing, web/SEO, or growth marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS.
  • Demonstrated conversion/CRO results you’ve run experiments that measurably improved website performance, not just managed a site.
  • Strong SEO foundation that you’re actively evolving toward AEO / generative search, with a real point of view on how AI is changing discovery.
  • Fluency with web analytics and experimentation tools (GA4, heatmaps, A/B testing) and comfort turning data into prioritized action.
  • Hands-on CMS experience and a working understanding of structured data/schema and technical on-page fundamentals.
  • Excellent communicator who can teach a non-technical audience and rally cross-functional teams around a new idea.

Nice to Have
  • Experience marketing to financial services, compliance, risk or other regulated, considered-purchase buyers.
  • HubSpot (CMS and Marketing Hub) experience.
  • Early, hands-on experience with AEO/GEO tooling and AI-answer monitoring.
  • Comfort working with developers and briefing/managing agencies.

About MCO (MyComplianceOffice)
MCO is a global leader dedicated to empowering Financial Services firms to manage compliance programs with ease and efficiency. Our mission is to foster a fair, transparent, and trusted financial environment worldwide by helping organizations meet their regulatory obligations to society.

At the heart of MCO’s offering is our unique, unified platform, which seamlessly integrates compliance monitoring and data into a single, comprehensive view. This holistic approach enables firms to maintain compliance across all internal systems, structures, and processes—ensuring peace of mind in an ever-evolving regulatory landscape.

Headquartered in Dublin, MCO has an international footprint, with offices in London, Singapore, Hyderabad, New York, Chicago, Fort Worth, Switzerland, South Africa, Slovenia, and the UAE. Since our founding in 2008, we have evolved from a specialist provider of “best of breed” employee compliance solutions to a pioneer in integrated compliance technology.

Today, our team of over 400 professionals supports more than 1.5 million users in 128 countries. Our diverse customer base includes small businesses, large enterprises, four of the world’s top ten asset managers, twenty of the top seventy-five global banks, and three of the top five investment banks for global M&A transactions.

  • Autonomia, bom julgamento na escolha de métodos e perfil colaborativo para construir relações produtivas entre áreas.

jobs.excerpt: Who we are:Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable.
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

As Director, Security Compliance and Trust, you will build and lead the function that earns and sustains customer, regulator, and partner confidence in Motive. Reporting to the CISO, you will own governance, risk and compliance; audit and certification across ISO 27001/27701, SOC 1 and SOC 2, PCI DSS and the path to FedRAMP; privacy and data protection; customer trust; security policy; training and human risk; and AI governance. You will partner closely with Legal, Engineering, Product, IT, Finance, Sales and Customer Success to make compliance a business enabler rather than a tax.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will lead a small, senior, globally distributed team — and you will also write policy, design controls, sit in audit fieldwork, and answer the hardest customer questions yourself. We expect this function to be built AI-first, with automation designed into the operating model from day one rather than added to a traditional GRC team later. Global expansion is central to the role: Motive is growing into Canada, the EU, Mexico and South America, and you will be the person who makes those markets enterable — mapping obligations before Sales arrives and building controls that satisfy multiple jurisdictions at once.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the compliance, privacy and trust function end-to-end — org design, hiring, and global team development — and act as Motive's senior authority on the control environment, deciding which frameworks we adopt and where we accept versus remediate risk
  • Build a single integrated control framework that maps once to many across ISO 27001/27701, SOC 1 and SOC 2, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, GDPR and CCPA/CPRA, so evidence is collected once rather than once per framework or once per country
  • Own the annual audit calendar end-to-end, manage auditor and assessor relationships directly, and lead Motive's path to FedRAMP from the ground up as public sector opportunity matures
  • Own privacy compliance operations — data subject rights, DPIAs, ROPA and cross-border transfer mechanics — treating driver data as the sensitive category it is, including location history, in-cab video, telematics behavior and biometric-adjacent processing
  • Own regulatory readiness for new markets ahead of go-to-market, partnering with Engineering and Platform on data residency and regional architecture rather than solving localization with policy language
  • Be the face of Motive's security and privacy posture to customers — owning trust.gomotive.com, scaling security questionnaire and review response, and serving as the senior escalation point in enterprise deals
  • Architect the AI-first operating model for the function, personally building and iterating on evidence automation, continuous control monitoring and AI-assisted questionnaire response rather than delegating it to a tooling vendor
  • Own the security policy and standards library and its exceptions process, along with company-wide security training, phishing simulation and human risk measurement
  • Establish Motive's AI governance program across both product and internal AI use, building against ISO/IEC 42001, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and the EU AI Act

What We’re Looking For:

  • 8+ years in security compliance, GRC, privacy, audit or risk management, including 5+ years in leadership roles managing both people managers and senior individual contributors
  • Demonstrably hands-on. You have personally written the policies, designed the controls, built the control mappings, sat through fieldwork and answered the hardest customer questions yourself — recently, not a decade ago. Be prepared to walk through work you did with your own hands
  • Proven ownership of multi-framework compliance programs at scale in a cloud-native SaaS environment — ISO 27001, SOC 1 and SOC 2, and PCI DSS as core, with the judgment to run them as one program rather than three
  • Deep, operational privacy experience across GDPR and CCPA/CPRA, with hands-on ownership of DSAR operations, DPIAs, ROPA and cross-border transfer mechanics. CIPP/E, CIPP/US or CIPM is a plus, but demonstrated operational ownership matters more
  • Experience standing up compliance and privacy in new international markets, ideally including Canada, the EU, Mexico or Latin America. Familiarity with PIPEDA/Law 25, LGPD or the Mexican LFPDPPP is a strong advantage
  • Experience with FedRAMP, ideally having led an organization through authorization or Moderate/High readiness, with the appetite to build Motive's path from the ground up
  • Concrete, demonstrated use of AI to run compliance work — evidence collection, questionnaire response, control monitoring, policy drafting, audit preparation or regulatory gap analysis. We will ask what you built, what it replaced, and what it measurably changed. General enthusiasm for AI is not what we're looking for
  • Demonstrated ownership of customer-facing trust functions — security reviews, questionnaires, trust portals and enterprise escalation — and experience leading globally distributed teams across multiple timezones
  • Working fluency in AI governance frameworks and a clear point of view on governing AI without blocking its adoption
  • Experience supporting IPO readiness, SOX or equivalent regulated-environment scrutiny, and experience with sensitive personal data at scale, are both strongly preferred

Pay Transparency
Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units. Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visitingMotive Perks & Benefits.

Cloudnonic is an international, fully remote cloud and software company. We build customized cloud-native systems for clients in Europe and North America, and we're looking for a Semi-Senior React developer to join the team.

Who we are

Cloudnonic Corp. is a digitally native software and cloud startup based in the Kitchener/Waterloo area, Ontario, Canada. We're fully remote, with developers in Canada and South America and clients across Europe, North America, and South America. We work across healthcare, finance, construction, and manufacturing, and we take the time to understand each client's industry so we can serve it well with technology.

We're big on AI and the cloud. Our services range from app and web development to AI and cloud integration, plus technology consulting: designing feasible, secure, cost-effective architectures for non-technical clients and advising them on their tech stack.

The role

As a React developer you'll work on multiple client projects at once, each with its own tech stack, code, and idiosyncrasies. You'll work with a wide range of code, libraries, and technologies and build the kind of adaptability that comes from switching between projects rather than staying in one repository.

We deliver AI-first. AI generates our tickets and acceptance criteria, we pair with AI while developing, and every pull request goes through AI review before a senior engineer reviews it. That makes us fast. It also means we have no room for developers who can only prompt. You need to be able to read what the AI produced, know when it's wrong, and fix it yourself: solid fundamentals in JavaScript, React's rendering model, semantic HTML, browser performance, and HTTP are the baseline, not a bonus. If you can't explain your code without the tool that wrote it, this isn't the role for you. Part of our technical interview is done without AI assistance.

You'll work directly with clients to architect solutions, discuss new features, and present your progress, most of the time in English. You'll learn to present ideas to clients in a professional, friendly way. Expect to be challenged constantly, and to enjoy the work along the way.

The Performance Media Manager is responsible for leading the implementation, delivery, and optimisation of performance media campaigns across the News Corp network and other major publishers on behalf of clients.

This role ensures the seamless management of campaigns throughout their lifecycle, including forecasting, setup, QA, pacing, optimisation, and reporting. With a focus on accuracy and compliance, the Performance Media Manager mitigates risks to revenue by addressing under-pacing campaigns, resolving creative delays, and adhering to ad product rules and auditing standards.

Leveraging deep expertise in performance media, they influence booking practices to prioritise on-net inventory, optimise campaigns to achieve client outcomes at the lowest cost, and test new products to ensure margin requirements are met.

Accountabilities & Responsibilities

Campaign Management & Delivery

  • Successfully manage and deliver performance media campaigns throughout their lifecycle, including pre-campaign forecasting, setup and QA, go-live pacing, optimisations, and end-of-campaign reporting.
  • Maintain high levels of accuracy and attention to detail while working under pressure to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Identify and resolve under-pacing campaigns to mitigate revenue risks, ensuring timely and effective optimisations.
  • Proactively address outstanding digital creative issues to ensure campaigns launch on time and meet client expectations.

Compliance & Best Practices

  • Uphold ad product rules and ensure adherence to auditing compliance standards across all campaigns.
  • Ensure accurate forecasts to prevent poor campaign practices, such as over-bidding, that negatively affect margin.
  • Influence the acceptance of bookings by hedging high-risk inventory with alternate solutions, while prioritising and maximising on-net inventory.

Team Development & Collaboration

  • Coach and develop partner team members, providing first-level support for their tasks and fostering a high-performance environment.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure campaign strategies align with client outcomes and organisational goals.

Product Testing & Validation

  • Test and validate new products to ensure they meet margin requirements and deliver value to clients.
  • Provide actionable insights and feedback to improve product performance and alignment with market needs.

Capabilities & Competencies

Plans and Aligns

Plans and prioritises work to meet commitments aligned with organisational goals. For example, outlines clear plans that put actions in a logical sequence; conveys some time frames. Aligns own work with relevant workgroups. Takes some steps to reduce bottlenecks and speed up the work.

Business Insight

Applies knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organisation's goals. For example, clearly understands how own activities relate to critical business drivers. Monitors business news and market changes for impact on the business or on own expertise area; uses this to shape decisions.

Manages Complexity

Makes sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems. For example, looks at complex issues from multiple angles; explores issues to uncover underlying issues and root causes; sees the main consequences and implications of different options.

Communicates Effectively

Develops and delivers multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences. For example, listens attentively and takes an interest. Keeps others well informed; conveys information clearly, concisely, and professionally when speaking or writing.

Tech Savvy

Anticipates and adopts innovations in business-building digital and technology applications. For example, investigates technologies to learn some cutting-edge best practices. Uses digital/social media to benefit the team and add value to the work being done; understands how to avoid misuse of these tools.

Nimble Learning

Learns through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder. For example, shows a clear desire to learn and questions others to gain new knowledge. Deals appropriately with first-time or unusual problems; seeks relevant guidance and support. Learns from mistakes.

Collaborates

Builds partnerships and works collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. For example, finds many ways to add value to the team; probes to draw out richer input from others; is a valued resource who goes out of the way to help others.

jobs.excerpt: Say hello to HagertyHagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers.
jobs.description:
Say hello to Hagerty

Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers. We put our members at the center of everything we do, and are dedicated to making it easier and more enjoyable for enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love. We’re proud to be the world’s largest insurer of collectible and enthusiast vehicles and are home to the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest car club. Our Marketplace business presents live and digital sales across the U.S. and Europe, we host a number of driving events and concours, and our award-winning automotive journalists produce the most popular car magazine globally, alongside internationally awarded videos. We’re committed to Never Stop Driving. Ready to get in the driver’s seat? Join us! 

The Corporate Underwriting Analyst helps protect the long-term health of Hagerty's collector and enthusiast vehicle program. This role analyzes production trends, pricing performance, competitive landscape, book segmentation, and underwriting results, then turns those findings into concrete recommendations that improve how Hagerty selects, prices, and manages risk.

What you'll do

  • Own analyses that evaluate performance and measure the impact of underwriting actions and changes.
  • Translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for guidelines, standards, and process improvements.
  • Help develop and refine underwriting guidelines and risk appetite for collector and enthusiast vehicles, balancing growth with sound risk selection.
  • Assist in the development and communication of underwriting appetite to cross-functional partners.
  • Build and present business cases, including cost-benefit analysis, to support decisions and influence change.
  • Analyze production trends, pricing performance, competitive landscape, and book segmentation to identify emerging risks and opportunities for improvement.
  • Review relevant insurance regulations and support implementation of changes to underwriting practices to ensure state compliance.
  • Apply AI tools to accelerate research and analysis and to design more efficient ways of working.
  • Lead projects from start to finish, partnering with Regional VPs, sales and service teams (including production underwriters), Claims, Data & Decision Science, and Technology to deliver measurable results.
  • Define and document requirements for data, reporting, and system changes.
  • Participate in user acceptance testing for underwriting-related system or rule changes.

This might describe you

  • 1-3 years of relevant experience, with at least 1 year in an analytical or quality-focused capacity.
  • Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to exercise independent judgment.
  • Proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, formulas) and SQL or business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau); exposure to scripting (e.g., Python or R) or AI-enabled analytics is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting insights to leadership.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Over and above

  • Solid working knowledge of underwriting or insurance principles and processes.
  • Solid understanding of underwriting/pricing performance drivers and competitive landscape dynamics within a specialty insurance segment.
  • Familiarity with the collector vehicle, specialty auto, or enthusiast insurance segments.
  • Experience partnering with data science or analytics functions to act on model output.
  • Progress toward an industry credential such as CPCU or AU.

Other things to note

  • This position is open to U.S. remote work. However, team members who reside within 20 miles of the Traverse City headquarters will follow a hybrid schedule, working from the office three days per week.
  • May require occasional travel for partner meetings, industry events, and team collaboration.
  • Familiarity with public company requirements, including Sarbanes Oxley and key regulations, if applicable. For SOX compliant roles, responsible for designing, executing, and documenting internal controls where they have been identified as owners to prevent errors in financial reporting, processes, and business operations. Including attestation to the completeness, accuracy, and compliance of all financial reporting data, where applicable.

At Hagerty, we share the road. We are an inclusive automotive community where all are welcomed, valued and belong regardless of race, gender, age, or car preference.  We are united by our shared passion for driving, our commitment to preserve car culture for future generations and our desire to make a positive impact in the world.

jobs.description:
CEO Lawyer

The CEO Lawyer Personal Injury Law Firm is dedicated to educating, empowering, and fighting for victims. With offices across the country, no matter where you are injured, our team of experienced lawyers is here to help you.

CEO Lawyer is a rapidly growing personal injury law firm headquartered in downtown Atlanta. We are known for our innovative approach to legal services and our commitment to operational excellence.

Our Core Values

We are guided by a strong set of values that shape our culture, decisions, and the way we work together:

  • Trust – We build strong relationships through honesty, transparency, and reliability.
  • Humility – We stay open to learning, feedback, and continuous improvement.
  • Ethics – We act with integrity and always do what’s right.
  • Hunger – We are driven, ambitious, and committed to excellence.
  • Education – We value growth, development, and knowledge-sharing.
  • Accountability – We take ownership of our actions and deliver on our commitments.
  • Respect – We treat everyone with professionalism, empathy, and fairness.
  • Teamwork – We collaborate and support each other to achieve shared success.

Summary

We are looking for a confident, sales-driven, and highly persuasive Sales Intake Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be the first point of contact for potential clients and will play a critical role in converting qualified leads into signed clients.

This is not just a customer service or administrative intake role. We are seeking someone with a strong sales mindset who knows how to build trust quickly, ask the right probing questions, overcome objections, and guide potential clients through the onboarding and sign-up process with confidence.

The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator who thrives in a fast-paced environment, is motivated by results, and knows how to turn opportunities into retained cases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Respond promptly to inbound leads through phone, email, chat, and other communication channels.
  • Conduct high-quality intake calls with potential clients, gathering case details and assessing eligibility.
  • Build trust and rapport quickly with leads while delivering a professional and empathetic experience.
  • Take ownership of the conversation and confidently guide potential clients toward signing with the firm.
  • Use consultative selling techniques to explain the firm’s value, address concerns, and move leads through the decision-making process.
  • Handle objections effectively and follow up persistently with warm and undecided leads.
  • Close contracts and support clients through the onboarding process from first contact to signed agreement.
  • Accurately document all conversations, updates, and lead activity in the CRM and case management systems.
  • Review and manage new leads, pending contracts, and follow-up opportunities daily.
  • Coordinate with the legal and intake teams to ensure a smooth handoff once the client signs.
  • Organize contracts, supporting documentation, termination letters, photos, and other intake-related files.

Requirements

  • Fully bilingual in English and Spanish with strong verbal communication skills.
  • Proven sales experience in intake, consultative sales, client acquisition, appointment setting, closing, or a similar high-conversion role.
  • Strong ability to close deals, handle objections, negotiate, and convert leads into clients.
  • Confident and persuasive communication style with a strong sense of urgency and follow-through.
  • Experience with client onboarding, lead follow-up, and relationship-building.
  • Comfortable working in a high-volume, KPI-driven environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to multitask and manage multiple leads without losing quality.
  • Personal injury experience is a strong plus.
  • Experience with Filevine, CRM systems, or legal intake processes is a plus.

What We’re Looking For

  • Sales hunter mentality
  • Strong closer
  • Confident and persuasive communicator
  • Results-driven and competitive
  • Excellent follow-up habits
  • Comfortable asking direct questions and leading conversations

Other requirements:

  • Your PC or laptop (a wired connection to your modem is recommended).
  • You must provide your own equipment and a stable internet connection.
  • This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position that may require a flexible schedule.
  • A noise-canceling headset and a quiet place to work.
  • This is a remote position, and you will be responsible for your local taxes.

jobs.excerpt: BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals.
jobs.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

The Director, Legal Entity Planning & Forecasting will be a key member of the Corporate FP&A team and will own the enterprise legal entity forecasting and reporting framework. The role will translate the management forecast into a complete, accurate, and reconciled legal entity forecast. This serves as a key input to our corporate tax planning and transfer pricing processes, legal entity cash flow and liquidity forecasting, as well as other related accounting analyses. The position will partner with Corporate FP&A, Global Tax, Treasury, Accounting/Controllership, Finance Systems, and business finance teams across Commercial, R&D, Technical Operations, and G&A.

The successful candidate will combine strong FP&A and business planning capabilities with sufficient accounting, tax, intercompany, and legal entity knowledge to understand how management forecasts translate into legal entity financial statements and related implications on tax planning, transfer pricing, and capital allocation strategies (cash flow by entity perspective). This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for building governance, controls, and accountability around legal entity forecasting while ensuring one reconciled view of the company across management and statutory/tax needs.

The ideal candidate is proactive, highly analytical, comfortable operating in a dynamic global environment, and able to move between detailed model mechanics and executive-level insights. The role requires strong cross-functional influence, process design skills, and a continuous-improvement mindset.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish and govern the enterprise Legal Entity Forecasting framework, including process design, calendar, ownership, controls, data requirements, and reconciliation to the management forecast

  • Lead the translation of management forecasts into legal entity forecasts, ensuring entity-level P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow projections reconcile to the consolidated FP&A outlook

  • Partner with Finance Systems/TM1 to design scalable forecasting capabilities, enabling efficient capture and allocation of costs, intercompany activity, and other legal entity drivers across the enterprise

  • Provide reliable legal entity forecasts and insights to Global Tax to support tax provision, effective tax rate forecasting, tax planning, transfer pricing, impairment/valuation analysis, and other accounting-for-income-tax requirements

  • Partner with Treasury to assess legal entity liquidity and cash generation, identifying potential funding requirements, trapped cash, and implications for capital allocation and treasury risk

  • Perform regular actual-to-forecast and forecast-to-forecast variance analysis by legal entity, identifying key drivers, emerging risks, and potential implications for Global Tax, Treasury, Accounting, and management reporting

  • Establish governance and accountability across Legal Entity Finance Directors and functional teams, ensuring completeness, accuracy, timely submissions, and resolution of forecast risks

  • Provide management with actionable legal entity insights, highlighting forecast changes and emerging risks impacting GlobalTax, Treasury, Accounting, and enterprise financial planning.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience across FP&A, corporate finance, accounting, controllership, transaction advisory, audit, or related finance disciplines in a complex multinational environment.

  • CPA preferred. Big 4 audit, accounting advisory, transaction services, or similar background is highly valued but not required if equivalent corporate experience is demonstrated.

  • Demonstrated experience with legal entity forecasting statutory/entity-level planning, tax forecasting support, or integrated forecasting across FP&A, Global Tax, Treasury, and Accounting.

  • Strong understanding of US GAAP and consolidated financial statements; IFRS knowledge; knowledge of accounting for income taxes (ASC 740), impairment/valuation concepts, and the role of forecasts in external reporting.

  • Solid understanding of intercompany transactions, transfer pricing, and how operational activity flows through legal entities.

  • Experience with cash flow and liquidity forecasting and the ability to connect legal entity earnings, balance sheet movements, and cash requirements.

  • Experience in the pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry strongly preferred, with understanding of R&D, Technical Operations/manufacturing, Commercial, and Global Medical Affairs economics.

  • Public-company and multinational experience strongly preferred; SEC reporting exposure is a plus.

  • Advanced financial modeling and systems skills; TM1/Planning Analytics experience strongly preferred, with advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.

  • People-management experience and demonstrated ability to influence across functions without direct authority.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex entity-level financial information into clear executive insights.

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, results-focused, and comfortable balancing strategic process design with hands-on execution.

Group AI Transformation Manager
The Group AI Transformation Manager is the primary driver of AI adoption across a group of 6+ business units, reporting to the Group Leader and partnering closely with the Modaxo AI Centre of Excellence (CoE). This is fundamentally a change, commercial, and capability role — the human bridge between enterprise AI strategy and operational reality of each business unit. The AI Transformation Manager does not build the business unit’s AI solutions; they accelerate the pace at which AI is adopted, embedded, generates value driving solutions for our customers that are brought to market quickly and scaled across the group. Strong candidates will typically come from transformation, senior business units partnering backgrounds or commercial and technical strategy backgrounds. Remote candidates in North America are considered with regular travel expected.

Job Description:

Job Summary:

The Group AI Transformation Manager is the primary driver of AI adoption across a group of 6+ business units, reporting to the Group Leader and partnering closely with the Modaxo AI Centre of Excellence (CoE). This is fundamentally a change, commercial, and capability role — the human bridge between enterprise AI strategy and operational reality of each business unit. The AI Transformation Manager does not build the business unit’s AI solutions; they accelerate the pace at which AI is adopted, embedded, generates value driving solutions for our customers that are brought to market quickly and scaled across the group. Strong candidates will typically come from transformation, senior business units partnering backgrounds or commercial and technical strategy backgrounds. Remote candidates in North America are considered with regular travel expected.

Duties / Responsibilities:

AI Strategy & Opportunity Development

  • Develop and maintain an AI transformation roadmap for the group, mapping each business unit’s maturity, near-term priorities, and 12–24 month opportunity pipeline aligned to Group Leader and business unit strategy.
  • Identify and prioritize AI use cases using a structured framework (impact × feasibility × strategic fit) and lead regular AI opportunity reviews with Group Leader, business unit leaders, and other Modaxo Functions
  • Translate market trends on emerging AI capabilities into specific commercial opportunities for business units.

AI Adoption & Implementation Acceleration

  • Act as the primary implementation partner for business units deploying AI tools — removing adoption barriers and moving from decision to live deployment faster.
  • Lead AI pilot scoping, design, and monitoring to generate transferable learning and scale-ready outcomes; replicate successful use cases across business unit s.
  • Hold B business unit leaders accountable for agreed AI adoption milestones with appropriate support and challenge.

AI Champions Partnership & Capability Business development

  • Serve as day-to-day partner to AI Champions — providing guidance, escalation support, and a link to other Modaxo resources.
  • Help Champions develop business unit AI readiness assessments and activation plans; identify capability gaps and coordinate learning interventions.
  • Track and report AI literacy levels and adoption readiness using a consistent maturity framework.

Stakeholder Engagement & Change Leadership

  • Build relationship as a trusted advisor with business unit leaders; manage the human side of AI change proactively and ensure no business unit is left behind.
  • Brief the Group Leader regularly on adoption progress, emerging risks, and priority decisions; prepare a monthly AI adoption summary for upward reporting.
  • Support talent and role evaluation to ensure business unit s have the right skills to deliver AI strategy; connect AI adoption to the AI Impact Personas framework.

Performance, Measurement & Reporting

  • Own the group’s AI adoption scorecard: adoption rates, use cases live, value delivered, capability development, and maturity progression.
  • Conduct periodic AI maturity assessments and provide regular reporting to the Group Leader and other Modaxo stakeholders against the transformation roadmap.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Education and Experience:

  • Demonstrable track record leading complex, multi-business unit change programs — ideally technology-related.
  • Background in management consulting, business transformation, change management, digital program leadership, or senior commercial roles with significant change exposure in a software development or technology area.
  • Evidence of translating strategy into practical action through people who do not report to them; experience coaching and enabling others.
  • Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in transformation, change, or strategic business unit partnering roles.
  • Post-secondary degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Organizational Behavior, or related field preferred.
  • Desirable: direct AI deployment experience, multi- business unit /group structure background, familiarity with ADKAR/Kotter or AI maturity frameworks, and Modaxo/CSI or relevant sector experience.

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods working at a desk and on a computer or laptop.
  • Ability to travel up to 30–40% of the time (domestic and international) to business sites.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at a time and handle high utilization of hand and wrist dexterity.

jobs.description:
System Engineer – Managed Kubernetes

The Container Services team is responsible for delivering Leaseweb Managed Kubernetes: a platform that empowers customers to deploy, manage, and update their own Kubernetes clusters while simplifying the complexity that comes with running them at scale. We are looking for a motivated System Engineer to help build and evolve this product.

Product Engineering at Leaseweb

Our team of approximately 145 engineers works in small scrum teams, each with end-to-end responsibility for a specific product or part of our architecture. We work on a remote-first basis, coming together in person at our Amsterdam headquarters twice a year.

Our organizational structure is flat, placing a high value on independence and entrepreneurship. The atmosphere is informal and relaxed, creating a highly motivating work environment where you will work alongside some of the most inspiring colleagues in the industry.

What is the role about?

As a System Engineer in the Container Services team, you are responsible for developing our container offering based on Kubernetes. Your main activities will be automating the deployment of Kubernetes clusters across Leaseweb's various compute offerings, as well as maintaining and monitoring those clusters.

You will be part of a multidisciplinary team of experienced professionals: software engineers, system engineers, a scrum master, product owner, and product management.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Automate deployment, management, patching, and deletion of Kubernetes clusters across Leaseweb's compute offerings

Customer Intelligence Analyst

We are looking for a highly analytical and curious Customer Intelligence Analyst who will help our teams better understand how customers experience our products.

This role goes beyond traditional reporting and analytics. The successful candidate will act as a Customer Reality Champion, connecting customer feedback, product usage data, operational signals, UX research insights, and validation findings into a clear and actionable understanding of customer experience.

The ideal candidate is not only skilled at working with data but also passionate about uncovering patterns, identifying meaningful signals, and helping teams make better decisions. They will collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, Engineers, Customer Success teams, and Experience Validation specialists to surface insights that improve customer outcomes and drive product decisions.

This role is critical to scaling Product Experience across the organization by transforming fragmented information into reusable intelligence that teams can leverage throughout the product lifecycle.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DELIVERABLES

  • Extract, clean, combine, and analyze data from various sources including APIs, analytics platforms, operational systems, exports, and internal repositories

  • Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis and knowledge synthesis while maintaining appropriate quality controls
  • Identify opportunities to improve how customer insights, experience data, and operational signals are captured and leveraged across the organization
  • Contribute to post-release analysis and ongoing monitoring of customer experience outcomes

ORGANIZATIONAL ALIGNMENT

  • Reports to the Senior Manager, User Experience
  • Works closely with UX Designers, Product Managers, Engineers, Customer Success, Implementation teams, and Experience Validation specialists
  • Partners closely with the PXV Enablement Specialist to support scalable validation and customer understanding practices
  • Willing to work across time zones

QUALIFICATIONS

SKILLS & WORK TRAITS

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to identify meaningful patterns across multiple data sources
  • Ability to create structure from ambiguous, incomplete, or inconsistent information
  • Experience developing taxonomies, classifications, frameworks, or information models

  • Experience using Python for data analysis, transformation, or automation
  • Experience gathering and analyzing data from multiple systems and sources
  • Ability to work with structured and semi-structured datasets

  • Familiarity with modern AI tools and AI-assisted workflows

  • Experience creating taxonomies, metadata models, knowledge structures, or information architectures

  • Enterprise SaaS experience
  • Experience working with highly configurable, multi-tenant software platforms

EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

  • Demonstrated experience transforming multiple data sources into actionable business insights

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Headless CMS Solutions Architect to lead client discovery, technology evaluation, solution architecture, and implementation planning for modern digital content platforms.

This is a senior, client-facing role for someone who can bridge business requirements, content strategy, cloud architecture, systems integration, and development.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with multiple headless CMS platforms, particularly:

•Storyblok

•Sanity

•Contentful

•Strapi

The successful candidate must also be comfortable designing solutions within an Amazon Web Services (AWS) environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead client discovery workshops and stakeholder interviews.
  • Gather and document business, editorial, technical, integration, security, and content requirements.
  • Evaluate headless CMS platforms and recommend the best solution based on client needs.
  • Develop current-state and future-state solution architectures.
  • Design scalable content models, schemas, reusable components, taxonomies, and metadata.
  • Define editorial workflows, approvals, permissions, localization, and publishing processes.
  • Design integrations between the CMS and enterprise systems.
  • Collaborate with front-end, cloud, DevOps, security, UX, and development teams.
  • Develop CMS migration strategies from legacy platforms such as Drupal, WordPress, Sitecore, or custom systems.
  • Design architectures supporting multilingual content, accessibility, SEO, search, and content governance.
  • Produce architecture diagrams, technology recommendations, implementation roadmaps, and technical documentation.
  • Present recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Headless CMS Experience

Candidates should have strong experience with multiple headless CMS platforms and be capable of objectively evaluating their strengths and limitations.

Experience should include several of the following:

Storyblok

Visual Editor, components, workflows, localization, roles and permissions, Content Delivery API, and Management API.

Sanity

Sanity Studio, structured content, schemas, GROQ, Content Lake, custom editorial experiences, and integrations.

Contentful

Content models, localization, environments, permissions, workflows, Content Delivery API, and Content Management API.

Strapi

Content Type Builder, components, Dynamic Zones, REST and GraphQL APIs, permissions, plugins, and cloud or self-hosted deployments.

Candidates do not need equal expertise in all four platforms, but strong experience with at least two and familiarity with all four is preferred.

AWS & Cloud Architecture

The client environment will use Amazon Web Services.

The candidate should understand how headless CMS platforms integrate with AWS-based applications and infrastructure.

Relevant AWS experience may include:

•Amazon S3

•CloudFront

•Lambda

•API Gateway

•EC2

•ECS / EKS

•RDS

•DynamoDB

•OpenSearch

•Cognito

•IAM

•Route 53

•AWS WAF

•Secrets Manager

•CloudWatch

Overview

Join a team where innovation meets mission. Our AI, cloud, cyber, and modernization solutions save agencies thousands of hours, safeguard national security, and strengthen health and humanitarian missions worldwide. With more than 1,700+ team members, 1,500+ AI & data experts, and 100+ prime contracts, we deliver at scale and with purpose.
