Credence is a welcoming environment for those looking to grow and make a meaningful impact. We encourage employees to push boundaries and help solve critical, world-changing federal challenges.

Position Summary

Credence has an immediate need for a Technical Writing Assistant to support U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) in the development, maintenance, and lifecycle management of agency policy documentation. This is a 100% remote position supporting a mission-critical federal customer.

The ideal candidate should possess exceptional organizational skills and an eye for detail that catches what others miss. Success in this role requires precision over volume — accurate citations, clean formatting, disciplined version control, and clear tracking of where every document stands in the review and approval cycle. The Technical Writing Assistant serves as the day-to-day steward of a large policy library, fielding research requests from government stakeholders, validating the authorities that underpin existing policy, formatting documents to CBP-approved standards, and shepherding materials through routing and concurrence.

Requirements

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the duties listed below:

  • Must be able to maintain the CBP policy library, including document intake, indexing, version control, and archiving of superseded material.
  • Will be responsible for providing responsive customer service to the Security Operations Division (SOD) on policy searches and research inquiries.
  • Will conduct independent research and analysis to support the development of new policy.
  • Will validate references and authorities cited in policy documents and determine whether the scope of expiring policy remains relevant, requires revision, or should be sunset.
  • Will create and track routing sheets, monitoring each document action through review, concurrence, and final approval.
  • Will assist with web content management, including posting, updating, and organizing policy content on CBP sites.
  • Must have the ability to utilize Microsoft Word and Adobe Acrobat Pro to format documents into CBP-approved formats, applying styles, templates, cross-references, tables of contents, bookmarking, and accessibility remediation.
  • Must have demonstrated experience utilizing Microsoft PowerPoint to create presentations depicting workflows, processes, and organizational charts.
  • Must have prior experience proofreading and copy editing a wide range of materials, including directives, handbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), memoranda, and briefing products.
  • Must maintain working knowledge of a broad range of current guidelines, regulations, policies, and handbooks pertinent to CBP activities.

Qualifications:

  • Must have a Bachelor’s degree in Technical Writing or a related field is required.
  • Must have a minimum of 5 years of relevant technical writing/editing experience.
  • Must have advanced proficiency with Microsoft Word (styles, templates, cross-references, tables of contents, track changes) and Adobe Acrobat Pro (PDF creation, bookmarking, form fields, Section 508 accessibility).
  • Must have proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint, including building workflow diagrams and organizational charts.
  • Must have demonstrated experience maintaining a document, policy, or knowledge library with disciplined version control.
  • Must be able to conduct independent research, validate source authorities, and summarize findings clearly.
  • Must have exceptional proofreading and copy-editing skills, with strong command of grammar, usage, and a recognized style guide.
  • Must be stakeholder engaging, with a service-oriented approach to fielding research requests.
  • Must be able to work well within Teams.
  • Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Must have the ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive data.
  • Must have the ability to manage multiple concurrent document actions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Must be able to work independently with minimal supervision in a fully remote setting.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen and able to obtain and maintain a favorable CBP suitability determination.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience supporting CBP, DHS, or another federal law enforcement or homeland security organization.
  • Familiarity with federal policy document types (directives, handbooks, musters, SOPs, memoranda) and agency policy lifecycle and review processes.
  • Experience with routing sheets, staffing packages, or comparable government concurrence workflows.
  • Experience with SharePoint and web content management systems.
  • Working knowledge of Section 508 / WCAG accessibility requirements for documents and web content.
  • Experience researching statutory and regulatory authorities (U.S. Code, CFR, executive orders, agency directives

Why this role exists

We are seeking an experienced, analytical, and data-driven Paid Search Manager to own and scale our Google Ads and Microsoft (Bing) Ads programs. Managing a combined monthly budget of $225K–$250K+, you will be directly responsible for the strategy, execution, optimization, and continuous growth of our paid search efforts.
You will oversee a multi-faceted account structure—including Branded, Non-Branded, Performance Max (PMax), and Demand Generation campaigns—leveraging advanced tROAS bidding strategies to maximize revenue and return on ad spend.

What are your responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Account Ownership: Strategy, buildout, optimization, and daily management of Google Ads and Microsoft Ads accounts targeting high-volume revenue growth.
  • Bidding Strategy & Budget Allocation: Manage and fine-tune automated bidding strategies (specifically tROAS and Maximize Conversion Value), continuously balancing spend between high-intent search, PMax, and Demand Gen channels.
  • Campaign Execution & Optimization:
    • Structure and refine Branded and Non-Branded search campaigns for high relevance, strong quality scores, and efficiency.
    • Optimize Performance Max (PMax) campaigns using strategic asset groups, audience signals, negative keyword lists, and placement exclusions.
    • Scale Demand Generation campaigns to capture upper/mid-funnel demand through engaging visual and video assets across YouTube, Discover, and Gmail.
  • Testing & Experimentation: Design and execute structured A/B tests for ad copy, landing pages, creative assets, audience targeting, and bidding targets.
  • Data & Attribution Integrity: Collaborate with data/analytics teams to ensure accurate conversion value modeling, offline conversion tracking (OCT), first-party data integration, and attribution accuracy.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Work closely with Creative, Copywriting, and Landing Page teams to supply high-performing assets for Demand Gen and PMax campaigns.
  • Reporting & Insights: Deliver weekly and monthly performance reports highlighting key metrics (Spend, Revenue, ROAS, CPA, Conversion Value) and actionable insights to senior leadership.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Experience: 4–6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience managing large-scale Paid Search (Google Ads & Bing Ads) accounts.
  • Budget Scale: Proven track record of directly managing paid search budgets of $150K+ per month ($1.5M+ annually) with strict performance goals.
  • Smart Bidding Mastery: Deep, practical expertise with target ROAS (tROAS) bidding, portfolio bid strategies, dynamic value-based bidding, and Smart Bidding mechanics.
  • Campaign Diversity: Extensive experience running and optimizing non-branded search, PMax, and Demand Gen (or Discovery) campaigns.
  • Analytical Skills: Expert-level capability in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, data manipulation), and attribution modeling.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong understanding of Google Tag Manager (GTM), conversion pixels, server-side tracking, and enhanced conversions.
  • Creative Eye: Ability to collaborate on visual and video creative specs tailored for Demand Gen and asset-led formats.
  • Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising certifications.
  • Experience with third-party SEM management tools (e.g., SA360, Marin, Kenshoo/Skai) or bid management scripts.
  • Background in [B2B / E-commerce / Lead Gen - specify your industry].

Your superpowers are…
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong data interpretation abilities with a passion for turning insights into action.
  • Outstanding attention to detail and campaign accuracy.
  • Strategic thinking with the ability to balance short-term performance and long-term growth.
  • Expertise in performance marketing optimization and experimentation.
  • Strong forecasting, budget management, and resource allocation skills.
  • Ability to identify opportunities and risks before they impact performance.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Highly organized with strong project and priority management capabilities.
  • Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and a results-driven mindset.

You should apply if...
  • Passionate about performance marketing and driving measurable business outcomes.
  • Enjoy analyzing data and uncovering insights that lead to growth opportunities.
  • Naturally curious and continuously test, learn, and optimize.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt quickly to changing priorities.
  • Comfortable managing large budgets and making data-driven decisions.
  • Possess grit and persistence when solving complex performance challenges.
  • Take initiative and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Highly collaborative and enjoy partnering with creative, analytics, and cross-functional teams.
  • Open to feedback and continuously seek ways to improve.
  • Available to work full-time during Eastern Time (ET) business hours and collaborate effectively with a US-based team.
  • Thrive in a remote work environment and can effectively manage time and priorities independently.

Benefits

Permanent Work-From-Home Forever!
Zero commuting, zero traffic, and more time to do what you love.

You get to pick the perfect spot to unleash your creativity and sharpen your problem-solving skills. The possibilities are endless, so let your imagination run wild!

Our day-to-day work puts mental health front and center!
At Magic, we take mental health seriously. It's not just a catchy poster slogan - it's how we live our lives. We believe in listening to our minds and bodies, and if you need a break, take time to recharge and do something that brings you joy!

jobs.description:
Voici un poste à distance.

TEHORA est présentement à la recherche d’un(e) conseillère ou conseiller en gestion de projets de développement ayant d’excellentes aptitudes techniques, d’excellentes connaissances et qui souhaite mettre à profit ses compétences au sein d’une équipe polyvalente.

Sans être exhaustifs, voici les services et livrables que devra fournir la personne retenue.

Description des travaux ou des biens livrables :

La conseillère ou le conseiller en gestion de projets de développement accompagne le directeur ou le chef de projet tout au long de la durée du projet dont elle ou il a la responsabilité. La personne occupant ce poste est appuyée par de proches collaborateurs, dont le responsable de produits, l’analyste TI, l’architecte de solutions et le contrôleur de projet (PCO). Elle gère le projet au quotidien. Elle planifie, organise et coordonne les travaux de l’équipe de développement selon la méthode agile de type mêlée (scrum). Elle assure la cohésion des activités afin de respecter les objectifs, les coûts, les échéanciers, la qualité attendue et la portée du projet. Elle assure également l’implantation harmonieuse de la solution, tout en se souciant des risques et des mesures transitoires permettant de livrer le projet à l’organisation.

Responsabilités principales

• Actualise l’information concernant le projet et vérifie qu’il répond aux besoins exprimés par le client;
• Maintient une communication efficace entre toutes les parties prenantes concernant l’état d’avancement, les problématiques rencontrées et les enjeux associés au projet;
• Supervise la mise en place des modalités de la gestion du projet et du développement et s’assure du respect de ces modalités;
• Recommande aux instances concernées des orientations ou des solutions aux problèmes éprouvés;
• Se conforme aux processus relatifs aux biens livrables du bureau de projets de l'Office ainsi qu'aux processus relatifs à la reddition de comptes telle que définie dans la Loi sur la gouvernance et la gestion des ressources informationnelles (LGGRI);
• Peut être appelé à jouer aussi le rôle de maître de mêlée (scrum master);
• Avec l’appui du contrôleur de projet (PCO) :
a.Veille au respect de la portée, de la qualité, des coûts et de l’échéancier du projet;
b.Coordonner les différents processus relatifs à la gestion de projet (processus des demandes de changements, résolution des points en suspens, suivi adéquat des risques, gestion de la qualité des livrables et approbation des livrables en matière de gestion de projet et de contenu);
c.Supervise la rédaction des rapports d’avancement et la production des biens livrables relatifs à la gestion du projet;
d.Supervise la production des indicateurs de performance du projet et la réalisation du tableau de bord;
• Coordonne les liens, s’il y a lieu, entre le projet placé sous sa responsabilité et les autres projets de l’organisation;
• Organise le transfert de connaissances vers les équipes concernées par l’entretien de la solution, s’il y a lieu.

Profil

Connaissances générales requises
• Excellente connaissance des pratiques de développement agile;
• Excellente connaissance des phases de la gestion de projet et de la production des biens livrables associés (démarrage, planification et organisation, exécution, surveillance et contrôle, clôture);
• Excellente connaissance des technologies de développement Microsoft en infonuagique.

Connaissances spécifiques et habiletés requises

  • Posséder au moins dix-huit (18) ans d’expérience dans des projets de développement de nouvelles solutions informatiques, dont dix (10) anscomme chargée de projet ou comme maîtresse ou maître de mêlée (scrum master), dont cinq (5) ans dans un contexte d’agilité (escouades agiles en mêlée [scrum]) s’apparentant à un cadre similaire à celui de l’Office.
  • Avoir réalisé au moins trois (3) mandats à titre de chargée ou de chargé de projet dans des organisations de même envergure ou d’une envergure comparable à celle de l’Office. Avoir utilisé la méthodologie de gestion de projet en mode agile dans le cadre de deux (2) mandats.
  • Certification reconnue en gestion de projet en mode agile (ex. : PMP, SAFE, COC, PSM, PMI-ACP, PMI-PCM, etc.);
  • Utilisation des outils collaboratifs (ex. : Microsoft DevOps);
  • Bonne connaissance de la méthodologie de gestion de projet telle qu’appliquée dans les projets de développement informatique;
  • Capacité et facilité à transmettre ses connaissances aux ressources internes d’une organisation;
  • Très bonne maîtrise de la langue française, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit.

Scolarité requise

Posséder un diplôme d’études universitaire dans le domaine de la gestion de projet, des ressources informationnelles (informatique, génie informatique, génie logiciel ou discipline connexe), ou l’équivalent (joindre copie du diplôme).

LIEU DE TRAVAIL

Le lieu de travail sera déterminé selon le mandat, il peut être en télétravail ou chez le client.

POURQUOI SE JOINDRE À TEHORA?

TEHORA est une firme québécoise multidisciplinaire reconnue pour l'excellence de ses services professionnels, de nature technique et de gestion de projets à l'échelle nationale et internationale. Notre mission est d'accompagner nos clients dans la concrétisation de leurs projets par l'excellence de notre savoir-faire et de notre créativité.

Depuis sa création en 2017, notre équipe de professionnels connait une croissance exponentielle en répondant aux besoins importants en gestion de projets multidisciplinaires, dans le domaine des transports, du génie civil, du TI et plus.

Nos collaborateurs travaillent sur des mandats aussi bien à l’interne que chez des clients d’envergures.

TEHORA se distingue par sa culture d’entreprise, axée sur le bonheur de ses employés et la diversité.

Chez TEHORA, chaque collaborateur est un membre important de l'équipe qui contribue à notre succès collectif. Nos membres ont la flexibilité requise pour avoir un équilibre entre le travail et leur vie privée, tout en menant une carrière enrichissante.

Nous offrons un environnement de travail motivant. La diversité des projets, la grande autonomie et l’interaction directe avec les clients sont appréciées. Une telle proximité est possible en raison de notre structure organisationnelle

horizontale, qui se traduit par des relations de confiance et une communication efficace entre notre équipe et les clients.

AVANTAGES

  • Du télétravail et de la flexibilité pour s’adapter à vos obligations familiales;

  • Une culture entrepreneuriale favorisant la créativité et l'innovation;

  • Horaires flexibles (selon le type de contrat de travail);

  • Congés en cas de maladie et à l'occasion d'événements familiaux;

  • Outils informatiques adaptés;

  • Espace de travail épanouissant et motivant;

  • Initiatives sociales et environnementales;

  • Programme d’apprentissage en milieu de travail;

  • Cheminement de carrière.

SALAIRE

Le salaire sera calculé sur la base du taux horaire moyen correspondant à votre profil.

jobs.description:
Factbird gives manufacturing teams real-time operational intelligence without the complexity of traditional industrial systems. Our plug-and-play hardware and cloud platform turn live production data into decisions that improve performance across lines, sites, and global manufacturing networks.
We are building a dedicated enterprise capability to win and expand large, complex manufacturers. This is a foundational commercial hire with the mandate to shape how Factbird creates, closes, and grows our most important global accounts.

The opportunity
We are looking for a Large Enterprise Account Director who can lead high-stakes enterprise deals from first hypothesis to global rollout.

You will operate as the strategic commercial lead across a focused portfolio of named accounts. That means creating opportunities rather than waiting for them, building conviction with senior executives, navigating competing priorities and internal blockers, and turning operational value into an investment case that stands up to CFO-level scrutiny.
Success means more than winning a pilot. It means establishing Factbird as the manufacturing intelligence standard across dozens or hundreds of sites.

What you will own

Create the opportunity
  • Develop a point of view on each named account: where operational performance is constrained, why change matters now, who owns the problem, and how Factbird can create measurable enterprise value.
  • Build pipeline personally through disciplined account research, executive outreach, internal champions, partner routes, and relevant transformation events. You will not depend solely on inbound demand or centrally generated opportunities.

Shape the decision
  • Lead discovery that goes beyond gathering requirements. Test assumptions, expose the cost of inaction, and help customers define the operational and financial case for change.
  • Use MEDDPICC as a decision framework, not a reporting exercise. Identify the Economic Buyer, decision criteria, decision process, competition, champions, and commercial risks early enough to influence the outcome.

Navigate complexity and resistance
  • Build and lead a multithreaded strategy across Operations, IT, Finance, Procurement, Legal, and executive leadership.
  • Anticipate where a deal could stall, surface difficult issues directly, and create credible routes around technical, political, financial, and organisational blockers. Know when to build consensus, when to challenge, and when to escalate.
Prove enterprise value
  • Own the commercial strategy for pilots and proof-of-value programmes in partnership with Solutions Consulting and Customer Success.
  • Define success measures before deployment, maintain executive visibility, and ensure the pilot answers the questions required for an enterprise decision. Convert operational outcomes into a CFO-grade business case with a clear path to scale.

Lead the commercial close
  • Own deals involving complex buying groups, extended sales cycles, procurement processes, legal negotiation, and significant commercial value.
  • Develop deal strategies that protect value while simplifying the path to signature. Maintain a precise view of deal health, distinguish evidence from optimism, and communicate risks without spin.

Turn one site into a global programme
  • Treat the initial close as the start of the enterprise journey. Establish executive sponsorship, governance, deployment principles, and an expansion roadmap from the outset.
  • Work across regional and global stakeholders to convert one site into 20, 100, or more, embedding Factbird into the customer’s operational and financial planning cycles.
Raise the standard
  • As a foundational member of the enterprise team, help sharpen Factbird’s account strategy, qualification discipline, deal reviews, value methodology, and global expansion playbook.
  • Bring a strong point of view. Challenge internal thinking when the evidence calls for it, invite challenge in return, and improve the quality of decisions around you.

What We're Looking For


Enterprise deal leadership
  • 7+ years in complex B2B sales, ideally in enterprise SaaS, industrial technology, manufacturing technology, or another operationally critical category
  • Evidence of personally creating, closing, and expanding complex enterprise opportunities, rather than only managing opportunities generated by others
  • Experience navigating £/€500k–£/€1m+ deal complexity, or an equivalent combination of contract value, stakeholder breadth, deployment risk, and commercial sophistication
  • Success across sales cycles of 6–18 months or longer, involving multiple functions, sites, geographies, and senior decision-makers
  • A track record of converting initial deployments or pilots into meaningful multi-site expansion
  • Strong command of MEDDPICC or an equivalent enterprise qualification discipline, demonstrated through how you run deals rather than a training credential

Strategic and commercial capability
  • Credibility with COOs, CFOs, CIOs, and senior operational leaders
  • Ability to build business cases based on measurable operational and financial outcomes
  • Strong commercial judgment across pricing, negotiation, procurement, legal complexity, and value protection
  • Disciplined forecasting grounded in customer evidence and explicit next steps
  • Ability to develop a clear account thesis, translate it into action, and adapt it as new evidence emerges

How you operate
  • You are constructively challenging. You do not confuse collaboration with agreement, and you are comfortable testing the thinking of customers, colleagues, and leaders.
  • You create momentum. When a deal encounters resistance, you diagnose the blocker and build another route rather than waiting for circumstances to change.
  • You combine confidence with coachability. You bring experience and independent judgment without becoming rigid or defensive.
  • You treat each account as a business within the business, taking full ownership of strategy, execution, risk, and outcome.
  • You are energised by complex, long-cycle pursuits where disciplined thinking and persistence create an advantage.

What success looks like
Within your first 12 months, you will have:
  • Built credible, multithreaded strategies across a focused portfolio of named enterprise accounts
  • Personally created and advanced qualified opportunities with senior executive sponsorship
  • Established clear decision paths and commercial strategies for complex enterprise pursuits
  • Converted operational value into financially credible business cases
  • Progressed pilots with explicit success criteria and agreed routes to rollout
  • Built expansion plans capable of taking Factbird from an initial site to a global manufacturing standard
  • Raised the quality of enterprise account planning, qualification, forecasting, and deal strategy across the team

Who you will work with
You will report to the VP of Sales and act as the commercial lead within a Global Enterprise Pod, partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and regional Sales leadership across EMEA and the US.

Why Factbird?

People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here’s what you can look forward to:
  • Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.
  • Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.
  • Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.
  • Thoughtful, human onboarding: We’ll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.
  • A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we’ll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.
  • Company-wide kickoffs & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what’s next.
  • A global, inclusive culture: We’re proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

We’d love to hear from you If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Wanderlog is hiring a full-time engineer to help build and scale our web and mobile travel planning products. This is a permanent, full-time role reporting to the co-founders at Wanderlog.
Role details

  • Employment type: Full-time

  • Location: Remote — Canada

  • Reports to: Co-founders

  • Salary range: $110,000-$170,000 USD, depending on experience

About Wanderlog

Wanderlog helps make leisure travel easier. We believe that travel makes the world better, and are building tools that lower the bar to it.

Our core product, built starting in 2019, is a travel planning app, but we’re also helping travelers book hotels (without hidden fees), providing them with information through pages such as best attractions and restaurants, and more.

We’re a small, engineering- and product-driven team building tools used by travelers worldwide.

Wanderlog was founded by twin brothers Peter Xu and Harry Yu, who previously built successful travel products before starting Wanderlog.

What you'll do

As an engineer, you’ll be responsible for owning portions of the product. You’ll be expected to:
  • Build new features on our website and mobile app. (Our stack is Javascript (Typescript): modern React on the web, React Native on mobile, and Node.js/Express on the server.)
  • Design and decide what to build based on what would help travelers and drive growth. You won’t be handed a spec; you’ll be coming up with it!
  • Build data pipelines to crawl, process, and synthesize data from various sources around the web.
  • Write tests and build out engineering infrastructure. Our code is fully typed (Typescript) and tested.
  • Debug and fix bugs and scale the infrastructure as it grows.
  • Review code written by other engineers.
  • Be fast and nimble: figure out the best way to build new features at the lowest cost in time and future technical debt.
What you might work on
  • New, user-friendly hotel booking interfaces that make finding a place to stay easier.
  • AI-powered tools that read articles and watch videos for you and summarize the places they mention.
  • Improvements to our React Native mobile app so that it runs faster on slower Android phones.
  • A Chrome extension to let travelers quickly compare possible places to visit, airfares, and hotels.
  • Better invite and collaboration tools to encourage people to use Wanderlog to get more friends to join them.
  • A better profile page that lets travelers on Wanderlog show off where they’ve been, see how many people they’ve helped, and follow other friends and their trips.
What it's like to work here

We’re an engineering- and product-heavy team. A typical week involves talking to users, prioritizing tasks, designing in Figma, and continuously building and shipping improvements.

Our values include putting travelers first, owning the product end-to-end, treating teammates with respect, and moving fast by being thoughtful about what we build.

We believe work should fit into your life. We also hold twice-annual travel off sites to collaborate more closely and enjoy visiting new places together.

Hiring process
  • Two short asynchronous programming challenges, including an automated coding assessment
  • A live coding interview with one of the founders
  • A half-day final-round virtual onsite conducted via video call

Requirements

  • Have at least 2 years of experience doing full-stack, product development work. We have a wide salary range, as we do want to accept a range of candidate experiences properly.
  • Are a Javascript developer comfortable with React and/or React Native.
  • Are a product person: you’ve built products end-to-end before, and really care about the people who use them.
  • Are comfortable with picking up various technologies for the task at hand. We quickly evaluate libraries and tools that could help our product, and variously use Redis, Elasticsearch, and Python as needed too.
  • Are entrepreneurial: excited about joining a small, high-growth team and talking to users, doing product and design, and wearing a variety of hats.
  • Love travel and believe in it as a positive force personally and for the world.

Benefits

  • Medical
  • Vision
  • Dental
  • FSA or HSA plans
  • Paid sick leave

Position: Conveyancing Paralegal — NSW Property Law

Salary: up to PHP 95,000 per month (depending on skills and work experience)

ROLE OVERVIEW

The company is seeking an experienced Conveyancing Paralegal to support their NSW property law practice on a remote basis. This role focuses on assisting with the day-to-day management of NSW residential conveyancing transactions from commencement through to settlement and post-settlement administration — working closely with Australian-qualified solicitors and licensed conveyancers to ensure files progress efficiently, accurately, and within required timeframes. This is a paralegal support position; final legal review, settlement authorisation, and compliance oversight remain with the supervising Australian-based licensed practitioner at all times.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Client & File Management

  • Assist in managing conveyancing files from initial instruction through to post-settlement completion
  • Maintain regular communication with clients regarding transaction progress, outstanding requirements, and timelines
  • Obtain client documentation and instructions for review by supervising practitioners
  • Ensure file records, correspondence, and supporting documentation are accurately maintained throughout

Contract Preparation & Document Support

  • Assist with preparation of contracts for sale and supporting conveyancing documentation
  • Review contracts and supporting documents for completeness and accuracy prior to solicitor or licensed conveyancer review
  • Draft standard correspondence, settlement documentation, and transfer documentation
  • Assist with preparation of special conditions and amendments under supervision
  • Identify potential issues relating to title, zoning, easements, covenants, or restrictions and escalate where required
  • Coordinate disclosure documents and statutory certificates

Property Searches & Due Diligence

  • Conduct and manage property searches including title, plan, council, water authority, land tax, bankruptcy, ASIC, and planning and zoning searches
  • Review search results and identify matters requiring escalation to supervising practitioners
  • Assist with due diligence processes, file preparation, and coordination of outstanding documentation

Transaction Coordination

  • Assist with residential sales and purchases, transfers, refinancing, off-the-plan transactions, subdivisions, leasing matters, and related party transfers
  • Monitor key contractual and settlement dates across all active files
  • Prepare settlement figures and rate adjustments for review by supervising practitioners
  • Liaise with lenders regarding loan and discharge documentation
  • Coordinate execution of transfer and mortgage documents and prepare settlement packs

Electronic Conveyancing Support

  • Assist with settlements through electronic lodgement platforms including PEXA and Sympli
  • Prepare electronic workspace documentation and settlement schedules
  • Upload and manage settlement documents within electronic platforms
  • Coordinate with financial institutions and external parties regarding settlement requirements
  • Support Verification of Identity (VOI) and compliance processes
  • Escalate settlement risks, discrepancies, or financial concerns to supervising practitioners

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Assist with compliance requirements relating to NSW conveyancing procedures, duties and land tax, Electronic Conveyancing National Law, VOI requirements, client identification, and AML/CTF obligations where applicable
  • Maintain accurate file and compliance records and follow internal risk management protocols
  • Escalate legal or settlement risks to supervising Australian practitioners without delay

Settlement & Post-Settlement

  • Coordinate settlement preparation and administration tasks
  • Assist with calculation of settlement adjustments including council rates, water rates, and land tax
  • Arrange stamping, lodgement, and registration support where required
  • Confirm registration of dealings post-settlement and finalise and archive files in accordance with internal and regulatory requirements

Requirements

Must Haves:

  • Minimum 2 years of Australian conveyancing experience is required — previous experience supporting NSW residential conveyancing transactions is strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of Australian conveyancing processes and working knowledge of NSW conveyancing practice and procedures
  • Proficient in PEXA — hands-on experience is essential
  • Experience with LEAP or similar conveyancing practice management software
  • Qualification in Law, Legal Studies, Paralegal Studies, or a related field
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills with a professional and client-focused approach
  • Strong attention to detail and organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple conveyancing files simultaneously
  • Ability to work collaboratively with Australian-qualified practitioners under clear supervisory frameworks
  • Proactive approach to problem identification and escalation — does not wait to be prompted

PREFERRED SKILLS (nice to have)

  • Experience with Sympli for electronic conveyancing settlements
  • Familiarity with NSW-specific disclosure requirements, duties obligations, and land tax procedures
  • Exposure to a broad range of transaction types — off-the-plan, deceased estates, retirement village transactions, subdivisions, and leasing matters
  • Prior experience working with an Australian law firm or conveyancing practice in a remote or offshore support capacity
  • Experience across multiple Australian states — note that NSW-specific onboarding may be provided where required

Accelerate the possible by joining a winning Amcor team that’s transforming the packaging industry and improving lives around the world.

At Amcor, we unpack possibility through our innovative and responsible packaging to provide solutions that benefit our customers, our people and our planet. More than 10,000 consumers worldwide encounter our products every second and rely on us for safe access to food, medicine and other goods. We value their trust by making safety our guiding principle. It’s our core value and integral to how we do business.

Beyond this core principle, our shared values and behaviors unite us as we work together to elevate customers, shape lives and protect the future. We champion our customers and help them succeed. We play to win – adapting quickly in an everchanging world – and make smart choices to safeguard our business, our communities and the people we serve for generations to come. And we invest in our world-class team, empowering our colleagues to unpack their potential, because we believe when our people grow, so does our business.

To learn more about playing for Team Amcor, visit www.amcor.com I LinkedIn I Glassdoor I Facebook I YouTube

Job Description

As the Global Key Account Director - Mars, you'll be in a senior commercial leadership role focused on strengthening and growing the global partnership between Amcor and Mars. Our goal is simple: Partnering for Growth.


You’ll lead the global Mars snacking account, bringing together teams across Amcor to deliver growth, improve efficiency, advance sustainable packaging solutions, and create value for both organizations.


You’ll own the overall account strategy and Joint Business Plan, working closely with senior leaders at Mars as well as Amcor’s global and regional account teams, R&D, Sustainability, Operations, Supply Chain, and Sales & Marketing teams.


Success in this role means building strong relationships, identifying new opportunities, simplifying the packaging portfolio, delivering profitable growth, and ensuring we execute consistently across regions.


What You’ll Do


Lead the Global Account Strategy

  • Own the overall strategy, relationship, and commercial performance for the Mars account.
  • Lead the execution of the 3 to 5-year Joint Business Plan, translating long-term goals into clear priorities, projects, and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with regional and business unit leaders to align account strategies, growth plans, budgets, and commercial objectives.
  • Represent One Amcor, connecting capabilities across Flexibles, Cartons, and Rigids to bring the best solutions to Mars.

Drive Growth and Portfolio Transformation

  • Identify opportunities to grow Amcor’s share of business with Mars across regions, products, and business groups.
  • Lead packaging portfolio transformation efforts focused on innovation, simplification, sustainability, and total cost optimization.

Build Strong Customer Partnerships

  • Develop trusted relationships with senior Mars stakeholders around the world and across functions.

Deliver Commercial Results

  • Own the commercial performance and profitability of the account within the assigned scope.
  • Establish sales, growth, and margin targets in partnership with Amcor’s business units and global account leadership.
  • Monitor performance against targets, identify gaps, and coordinate action plans when needed.
  • Maintain clear visibility into account plans, customer projects, engagement priorities, and the growth pipeline.
  • Provide regular updates to senior leadership on account performance and progress against the Joint Business Plan.

Lead and Develop the Team

  • Lead, coach, and inspire commercial professionals supporting the account.
  • Set clear priorities and create accountability for delivering results.
  • Build a collaborative environment where teams across businesses, regions, and functions can work effectively together.
  • Develop talent, encourage ownership, and empower teams to make decisions and solve problems.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for an experienced commercial leader who is comfortable navigating a large, complex global customer relationship and bringing multiple teams together around a common strategy.


Ideally, you’ll bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in sales, marketing, commercial leadership, or a related role.
  • Ability to travel up to 40%, including occasional international travel.
  • Experience managing large, complex strategic accounts or commercial projects, preferably across multiple regions.
  • Experience in packaging, food, healthcare, or another complex manufacturing environment is preferred.
  • Knowledge of flexible packaging, manufacturing technologies, and production processes is a plus.
  • Solid business and financial acumen with the ability to balance growth, customer value, and profitability.
  • Proven ability to develop strategy and turn it into measurable results.
  • Proven project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • A customer-focused, solutions-oriented mindset with a passion for innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Solid communication and relationship-building skills across different functions, seniority levels, cultures, and geographies.
  • A collaborative leadership style that empowers teams while maintaining accountability for results.
  • Comfort working across global time zones and cultures.

What Success Looks Like


You’ll be successful in this role by bringingAmcor and Mars closer together, creating a clear growth agenda, advancing meaningful packaging innovation and sustainability initiatives, and turning the Joint Business Plan into measurable commercial results.


You’ll combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, helping teams across both organizations move faster, work more collaboratively, and create sustainable long-term value.


Our Expectations

We expect our people to be guided by The Amcor Way and demonstrate our Values every day to enable the business to win. We are winning when:

  • Our people are engaged and developing as part of a high-performing Amcor team

We are looking for an experienced MSP professional with incredibly high integrity, an inquisitive mind, strong commercial instincts, and a passion for operational and customer service excellence.

Commitment to our culture, values, and behaviors:

Achievement of the position objectives and key responsibilities is attained by:

  • Championing respect and inclusion, ensuring every interaction reflects our commitment to equal opportunity and a positive workplace culture.

  • Acting responsibly and with integrity, prioritizing the safety and well-being of yourself, others, the environment and our company.

Commercial Ownership, Customer Success & Business Partnership – your top priority is building relationships and driving measurable commercial impact across the client account:

Je bent de onmisbare schakel tussen de business van de klant en onze getalenteerde developers. Samen met je teams bouw je applicaties die dagelijks door miljoenen mensen worden gebruikt. Je doorziet technische en procesmatige risico's snel en vertaalt deze proactief naar concrete oplossingen.

Wat je gaat doen:

  • Complexe, organisatiebrede IT-trajecten en cross-platform projecten zelfstandig van initiatie tot succesvolle oplevering loodsen.

  • Duurzame relaties opbouwen met veeleisende enterprise-klanten en hen op C-level niveau overtuigend adviseren over prioriteiten en resources.

  • Multidisciplinaire, remote werkende ontwikkelteams (Android/Kotlin, iOS/Swift en backend) motiveren en optimaal laten presteren.

  • Technische risico's, zoals strenge store-richtlijnen van Apple en Google of complexe hardware-integraties, vroegtijdig tackelen.

  • Bestaande klantaccounts helpen groeien door proactief mee te denken over hun digitale transformatie.

Requirements

Wie ben jij?

We zoeken een daadkrachtige spin in het web met een scherpe blik op tastbare meerwaarde voor de klant. Je hebt aantoonbare, meerjarige ervaring als Projectmanager in het succesvol leiden van complexe, omvangrijke maatwerk softwareprojecten (ervaring in de mediasector is een pre). Je combineert een strategische langetermijnvisie moeiteloos met een hands-on executie. Ervaring in de mediasector is een pré.

Je schakelt soepel tussen Agile/Scrum-methodieken en traditionele fixed scope/fixed price - trajecten. Als communicatief sterke professional bewaar je de rust bij tegenslag en weet je hoe je met tact en daadkracht slecht nieuws overbrengt. Je hebt ervaring met stakeholdermanagement op C-level niveau van veeleisende corporate of Enterprise klanten, waarbij je duurzame relaties opbouwt, overtuigend adviseert en effectief onderhandelt over prioriteiten en resources. Je bent empathisch, verbindend en voelt je thuis in een 'remote first' werkomgeving waar vakmanschap de standaard is. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland en spreek je vloeiend Nederlands.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

  • Salaris: Bruto maandsalaris passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten.

  • Werkplek & Sfeer: Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen.

  • Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken: Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen.

  • Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies.

  • De 'Gadget Kit': Alle devices die je nodig hebt om mee te kijken op jouw projecten én een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek.

  • Events & Fun: Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.

Solliciteren

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.

Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

jobs.description:
At Terabase Energy, we believe that digitalization and automation will drive the next wave of innovation and cost reduction in large scale solar. To fully unlock the potential of this opportunity, Terabase is developing an interconnected software and construction automation platform. We work alongside project developers, owners, and engineering & construction firms to support the design, optimization, and construction of huge solar projects around the world. Our team is a blend of solar-industry veterans and newbies, thought-leaders, dreamers, software, electrical and mechanical engineers, coders, product managers, project managers, and sales and marketing professionals. We are based in Northern California, with several other offices in the United States and around the world.

Job description

Test Automation Engineer is responsible to develop, and execute automated test frameworks for environments like SIL(Software-in-the-loop) and HIL(Hardware-in-the-loop), that allow us to test our power plant controller and SCADA system. Your mission is to build the automated frameworks that catch edge cases before they hit the field, ensuring every product we ship meets the highest standards of reliability.

Responsibilities

  • Automation Framework Development: Design, build, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks and scripts for power, control and SCADA systems using Python. You will transition our validation processes from manual intervention to a fully automated, scalable framework.
  • V&V Strategy: Define and execute comprehensive Verification and Validation (V&V) plans, ensuring all software requirements for the site controller and SCADA systems are met under normal and fault conditions
  • CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated HIL/SIL testing into our CI/CD pipelines, providing real-time feedback to the development teams and serving as the final gate for production-ready code
  • Requirements Investigation: Analyze and interpret technical specifications to author comprehensive automated test suites, actively tracking down gaps in system requirements.
  • Multi-Environment Execution: Execute automated test suites across SIL, MIL, and HIL setups.Analyze test captures, isolate system failures, and generate detailed engineering reports.
  • Root Cause Analysis: Work closely with the controls and systems teams to debug complex failures found during validation, using logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and telemetry logs to pinpoint issues

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Experience: 2+ years of professional experience in software validation or test automation for hardware-focused systems.
  • Programming Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Python and Bash scripting, alongside a practical reading knowledge of PLC/RTAC/IEC 61131-3 Control logic.
  • Automation Toolchains: Direct experience architecting or heavily extending modern pythonic test frameworks (such as Pytest or OpenHTF).
  • Systematic Thinking: A dedicated mindset for "breaking" software. You have a track record of finding critical edge cases in complex state machines and control loops
  • Infrastructure: Experience with Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, and containerization tools like Docker for managing consistent test environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of NERC, FERC, ISO/RTO, and utility interconnection requirements is preferred.
  • Experience with utility-scale solar PV, Battery ---Energy Storage Systems (BESS), hybrid renewable energy plants, or inverter-based resources (IBR) is preferred.
  • Version Control: Advance user-level with Git and modern branch management strategies.

Communication protocols (e.g., IEC 61850, Modbus, DNP3)

jobs.description:
iFIT’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey.

We are currently seeking an ambitious pace-setter to join our team as a Consumer GTM Lead, NordicTrack North America remotely in the US.

NordicTrack is one of the most recognized names in fitness equipment and a flagship brand of iFIT, a global leader in connected fitness. The Consumer GTM Lead for NordicTrack North America will operate as a business owner across the total consumer purchase journey for all consumer-facing sales channels — retail and the DTC website. This role owns audience and demand strategy, positioning and merchandising, pricing and promotion, full-funnel acquisition and retention, and the conversion engine that turns consumer demand into sales across channels. Success requires strong consumer and commercial instincts, fluency in performance marketing and funnel economics, comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to connect brand, creative, media, and merchandising into a cohesive, revenue-generating go-to-market approach.

ROLE COMMITMENTS

  • Own the NordicTrack North America consumer business as a clearly defined, high-performing commercial engine across retail and DTC, creating clarity around who the priority audiences are, what NordicTrack offers them, and why the brand wins across the full consumer purchase journey.
  • Partner with Sales and drive the sales performance metrics that translate consumer demand into measurable, profitable revenue, setting realistic targets for traffic, conversion, average order value, and revenue.
  • Build and run the full-funnel, cross-channel go-to-market motion from strategy to closed revenue, owning the acquisition-to-retention engine across retail, owned, and paid channels.
  • Connect brand, media, retail, and merchandising into a cohesive, channel-agnostic conversion strategy, ensuring creative, media, site, retail, and promotional decisions work together to drive both brand health and commercial performance.
  • Operate as the accountable owner of the NordicTrack North America consumer business, taking end-to-end responsibility for traffic, conversion, revenue, and retention in close partnership with Sales as the channel P&L owner.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own demand creation across retail and DTC — developing the audience, brand, and full-funnel strategy that generates new consumer demand for NordicTrack, not just capturing existing demand.
  • Identify the primary barriers to conversion and retention, and push beyond surface explanations to uncover root causes.
  • Translate demand-creation ambition into a clear full-funnel strategy and channel roles that build and convert demand, in partnership with Media, Creative, Merchandising, and Analytics.
  • Monitor competitive, cultural, and consumer trends and determine which are strategically relevant.
  • Define how NordicTrack should be positioned to priority consumer audiences.
  • Build a full-funnel communication and merchandising framework that clarifies who we are speaking to, what we are saying, and when.
  • Develop pricing and promotional strategies that connect consumer value with margin objectives.
  • Ensure positioning, merchandising, and messaging are consistently reflected across retail, site, paid media, social, and lifecycle channels.
  • Continuously refine pricing, promotion, and messaging based on performance signals and customer response.
  • Own go-to-market planning across consumer channels, including timelines, channel roles, retail and site asset requirements, and success metrics.
  • Own the acquisition-to-retention funnel, from traffic and conversion through repeat purchase and lifetime value.
  • Write clear briefs that define target audience, insight, single-minded message, tone, and guardrails.
  • Evaluate creative and site performance decisively and consistently, distinguishing good work from great work.
  • Serve as the strategic owner of conversion and commercial quality across brand, performance, retail, and site experience.
  • Partner effectively with Media and Finance with a working understanding of performance marketing economics, margin, and ROI tradeoffs.
  • Apply strong judgment about what will and will not work across organic and paid social platforms, and partner with Social and Influencer teams to develop ideas that feel native to platform and culture.
  • Develop clear product storytelling and merchandising that drives conversion across retail and owned channels.
  • Create site, promotional, and lifecycle assets that make the offer easy to understand and act on.
  • Ensure consistent and effective representation of the brand across retail, site, paid media, and lifecycle touchpoints.
  • Define success metrics across traffic, conversion, AOV, retention, and contribution margin.
  • Partner with Analytics to interpret performance results and identify root causes rather than symptoms.
  • Translate learnings into clear adjustments to strategy, pricing, merchandising, or channel emphasis.
  • Prioritize depth and impact over breadth of initiatives.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

Education and Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.
  • 5–7 years of experience in consumer go-to-market, retail, direct-to-consumer, e-commerce, or growth roles for physical products.
  • Experience owning conversion, retention, or full-funnel performance across retail and/or DTC channels.
  • Demonstrated ability to make decisions with incomplete information and move work forward quickly.
  • Proven judgment across brand and performance contexts, including experience shaping pricing and promotion.
  • Working understanding of performance marketing fundamentals, funnel economics, margin, and ROI considerations.
  • Experience operating within both scaled brands and fast-moving, resource-constrained environments.
  • Strong intuition for social-first creative and cultural relevance.

Qui sommes-nous?

Chez CMLS Financial, nous trouvons un équilibre unique : la solidité financière d'un leader de l'industrie depuis 50 ans, jumelée à l'énergie d'une entreprise dynamique au rythme rapide.

  • Croissance et exposition : Avec plus de 45 milliards de dollars en actifs sous administration, notre entreprise en plein essor vous offre une exposition à haut niveau et de réelles occasions d'avancement de carrière.
  • Culture de soutien : Nous sommes professionnels tout en étant agréables. Nous offrons un environnement stimulant, soutenu par une équipe qui souhaite vous voir réussir.
  • Portée nationale : Travaillez avec les banques, gestionnaires de placements et caisses de retraite les plus importants au Canada, à partir d'une plateforme dotée de bureaux d'un océan à l'autre.

Lieu de travail

Nous recherchons particulièrement une personne bilingue (français/anglais) basée au Nouveau-Brunswick, Canada. Il s'agit d'un poste en télétravail.

Pourquoi nous recrutons

Nous agrandissons notre équipe de souscription hypothécaire pour répondre à la croissance importante de notre volume de demandes au Québec.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Adjuger avec précision et discernement : Examiner et analyser les demandes de prêt hypothécaire résidentiel et les documents à l'appui (crédit, revenus, actifs et évaluations). Vous appliquerez un jugement de crédit solide dans les limites d'autorisation établies afin d'identifier et d'atténuer les risques, tout en assurant la conformité aux politiques réglementaires et internes.
  • Prendre en charge votre pipeline : Gérer vos dossiers de bout en bout dans un environnement à volume élevé et axé sur la performance. Vous êtes responsable de vous assurer que les demandes sont complétées dans les délais impartis et que les transactions se concluent selon le calendrier prévu, sans compromettre la qualité.
  • Offrir des solutions et du soutien : Agir en partenaire proactif auprès de nos partenaires courtiers. Vous ne vous contentez pas de rendre des décisions : vous proposez des solutions. Vous détectez les informations manquantes tôt et intervenez de manière proactive pour résoudre les situations complexes, assurant ainsi une expérience fluide pour le client.
  • Maintenir le standard « Bien fait » : Cultiver une culture de diligence rigoureuse. Vous maintiendrez des dossiers de prêt organisés et irréprochables, où chaque document est vérifié et conforme aux politiques de l'entreprise et aux directives de prêt.
  • Favoriser l'amélioration continue : Au-delà de la souscription quotidienne, vous repérerez des gains d'efficacité et accompagnerez les membres de l'équipe, en maintenant une attitude positive qui s'épanouit dans un environnement de prêt dynamique et en constante évolution.

Ce que vous apportez

  • Minimum 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en souscription hypothécaire résidentielle.
  • Vous n'acceptez pas les dossiers à leur valeur apparente. Vous êtes le type de souscripteur qui creuse dans les détails, pose des questions de clarification et cherche le « comment » plutôt que de se contenter d'un « non ».
  • Vous vous épanouissez dans un environnement à volume élevé. Vous êtes organisé, autonome et prenez fierté à gérer votre pipeline efficacement sans sacrifier la qualité.
  • Vous fonctionnez en équipe. Vous êtes à l'aise pour encadrer les autres et travailler en collaboration avec différents départements pour faire avancer les dossiers.
  • Vous avez un intérêt sincère à contribuer à la transformation du parcours client en matière hypothécaire.
  • Bilinguisme français et anglais.

Atouts

  • Expérience en tant que souscripteur dans une caisse populaire, un prêteur monoline ou un environnement institutionnel similaire.
  • L'expérience en prêt A (A lending) est centrale à ce rôle ; un parcours diversifié en prêt alternatif (B lending) ou en prêt commercial constitue un atout.

Processus d'entrevue

  • Entretien avec le recruteur (30 min) : Un appel de présentation pour en apprendre davantage sur votre parcours et vous donner un portrait réel du poste.
  • Etude de cas: Une occasion de mettre en valeur vos compétences au moyen d'un exercice pratique pertinent au rôle.
  • Entrevue finale (60 min) : Vous rencontrerez le recruteur ainsi que deux autres parties prenantes pour une dernière conversation avant qu'une décision soit prise.
  • Étape de l'offre : Sous réserve de vérifications satisfaisantes des antécédents, du casier judiciaire et des références, vous recevrez une offre formelle pour rejoindre l'équipe.

Pour soutenir votre vie chez CMLS

  • Couverture santé complète : Assurance maladie complémentaire, soins dentaires et soins de la vue de premier ordre, avec une couverture médicamenteuse à 100 %.
  • Compte santé et mieux-être : Un fonds flexible annuel combiné de 1 500 $ pour des dépenses telles que les abonnements à une salle de sport ou des besoins médicaux supplémentaires.
  • Congés payés généreux : 4 semaines de vacances et 8 jours personnels flottants.
  • Épargne-retraite : Accès à un régime collectif REER/RPDB avec des cotisations de contrepartie concurrentielles de l'employeur.
  • Services de télémédecine : Accès via Dialogue et couverture pour les services de praticiens agréés.
  • Soutien à la famille : Programmes généreux de prestations complémentaires de maternité et de congé parental.

Employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances CMLS Financial est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances. Nous célébrons la diversité et nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour l'ensemble de nos employés. Nous accueillons les candidatures de toutes les personnes qualifiées, incluant les peuples autochtones (Premières Nations, Inuits et Métis), les personnes en situation de handicap, les femmes ainsi que les membres des minorités visibles et des communautés LGBTQ2+.

Des accommodements liés à un handicap sont disponibles sur demande pour les candidats participant à toutes les étapes du processus de sélection.

Prêt à vous joindre à nous?

Nous apprécions votre intérêt envers CMLS Financial. Nous examinons les candidatures dès leur réception et continuerons jusqu'à ce que le poste soit pourvu. Bien que nous remercions tous les candidats pour leur temps, veuillez noter que nous communiquerons uniquement avec les personnes sélectionnées pour une entrevue.

Work Experience, Education, and Certifications

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or a similar role.
  • Proven, hands-on experience building data models and Notebooks within Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse and/or Warehouse), not just Power BI report-building.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewJoin a team where innovation meets mission.
jobs.description:
Overview

Join a team where innovation meets mission. Our AI, cloud, cyber, and modernization solutions save agencies thousands of hours, safeguard national security, and strengthen health and humanitarian missions worldwide. With 1,700+ team members, 1,500+ AI/data experts, and 100+ prime contracts, we deliver at scale and with purpose.

We’ve been recognized as a Top Workplace by the Washington Post for six straight years and named to the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies 13 of the past 14 years. Credence is a welcoming home for those looking to grow and contribute to positive change. We encourage all employees to expand beyond their boundaries, dive into important world-changing Federal challenges.

Position Summary

The Humanitarian Assistance Support Contract (HASC) brings together exceptional institutional support experience, technical leadership, and an unmatched commitment to US missions. HASC supports the U.S. Department of State’s (DOS) humanitarian assistance, disaster response, and foreign assistance across multiple bureaus. Team Credence, through the HASC, delivers operational and administrative support to provide and coordinate humanitarian assistance and maintain 24/7 response capability.

Credence has an immediate need for the Humanitarian Health Advisor, Ebola Response Consultant who will serve as part of the Disaster Humanitarian and Response (DHR) Bureau’s Technical Quality and Assurance (TQA) Office, within the Health Unit. They will be responsible for working on DHR’s response to the current Ebola disease outbreak in West/Central Africa.

The Consultant will also work with other sectors of the office including protection; water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH); nutrition; natural hazards and shelter and settlements, to provide a multidisciplinary approach to providing life-saving program to disaster affected populations. S/he will support DHR’s approach to emergency health activities within the team and assist in developing response strategies and provide technical support to humanitarian health programming in the Department of State. The Advisor will receive day-to-day guidance from the Senior Health Advisor. S/he will work in close coordination with other Health Advisors.

Scope:

The Consultant will provide technical advisory services to the TQA Office in support of the Department of State’s humanitarian health programming. In addition, the consultant will support DHR’s coordination with the Bureau of Global Health Security and Diplomacy and other bureaus at State and the interagency, including HHS/ASPR, OGA, and CDC.

Overall, the Consultant is expected to show strong independent initiative and work with minimal supervision and engage with stakeholders in close collaboration with and under the direction of the Senior Health Advisor and Ebola Response Leads. Day-to-day oversight of the position will be provided by the Senior Health Advisor, with formal supervisory and evaluation functions performed by a Credence contract supervisor.

The main roles and responsibilities of the Consultant will be:

  • Advise the Response Lead on appropriate strategies on humanitarian response modalities that best enable Ebola outbreak response activities considering lessons learned from past Ebola outbreaks. Identify critical gaps that facilitate the pillars of response and advise the DHR leadership on these strategies.
  • Liaise directly with technical lead and pillar leads of the response at post, and in DC.
  • Advise the DHR Programs Lead on programming. And advise on when other technical sectors need to provide analysis and technical assistance for the response.
  • Engage with the national health cluster and sub-clusters to understand humanitarian gaps, challenges and response plans; attend regular cluster meetings.
  • Evaluate and document health programming gaps and assess the performance of current DHR awards in responding to these gaps.
  • Coordinate with humanitarian partners to understand humanitarian gaps and challenges in light of the Ebola response and understand the integration of health humanitarian actions and Ebola response actions.
  • Attend pillar meetings to understand technical gaps and how they are exacerbated by humanitarian needs or could be better supported through humanitarian enablers.
  • Serve as a USG humanitarian health sector resource person, assist in strategy development and provide expert technical and organizational leadership in sectoral activity as part of Ebola Response.
  • Advise and support technical and strategic thinking for health activities, interventions, and recommendation discussions. Develop sector strategies, guidance, and recommendations (in coordination with other sectors when required) for disaster and humanitarian response; and provide technical support for DHR staff at Post, and other offices within State.
  • Advise and support discussions on emergency health activities with NGO partners and other Department of State staff working in humanitarian health.
  • Provide technical review of proposals submitted by NGO and UN partners for humanitarian health programs. Apply new developments in the emergency health sector to humanitarian programming.
  • Advise on the coordination, implementation and prioritization of emergency health activities to ensure that efforts in assigned program areas are meeting the needs of affected populations and satisfy the goals and objectives of the response program.
  • As needed, provide technical support to State’s humanitarian nutrition and WASH Teams related to the complementary nature of these interventions to improve health outcomes in humanitarian settings.
  • As needed, serve on DARTs and serve on Washington-based Response Management Teams (RMTs), which provides services and support to DARTs deployed in response to disasters. The duties on RMTs will vary. (DARTs may require immediate (within 24 hours) deployment overseas for an extended period of time.)

Requirements

  • Post Graduate Studies (Master’s degree) plus seven (7) years of experience working in emergency relief and humanitarian assistance, and infectious disease outbreaks. A minimum of three (3) years of relevant experience must be obtained overseas.
  • Recent experience working in a technical capacity for an international nongovernmental organization, public international organization, or USG agency working in humanitarian relief and/or response in health and infectious disease outbreaks.
  • Fluency in critical concepts of emergency/ humanitarian health interventions in humanitarian contexts and ability to develop and guide programming to reflect those standards.
  • Understanding of key health issues related to displaced populations, refugees and other vulnerable populations and ability to represent the humanitarian perspective.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret strategy; to analyze, develop and present work results; and to monitor and evaluate implementation of programs.
  • Demonstrated flexibility and openness in responding to changing work priorities and environments.
  • Fluency in French and experience in the Democratic Republic of Congo strongly preferred.
  • US citizenship with an Active Secret Clearance required.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:

  • This position requires the ability to deploy for international travel assignments for at least one month at a time, as well as occasional domestic travel to Washington, DC.
  • When not travelling, this is a fully remote position within the United States and its territories.
  • Consultant may be requested for additional domestic or international travel up to 21 days.

  • Brand stewardship. Act as a guardian of Cyera’s voice and identity across the company. Give partners across marketing, sales, and product the creative guardrails they need to move fast without losing consistency.

Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10-12 years of creative experience, including time as an art director, creative director, or similar role, ideally at a B2B technology company or a category-defining brand.

  • People leadership. You’ve hired, coached, and grown creative talent, and people want to do their best work for you.
